title: AgentServe: Algorithm-System Co-Design for Efficient Agentic AI Serving on a Consumer-Grade GPU
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI agents that operate in short reasoning-action loops, interleaving model computation with external calls. Unlike traditional chat applications, these agentic workloads require inference serving systems to balance low latency, stable token emission, and throughput under multiple request arrivals from different AI agents. Recent deployments highlight a shift toward running small language models (SLMs) locally on consumer-grade GPUs, driven by privacy, compliance, and cost constraints. When heterogeneous requests overlap on a single GPU, long prefills and short decodes contend for resources, creating head-of-line blocking that destabilizes interactive performance. By analyzing agent workloads, we observe that their execution naturally separates into cold prefills, which process long system prompts, resume prefills, which append tool outputs to cached contexts, and short decodes, which are latency-critical. This mix intensifies contention compared to conventional chatbot serving. We present AgentServe, a single-GPU serving system that ensures stable multi-agent execution under such conditions by isolating prefills from decodes, applying dynamic budgeting to resume prefills, and allocating GPU resources through pre-established CUDA Green Context slots with adaptive control. Evaluation results show that AgentServe significantly improves latency stability while sustaining competitive throughput, achieving up to 2.8x TTFT improvement and 2.7x TPOT improvement over state-of-the-art baselines across different settings.

AI.tldr: AgentServe是一个针对单GPU上多智能体推理服务场景的系统，通过隔离预填充和解码、动态预算resume预填充、以及使用CUDA Green Context的自适应控制来确保多智能体执行的稳定性。实验表明该系统可实现最高2.8倍的TTFT提升和2.7倍的TPOT提升。
AI.motivation: 1) 大语言模型作为AI智能体在短推理-行动循环中部署，需要低延迟、稳定的token生成和高吞吐量；2) 消费者级GPU上运行小语言模型(SLM)的趋势带来隐私、合规和成本优势；3) 异构请求（长预填充vs短解码）在单GPU上竞争资源，导致行首阻塞，破坏交互性能；4) 智能体工作负载自然分为冷预填充、恢复预填充和短解码，比传统聊天服务更具资源竞争性。
AI.method: 1) 将预填充与解码操作隔离，避免相互阻塞；2) 对恢复预填充应用动态预算控制；3) 通过预建立的CUDA Green Context槽位进行GPU资源分配，并实现自适应控制机制；4) 针对智能体工作负载特点（长系统prompt处理、工具输出追加、延迟敏感的短解码）进行专门优化。
AI.result: 在多种设置下，AgentServe相比最先进的基线系统实现了：1) TTFT（首个token生成时间）提升最高2.8倍；2) TPOT（每token输出时间）提升最高2.7倍；3) 显著改善了延迟稳定性；4) 保持了具有竞争力的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: AgentServe通过精细的资源隔离和动态调度机制，成功解决了单GPU上多智能体推理服务中的核心挑战，在保证吞吐量的前提下大幅提升了延迟敏感型智能体工作负载的性能稳定性和响应速度，为消费者级GPU上的高效智能体服务部署提供了可行方案。

title: S-HPLB: Efficient LLM Attention Serving via Sparsity-Aware Head Parallelism Load Balance
summary: With the increasing volumes of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the expanding context lengths, attention computation has become a key performance bottleneck in LLM serving. For fast attention computation, recent practices often parallelize the attention heads on multiple GPUs, and also widely adopt attention sparsification to reduce the computation amount -- which selectively computes a subset of attention pairs under a preset sparsity budget. In this paper, we notice that attention heads of an LLM model often exhibit heterogeneous-yet-stable sparsity elasticities, which motivates us to enforce head-adaptive sparsity budgets to attain better efficiency while preserving high inference quality. Yet, from the system aspect, with heterogeneous sparsity levels, attention computation time on different heads would be inconsistent, yielding cross-GPU resource bubbles under head-parallel deployment. To further minimize such bubbles, we propose a novel attention deployment strategy called Sparsity-aware Head-Parallel Load Balance (S-HPLB). Experiments on long-context benchmark show that, S-HPLB can achieve a $2.88\times$ improvement in average attention computation latency without quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM推理中注意力计算成为瓶颈的问题，提出了一种基于头自适应稀疏度的部署策略S-HPLB，通过为不同注意力头分配差异化的稀疏预算来平衡计算负载，在长上下文基准测试中实现2.88倍注意力延迟提升且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 1) LLM上下文长度增加导致注意力计算成为关键性能瓶颈；2) 现有方法对所有注意力头采用统一稀疏度，忽视了不同头之间的异质性；3) 头并行部署时，不同头的计算时间不一致导致跨GPU资源空闲气泡。
AI.method: 1) 观察到注意力头具有异质但稳定的稀疏弹性；2) 提出头自适应稀疏预算机制，为不同头分配差异化稀疏度；3) 设计Sparsity-aware Head-Parallel Load Balance (S-HPLB)策略，最小化跨GPU资源气泡。
AI.result: 在长上下文基准测试中，平均注意力计算延迟提升2.88倍，且无质量降解。
AI.conclusion: S-HPLB通过头自适应稀疏预算有效提升了LLM推理效率，同时保持了高质量推理，为长上下文LLM部署提供了新的优化方向。

title: CD-Raft: Reducing the Latency of Distributed Consensus in Cross-Domain Sites
summary: Today's massive AI computation loads push heavy data synchronization across sites, i.e., nodes in data centers. Any reduction in such consensus latency can significantly improve the overall performance of desired systems. This consensus challenge explosively peaks at cross-domain sites. In this paper, we proposed CD-Raft to address the cross-domain latency challenge, an optimized Raft protocol for strong consistency in cross-domain sites. CD-Raft can significantly reduce consensus latency by optimizing cross-domain round-trip time (RTT) for reads and writes, as well as carefully positioning the leader node. We verified the correctness of CD-Raft in a formal specification using the TLA+ specification, guaranteeing the strong consistency across sites. We have prototyped CD-Raft and evaluated it using the YCSB benchmark. Empirical results show that compared to the classic Raft, CD-Raft reduces the average latency by 32.90% and (99th percentile) tail latency by 49.24% for renown traces across multiple sites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CD-Raft优化跨域Raft协议，通过优化读写RTT和leader节点定位来解决跨站点共识延迟问题，经TLA+形式化验证和YCSB基准测试表明可降低平均延迟约33%、尾延迟约49%。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模AI计算产生海量跨站点（数据中心）数据同步需求，跨域场景下的共识延迟挑战尤为突出，降低共识延迟可显著提升系统整体性能。
AI.method: 提出CD-Raft协议，优化跨域读写操作的往返时间(RTT)，并精心设计leader节点位置部署；使用TLA+形式化规范验证了协议的正确性；基于YCSB基准测试进行原型实现与性能评估。
AI.result: 与经典Raft相比，CD-Raft平均延迟降低32.90%，99分位尾延迟降低49.24%，同时保证跨站点强一致性。
AI.conclusion: CD-Raft通过优化跨域RTT和 leader 节点定位，有效解决了跨域场景下的共识延迟问题，在保证强一致性的前提下显著降低了平均延迟和尾延迟。

title: Double-Precision Matrix Multiplication Emulation via Ozaki-II Scheme with FP8 Quantization
summary: In high-performance computing (HPC) applications, FP64 arithmetic remains indispensable for ensuring numerical accuracy and stability. However, in recent hardware generations, improvements in FP64 arithmetic performance have been relatively modest. Consequently, achieving sustained performance gains for FP64 computations necessitates the effective utilization of high-throughput low-precision arithmetic, such as INT8 and FP8. In several recent architectures, such as NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra and NVIDIA Rubin, INT8 performance has been significantly reduced, making reliance on INT8 alone insufficient. The use of FP8 arithmetic is thus increasingly important. In this paper, we propose a method for emulating double-precision (FP64) general matrix--matrix multiplication (DGEMM), a fundamental and performance-critical kernel in many HPC applications, using FP8 matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) units. The Ozaki-I and Ozaki-II schemes are well established as foundational approaches for emulating DGEMM via low-precision arithmetic. For DGEMM emulation via the Ozaki-I scheme, implementations using INT8, FP8, and FP16 MMA units have been proposed, all of which can be realized based on the same underlying algorithmic structure. In contrast, although implementations of DGEMM emulation via the Ozaki-II scheme using INT8 MMA units have been reported, the original algorithm cannot be directly adapted to exploit FP8 MMA units. In this work, we introduce a novel technique to overcome this limitation and demonstrate FP64 matrix multiplication emulation based on the Ozaki-II scheme that operates on FP8 MMA units. Compared to FP8-based emulation via the Ozaki-I scheme, our method significantly reduces the number of required FP8 matrix multiplications and enables efficient FP64 emulation on emerging GPU architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Ozaki-II方案利用FP8 MMA单元模拟FP64矩阵乘法(DGEMM)的方法，解决了传统Ozaki-II方案无法直接适配FP8的问题，相比Ozaki-I方案显著减少了所需的FP8矩阵乘法次数，可在新兴GPU架构上实现高效的FP64仿真。
AI.motivation: 1) FP64运算对HPC应用至关重要，但近年来性能提升有限；2) 新一代GPU（如NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra和Rubin）中INT8性能大幅下降；3) FP8成为重要选择，但已有Ozaki-II方案无法直接适配FP8 MMA单元
AI.method: 提出一种新技术使Ozaki-II方案能够利用FP8 MMA单元进行FP64矩阵乘法仿真
AI.result: 成功实现了基于Ozaki-II方案的FP64矩阵乘法仿真，与Ozaki-I方案相比显著减少了所需的FP8矩阵乘法次数，提高了效率
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够在新兴GPU架构上实现高效的FP64仿真，为HPC应用提供了新的低精度加速途径

title: LLMGreenRec: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Recommender System for Sustainable E-Commerce
comment: Accepted to the Proceedings of the Conference on Digital Economy and Fintech Innovation (DEFI 2025). To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Rising environmental awareness in e-commerce necessitates recommender systems that not only guide users to sustainable products but also minimize their own digital carbon footprints. Traditional session-based systems, optimized for short-term conversions, often fail to capture nuanced user intents for eco-friendly choices, perpetuating a gap between green intentions and actions. To tackle this, we introduce LLMGreenRec, a novel multi-agent framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to promote sustainable consumption. Through collaborative analysis of user interactions and iterative prompt refinement, LLMGreenRec's specialized agents deduce green-oriented user intents and prioritize eco-friendly product recommendations. Notably, this intent-driven approach also reduces unnecessary interactions and energy consumption. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate LLMGreenRec's effectiveness in recommending sustainable products, demonstrating a robust solution that fosters a responsible digital economy.

AI.tldr: LLMGreenRec是一个利用大语言模型的多智能体框架，通过协作分析用户交互和迭代提示优化来推断绿色导向的用户意图，从而推荐环保产品，同时减少不必要的交互和能源消耗。
AI.motivation: 传统基于会话的推荐系统优化短期转化率，无法捕捉用户对环保产品的细微意图，导致绿色意图与实际行动之间存在差距。此外，这些系统本身也产生数字碳足迹。
AI.method: 提出LLMGreenRec多智能体框架，利用大语言模型(LLMs)的协作分析能力，通过专业智能体推断绿色导向的用户意图，并进行迭代提示优化，从而优先推荐环保产品。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了LLMGreenRec在推荐可持续产品方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LLMGreenRec提供了一个促进可持续消费的稳健解决方案，能够在推荐环保产品的同时减少能源消耗，推动负责任的数字经济发展。

title: One Model, Many Skills: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Multitask Code Analysis
summary: Large language models have recently surpassed specialized systems on code generation, yet their effectiveness on other code-analysis tasks remains less clear. At the same time, multi-task learning offers a way to unify diverse objectives within a single model, but fully fine-tuning LLMs across tasks is computationally prohibitive. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning mitigates this cost by updating only a small fraction of weights. Although PEFT has proven effective in single-task settings, its potential for multi-task learning has not yet been systematically explored. We present the first comprehensive evaluation of multi-task PEFT for code analysis, comparing several methods across diverse tasks and model architectures. Our experiments show that a single PEFT module shared across tasks can match, and in some cases surpass, full multi-task fine-tuning, confirming that the benefits of PEFT extend beyond isolated tasks. When comparing single-task and multi-task setups, we find that multi-task PEFT achieves a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off: it delivers accuracy close to single-task fine-tuning while reducing storage requirements, cutting the number of trainable parameters by a factor of the task count, and lowering computation costs by as much as 85%. At the same time, multi-task gains remain sensitive to task grouping. Through task-pairing experiments, we identify key factors shaping outcomes: task stability, model architecture, task complementarity, asymmetry, and dataset quality determine the success of co-fine-tuning. Finally, we benchmark efficient multi-task PEFT against direct prompting of open-source general-purpose LLMs, including DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, CodeLlama, and StarCoder. Despite their strong performance in code generation, these models underperform on analysis tasks, where even a 1B-parameter model with multi-task PEFT achieves significantly better results.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估多任务PEFT在代码分析任务中的应用，表明共享PEFT模块可匹配完整微调，多任务PEFT在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低计算和存储成本，同时发现任务分组的关键影响因素，并证明小参数PEFT模型优于大型通用模型。
AI.motivation: 大模型在代码生成上表现优异，但在其他代码分析任务上的效果尚不明确；多任务学习可统一不同目标，但完整微调计算成本过高；参数高效微调（PEFT）虽在单任务中有效，其在多任务学习中的潜力尚未被系统探索。
AI.method: 在多样化的代码分析任务和模型架构上系统评估多种多任务PEFT方法，进行任务配对实验，并对比多任务PEFT与直接提示开源大模型的效果。
AI.result: 1）单个共享PEFT模块可匹配/超越完整多任务微调；2）多任务PEFT实现接近单任务微调的准确率，同时将可训练参数减少至任务数量的分之一；3）计算成本降低高达85%；4）多任务增益对任务分组敏感，受任务稳定性、模型架构、任务互补性、不对称性和数据集质量等因素影响；5）开源通用大模型在代码分析上表现欠佳，1B参数PEFT模型显著优于它们。
AI.conclusion: 单个PEFT模块可匹配甚至超越完整多任务微调，多任务PEFT在准确率上接近单任务微调，同时大幅降低存储需求和计算成本（高达85%）。任务分组对多任务增益有重要影响。开源通用大模型在代码分析任务上表现不佳，即使1B参数模型配合多任务PEFT也能显著超越这些模型。

title: Categorical Calculus and Algebra for Multi-Model Data
comment: In Proceedings ACT 2025, arXiv:2603.07595. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2504.09515
summary: Multi-model databases are designed to store, manage, and query data in various models, such as relational, hierarchical, and graph data, simultaneously.  In this paper, we provide a theoretical basis for querying categorical databases. We propose two formal query languages: categorical calculus and categorical algebra, by extending relational calculus and relational algebra respectively. We demonstrate the equivalence between these two languages of queries. We propose a series of transformation rules of categorical algebra to facilitate query optimization. Finally, we analyze the expressive power and computation complexity for the proposed query languages.

AI.tldr: 本文为多模型数据库的查询处理提供了理论基础，提出了两种形式化查询语言：范畴演算和范畴代数，分别扩展自关系演算和关系代数，并证明了这两类查询语言的等价性，同时给出了查询优化的转换规则，最后分析了表达力和计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 多模型数据库能够同时存储、管理和查询关系型、层次型和图数据等多种数据模型，然而缺乏针对这类数据库的形式化查询理论基础。该研究旨在填补这一理论空白，为多模型数据库建立统一的查询形式化框架。
AI.method: 通过将关系演算和关系代数分别扩展为范畴演算和范畴代数，构建适用于多模型数据库的形式化查询语言体系。利用范畴论的方法论框架来统一处理不同数据模型的查询操作。
AI.result: 证明了范畴演算与范畴代数两种查询语言在表达能力上的等价性；提出了一系列范畴代数的转换规则用于查询优化；分析了所提查询语言的表达力和计算复杂度特征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多模型数据库查询提供了坚实的理论基础，形式化了查询语言框架，证明了语言等价性，并提供了优化手段，对多模型数据库的理论与实践发展具有重要指导意义。

title: Agentic Control Center for Data Product Optimization
summary: Data products enable end users to gain greater insights about their data by providing supporting assets, such as example question-SQL pairs which can be answered using the data or views over the database tables. However, producing useful data products is challenging, and typically requires domain experts to hand-craft supporting assets. We propose a system that automates data product improvement through specialized AI agents operating in a continuous optimization loop. By surfacing questions, monitoring multi-dimensional quality metrics, and supporting human-in-the-loop controls, it transforms data into observable and refinable assets that balance automation with trust and oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文（ICDM 2025 Demo Track，Georgia Tech 与 IBM Research 合作）提出"数据产品优化的智能体控制中心"（Agentic Control Center）：由一组专门化 LLM 智能体在持续优化闭环中自动改进数据产品（如示例 question-SQL 对、数据库视图），并以用户自定义的质量契约/多维指标驱动，同时提供人类在环的干预与审计机制。
AI.motivation: 数据产品（data product）作为可复用的数据资产包，能让终端用户更深入地理解数据，但其构建依赖领域专家手工设计视图、编写示例问题与 SQL，成本高、速度慢、难以扩展。虽然近期已有 text-to-SQL（如 RAISE、MAC-SQL）、自主洞察生成（Data-to-Dashboard、QUIS）、数据库内嵌智能工作流（NeurDB）等智能体化工作，但数据产品的质量评估主观且非平凡，LLM 的黑箱执行带来可观测性、可控性与信任问题；现有工作也缺乏覆盖全数据生命周期的、契约感知的持续优化机制。因此需要可见的智能体行为、可量化的质量契约与人类干预能力。
AI.method: 系统为两层架构：前端连接数据源并设定质量目标（契约）；后端包含 State Manager（维护数据产品状态：表/列元数据、问题映射、查询版本、答案版本与置信度、视图定义）与 Agentic 编排层（工作流迭代执行 plan→parameterize→execute→update→measure）。四大核心组件为 State Manager、Data Product Quality Metrics 模块、Tool Registry 与 Agentic Orchestration Layer。质量指标可通过动态定义机制注册（表/列覆盖率、查询长度与复杂度、执行速度、回答准确度等），并维护指标依赖图，由上下文生成器在状态变更时做事件驱动的分层粒度重算。工具注册表以名称/描述/输入参数/输出模式/执行上下文描述工具（如问题生成、追问生成、SQL 生成、视图创建、主题聚类），并与指标建立关联（Fig.3a）。编排层包含：Planner Agent（依据工具前置条件图比较实际值与目标，输出含工具名、目标上下文、预期改进幅度与理由的 JSON，选择最高影响动作）、Input Planner Agent（基于 schema 特征、历史输出与契约缺口自适应调节生成规模，如欠覆盖表>50 时生成约 80 个问题、仅少数表待处理时约 20 个，并相应调整视图数量）、五个专门化智能体（Question Generation 基于 QUIS、Text-to-SQL、Follow-up Question Generation、Question Clustering、View Creation）、后处理将异构产物归并入统一 DataProductState，并将 SQL 与视图提交到 Git 仓库实现版本控制与审计。
AI.result: 在 BIRD 基准的三个代表性数据库上开展案例研究，质量目标设为 90% 表覆盖率、50% 列覆盖率、平均查询执行时间 <5 秒。系统表现出随库特征差异化的优化策略：小库快速收敛，几轮迭代即满足契约；复杂库触发自适应参数合成，自动提高问题生成数量并选择多阶段问题生成工具，产出多级子查询与连接等更复杂 SQL；Input Planner 日志显示其优先针对大规模未被覆盖的表以最大化覆盖增益，并在大量小表场景下自动转向挖掘复杂 join 关系而非简单查找；当覆盖目标达成后，问题聚类工具将数百个问题归组为连贯主题，为用户提供可回答问题类型的高层概览；Git 工作流对每次自主决策、生成产物与人工修改全部版本化，提供完整可审计性与受控修改。Planner 还能识别收益递减并适时建议转人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 该原型展示了以透明动态界面和指标驱动的 LLM 智能体系统实现数据产品持续自主优化的可行性，兼顾自动化与信任、监管。论文指出这只是迈向完整数据优化框架的第一步，后续需扩展更多质量指标与数据工具、构建更可扩展且交互性更强的界面，并支持复杂的多目标优化问题求解。

title: Explainable LLM Unlearning Through Reasoning
summary: LLM unlearning is essential for mitigating safety, copyright, and privacy concerns in pre-trained large language models (LLMs). Compared to preference alignment, it offers a more explicit way by removing undesirable knowledge characterized by specific unlearning datasets. In previous works, gradient ascent (GA) and its variants have shown promise for implementing unlearning, yet their untargeted nature results in unintended degradation of general capabilities, incomplete removal of knowledge, and the generation of incoherent responses, among many others. We argue that these issues stem from the absence of explicit guidance on what and how models should unlearn. To fill this gap, we introduce a novel unlearning target, reasoning-based unlearning target, which satisfies both the specified unlearning scope and the specified post-unlearning response. Building on this, we propose targeted reasoning unlearning (TRU), which leverages reasoning-based unlearning target as guidance. We employ the target using a cross-entropy supervised loss combined with a GA-based loss, enabling the model to learn reasoning ability for precise knowledge removal while preserving unrelated abilities. We evaluate TRU against strong baselines across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones, and find that it achieves more reliable unlearning while preserving general capabilities. Moreover, TRU exhibits superior robustness under diverse attack scenarios, stemming from the reasoning ability learned through reasoning-based targets. Overall, our study establishes reasoning-augmented unlearning as a practical paradigm for reliable and explainable LLM unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大模型"遗忘"过程中普遍存在的"失控"问题（遗忘范围不清、遗忘后输出退化），提出"基于推理的遗忘目标"（reasoning-based unlearning target），并据此设计 TRU（Targeted Reasoning Unlearning）方法：以交叉熵监督损失学习"推理链+连贯拒答"，再叠加梯度上升类损失彻底擦除记忆。TRU 在 WMDP、MUSE、TOFU 三个基准上显著优于 GA/GradDiff/PO/NPO/WGA/RMU 等基线，遗忘质量与通用能力保持同时达到最优，并在跨语言、越狱、重学习攻击下表现出更强鲁棒性，同时可解释、可控制遗忘边界。
AI.motivation: LLM 因记忆隐私、版权与危险知识而需"机器遗忘"。现有 GA 及其变体（GradDiff、KL、PO、NPO、WGA、RMU）均属"无目标（untargeted）"优化：它们只压制遗忘数据集的似然，既没有显式界定"该忘掉哪些知识"（specified scope），也没有规定"忘掉之后应该怎么回答"（specified response），导致三类系统性问题：①遗忘范围失控——遗忘实例但保留同一知识的其他表述（如换语言仍能复现），或连无关知识一并抹除；②遗忘后输出崩溃——生成重复符号、无意义文本而非有意义的拒绝；③后续行为不可预测。作者认为根源在于缺少对"遗忘什么、如何遗忘"的显式引导，而手动构造大规模连贯拒答与范围标注代价过高，因此需要可自动生成、同时携带范围与响应规格的"遗忘目标"。此外，作者还指出既有评测（WMDP 式选项准确率）存在答案位置重排的不稳定性，需要更贴近实际使用的统一评测框架。
AI.method: 1) 概念层面：提出"遗忘范围"的形式化定义——任务 T 下的等价类 [x]_T（Scope Unlearning 问题），并要求遗忘目标同时满足 specified scope 与 specified response 两个准则。2) 遗忘目标构造：以 Deepseek-reasoner API 按任务类型模板自动生成三元组 (x_u, r_rt, s_rt)（数据点、推理链、拒答响应），训练时用 <think>/<answer> 标签包裹，非推理型基座（Zephyr/Llama）需扩充 tokenizer 词表。3) 训练目标：min L_target + α·L_GA-based，其中 L_target 为对推理链与响应的交叉熵监督损失，L_GA-based 默认取 GradDiff，α=0.1（敏感性分析显示 UQ 随 α 增大而降、RQ 升）。4) 评测：提出 LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) 统一框架，从 Unlearning Quality（Relevance/Rejection/Helpfulness）与 Retention Quality（Readability/Specificity/Logic）六维 0–10 打分；并做消融（去推理、去 L_target、去准则、去 GA 项）、超参敏感性、三类攻击（跨语言/越狱/重学习）与范围可控性实验；还通过更换目标生成模型与评审模型验证非循环性。
AI.result: 主实验：TRU 在 WMDP-Bio/Cyber、MUSE-Books/News、TOFU-Forget01/05/10 上一致取得最高 UQ（普遍 >6.0，基线多为 0–4），同时 RQ 仅相对基座轻微下降（WMDP-Bio 约 3.9%），而 GA/GradDiff/KL 出现 RQ 塌陷至 0、RMU 则 RQ 高但遗忘不足、PO 只会输出无信息的"我不知道"。消融：去掉推理链会显著降低 RQ（WMDP 特异性 2.56→0.15）并导致过度遗忘；去掉 L_target 则 UQ/RQ 双双趋近 0；去掉准则或 GA 项亦同时削弱两者。鲁棒性：跨语言（西语/俄语）UQ 仅下降 0.24/0.47，越狱提示下仅降 0.33/0.65，重学习（15样本1轮、5样本3轮）后 UQ 由 7.01 降至 6.56/6.62。范围可控性：在 TOFU 上把范围从 author profile 扩到 personal information 会使特异性从 4.23 降至 2.31 并出现误拒（如拒答 iPhone 发布年份），说明模型确实在做范围判断而非表面拒答。通用能力：TOFU-Forget05 上 GSM8K 得分 0.423，接近 RMU 的 0.471 且远高于 GA/GradDiff。评审稳健性：更换目标生成模型（Deepseek/Kimi-K2-Thinking/Qwen3-plus）性能方差 <20%，更换评审模型偏差 <0.5。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统性地把"遗忘目标（unlearning target）"作为 LLM 遗忘的核心研究对象，提出推理式遗忘目标与 TRU 框架，将 GA 类方法的彻底擦除能力与目标类方法的可控可解释行为结合起来，确立"推理增强的遗忘"作为可靠、可解释 LLM 遗忘的实用范式。局限与展望：依赖外部强推理模型生成目标（成本与代理偏差需管控）、α 等超参敏感、评测以 LLM 评审为主；未来可拓展到持续/在线遗忘、与 DPO 等对齐方法的结合，以及面向更多骨干与更细粒度范围的实证研究。

title: Aceso: Carbon-Aware and Cost-Effective Microservice Placement for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises
summary: Microservices are a dominant architecture in cloud computing, offering scalability and modularity, but also posing complex deployment challenges. As data centers contribute significantly to global carbon emissions, carbon-aware scheduling has emerged as a promising mitigation strategy. However, most existing solutions target batch, high-performance, or serverless workloads and assume access to global-scale infrastructure. Such an assumption does not hold for many national or regional small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with microservice applications, which represent the real-world majority. In this paper, we present Aceso, an Adaptive Carbon- and Efficiency-aware placement for microservices that considers carbon, cost, and latency constraints. Aceso dynamically places microservices across geographically constrained regions using a scalable optimization strategy that leverages insight-based search space pruning techniques. Evaluation on a real-world deployment shows that Aceso quickly adapts to real-time changes in workload and carbon intensity and reduces carbon emissions by 37.4% and operational cost by 3.6%, on average, compared to a static deployment within a single country, while consistently meeting SLOs. In this way, Aceso enables carbon- and cost-aware microservice deployment for latency-sensitive applications in regionally limited infrastructures for SMEs.

AI.tldr: Aceso 是一个面向中小型企业（SME）的自适应碳感知与成本感知微服务放置系统：在地域受限（如仅欧盟/单国）的基础设施上，联合优化碳排放、运营成本与延迟 SLO。系统由流量预测器（GBDT，1 小时预测视界）、工作负载画像器（按流量分桶的哈希表）、基于可扩展遗传算法的放置优化器（含微服务钉扎与区域过滤的启发式搜索空间剪枝）以及调度器组成，事件驱动地响应碳强度与负载变化。真实 AWS 部署显示：相比单一区域静态部署，碳排放最多降低 37.4%、运营成本最多降低 3.36%（Frankfurt 为 -3.36%、香港为 -2.83%、卡尔加里 +0.22%），端到端延迟满足 300ms SLO（SLO 违约率仅 0.1%–0.26%）；优化求解时间 25.8 秒，比 Caribou（12.3 分钟）、GA（1.4 分钟）与 LP（4.41 小时）快数个数量级；1000 个微服务 + 全球区域时仍在 2.2 分钟内收敛。
AI.motivation: 数据中心与云基础设施能耗持续上升，碳感知调度成为关键缓解手段，但现有方案存在三重不适用性：(1) 目标工作负载多为批处理/HPC/无服务器（如 Meta 的 Carbon Explorer、GAIA、Caribou、Ecolife），依赖可延迟执行或无状态可迁移特性；(2) 隐含假设可访问全球规模基础设施，跨洲/跨时区自由迁移，而地域受限、预算有限、服务本地/区域用户的 SME（如西班牙本地打车类应用）无法做到，数据主权（GDPR）与本地监管进一步限制迁移；(3) 普遍忽视成本维度，或忽视延迟敏感型微服务（Oakestra、Astraea、Nautilus、Imbres 等只关注性能与资源效率，不考虑碳）。此外，延迟敏感微服务难以使用时间迁移（temporal shifting），只能做空间迁移（spatial shifting），而空间迁移带来的跨区延迟会与 SLO 冲突，构成碳—成本—延迟的三角权衡。论文由此提出核心问题：在地域受限基础设施内，SME 如何在保持性能（SLO）的前提下实现低碳、低成本的微服务部署？
AI.method: 1) 动机实验与洞见（真实部署，DeathStarBench 的 Social Network、Media Streaming、Hotel Reservation，AWS 西班牙→瑞典）：对比 Single MS / Subgraph / Layer 三类静态迁移配置，测量归一化碳、成本与延迟。发现 (a) 前端与数据库必须留在基准区域（延迟与数据主权）；(b) 迁移执行路径中「较早激活」的服务可将新增地理延迟摊薄到后续请求处理上，延迟更低；迁移越晚的服务越在末端产生跨区通信，延迟惩罚越大；(c) 全量迁移可降碳 43%–66%、省成本约 3%，但延迟增至 2–3 倍；最佳折中是迁移早激活子图（碳降 21%/17%/28%，成本降 1.8%/1.4%/1.9%，延迟 111/208/107ms，SLO 违约 1.67%/0.33%/0.02%）。同时发现全球云区域碳强度存在昼夜模式，且低碳区域并不必然更贵（Stockholm 在欧盟中最便宜），为成本可行性提供依据。2) 系统设计：Aceso 含四组件——Traffic Forecaster（sidecar，5 分钟粒度、1 小时视界，GBDT，小时级推理，低负载期周期性重训）、Workload Profiler（中心化 Pod，采集 CPU/内存/网络/延迟/能耗，按等频流量分桶 K≤10（每桶≥100 样本）建哈希表，桶内用 μ+σ 保守取值，保留一周、上限 2000 样本）、Placement Optimizer（控制面 Python 遗传算法，最小化 w_CO2·Σ CI_r(m)E_m + w_$·(计算+存储+跨区流量成本)，约束 Latency(r)≤SLO）、Scheduler（Kubernetes + Liqo 多区域编排 + VPA，ECR 预复制镜像、EKS/EC2 部署，就绪探测后切流再下线旧实例）。剪枝策略：微服务钉扎（前端、数据库结构钉扎；按激活顺序排序，基准区域延迟达 SLO 的 80–90% 时开始钉扎晚激活服务）与区域过滤（Pareto 式规则，双目标时用保守支配规则，仅在碳或成本单项改善时保留）。事件触发：碳驱动（CarbonCast 预测偏离近期趋势 >20%）与负载驱动（预测负载落入新流量桶）。GA 时间复杂度 O(M²)、空间 O(R²+M²)，剪枝后以 M′、R′ 降低常数（示例约 44%）。3) 实现：Prometheus + scikit-learn/NeuralForecast（预测）、Kepler/Node Exporter（能耗）、Electricity Maps API（碳强度）、AWS Pricing Calculator（价格）、AWS Latency Monitoring API（RTT）。4) 评估：真实 AWS 跨洲部署（Frankfurt/Calgary/Hong Kong，4 天，Poisson 请求，Azure Functions 生产轨迹缩放）+ 自研仿真器（支持并行/串行路径、基于服务类型的能耗/延迟模型、真实区域延迟/碳/价格；与真实实验误差：碳 1%/1.17%，成本 0.46%/2.1%，延迟 35ms/41ms）；基线为 Nautilus（单区域静态）、Caribou（serverless 碳感知）、线性规划 LP（线性化松弛 oracle）、Vanilla GA；并做可扩展性、消融（去过滤/去钉扎/全去）、预测模型对比（Linear/RF/GBDT/Prophet/N-HiTS/PatchTST）、权重敏感性与地理泛化分析。
AI.result: 真实部署（Figure 7）：72 小时内平均碳减排——法兰克福（EU）37.4%、卡尔加里（NA）21.2%、香港（Asia）23.2%；EU 更高源于邻近低碳区域（Stockholm、Paris）。延迟：EU 94ms/0.2% 违约，NA 40ms/0.1%，亚洲 Media Streaming 143ms/0.26%（SLO 300ms）。成本（Table 1，月均）：Frankfurt 201.6$→194.4$（-3.36%），Calgary 187.2$→187.2$（+0.22%，因存储与跨区流量换取大额碳减排），Hong Kong 439.2$→424.8$（-2.83%）。每日触发 6–7 次放置变更，EU 单次迁移约 42% 微服务，NA 约 12%；亚洲场景 77% 服务必须留在香港。基线对比（100 服务、EU、仿真）：碳归一化 Aceso 0.48×，优于 Caribou 0.49×、GA 0.63×，LP 最优 0.37×；成本 Aceso 0.984×（Caribou 0.971×、LP 0.959×、GA 0.996×）；延迟 Aceso 1.33s 优于 Caribou 1.55s 与 GA 1.61s，LP 1.28s，Nautilus 0.34s；求解时间 Aceso 25.8s，Caribou 12.3min、GA 1.4min、LP 4.41h（加剪枝后 LP 仍 >30min）。适应性：Aceso/GA/LP 对 41 次触发 100% 响应，平均迁移 52.2% 微服务（GA 68.3%、Caribou 80%、LP 仅 3%），在响应性与稳定性间取得平衡；区域分布上剪除 Ireland/Milan，优先 Paris 39.9%、Stockholm 23.9%。消融：去掉区域过滤与钉扎会使搜索空间增大近两个数量级；预测器消融虽在碳/成本/延迟上差异 ≤±1%，但触发数从 27 升至 113、放置变更从 6–7 次/天增至 28–29 次/天（约 4 倍），稳定性显著下降；模型对比中 GBDT 的 MAE 最低且推理为亚毫秒级，Prophet 漏掉短时波动，N-HiTS/PatchTST 因需长历史且面向长视界而表现较差。可扩展性：1000 服务 + 全球区域时 <2.2 分钟收敛；SLO 越严格剪枝越多，100 服务时更快，1000 服务时基本不受影响。敏感性：EU 场景对 w_CO2/w_$ 不敏感（41.1% 碳降、2.2% 成本降），亚洲更敏感（碳 4.8%–9.5%、成本 2.3%–5%）。地理泛化：EU 收益最高（Frankfurt 最高 38.5% 碳降、Zurich 最高 6.8% 成本降）；全球范围平均碳降 12.1%、成本降 1.5%；基线碳强度高的区域绝对收益可观（泰国 8.5% 对应 40.8 gCO2e/kWh，伦敦 31.2% 对应 49.3 gCO2e/kWh）；瑞典、N. Virginia、Ohio、Oregon 因本身已最优而不发生地理分布。
AI.conclusion: Aceso 证明在地域受限（国家级/区域级）公有云环境中，面向延迟敏感的微服务应用同时实现碳减排、成本控制与 SLO 合规是可行的：其核心机制是可扩展遗传算法 + 基于洞见的搜索空间剪枝（优先卸载执行路径中早激活的服务、基于 Pareto 的区域过滤），在数秒到数分钟内给出近 LP 最优的解，碳排放最多降 37.4%（全球平均 12.1%）、成本最多降 3.36%（平均 1.5%），同时保持 0.1%–0.26% 的极低 SLO 违约率，且迁移量可控、系统稳定。论文同时指出局限：依赖实时碳强度与价格信号（可能陈旧/延迟）、仅在 AWS 上评估而跨云厂商或混合基础设施存在区域可用性、区域间延迟、流量计费与区域监管差异等新挑战。未来工作包括接入现货价格进一步降本、引入分层 SLO 以支持差异化服务等级、以及提供实时监控与交互式配置仪表盘以提升 SME 可用性；系统与仿真器均已开源以便复现与社区采用。

title: KernelSkill: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization
summary: Improving GPU kernel efficiency is crucial for advancing AI systems. Recent work has explored leveraging large language models (LLMs) for GPU kernel generation and optimization. However, existing LLM-based kernel optimization pipelines typically rely on opaque, implicitly learned heuristics within the LLMs to determine optimization strategies. This leads to inefficient trial-and-error and weakly interpretable optimizations. Our key insight is to replace implicit heuristics with expert optimization skills that are knowledge-driven and aware of task trajectories. Specifically, we present KernelSkill, a multi-agent framework with a dual-level memory architecture. KernelSkill operates by coordinating agents with long-term memory of reusable expert skills and short-term memory to prevent repetitive backtracking. On KernelBench Levels 1-3, KernelSkill achieves a 100% success rate and average speedups of 5.44x, 2.82x, and 1.92x over Torch Eager on Levels 1, 2, and 3, respectively, outperforming prior baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/0satan0/KernelMem/.

AI.tldr: KernelSkill是一个基于多智能体架构的GPU内核优化框架，通过双层记忆机制（长期记忆+短期记忆）替代传统LLM中隐式的启发式优化策略，实现可解释的知识驱动优化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的GPU内核优化管道依赖LLM内部隐式学习的启发式方法来确定优化策略，导致低效的试错过程和弱可解释性的优化结果。
AI.method: 提出KernelSkill多智能体框架，具有双层记忆架构：长期记忆存储可重用的专家技能，短期记忆防止重复回溯。框架通过协调具有长期记忆的智能体和具有短期记忆的智能体来执行优化任务。
AI.result: 在KernelBench Levels 1-3上达到100%成功率，Level 1平均加速5.44倍，Level 2平均加速2.82倍，Level 3平均加速1.92倍（相比Torch Eager）。
AI.conclusion: KernelSkill通过引入知识驱动的专家技能和任务轨迹感知机制，有效替代了隐式启发式方法，显著提升了GPU内核优化的效率和可解释性，在三个难度级别上均优于现有基线方法。

title: Safety Under Scaffolding: How Evaluation Conditions Shape Measured Safety
comment: 74 pages including appendices. 6 frontier models, 62,808 primary observations (~89k total). Pre-registered: OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/CJW92. Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/safety-under-scaffolding
summary: Safety benchmarks evaluate language models in isolation, typically using multiple-choice format; production deployments wrap these models in agentic scaffolds that restructure inputs through reasoning traces, critic agents, and delegation pipelines. We report one of the largest controlled studies of scaffold effects on safety (N = 62,808; six frontier models, four deployment configurations), combining pre-registration, assessor blinding, equivalence testing, and specification curve analysis. Map-reduce scaffolding degrades measured safety (NNH = 14), yet two of three scaffold architectures preserve safety within practically meaningful margins. Investigating the map-reduce degradation revealed a deeper measurement problem: switching from multiple-choice to open-ended format on identical items shifts safety scores by 5-20 percentage points, larger than any scaffold effect. Within-format scaffold comparisons are consistent with practical equivalence under our pre-registered +/-2 pp TOST margin, isolating evaluation format rather than scaffold architecture as the operative variable. Model x scaffold interactions span 35 pp in opposing directions (one model degrades by -16.8 pp on sycophancy under map-reduce while another improves by +18.8 pp on the same benchmark), ruling out universal claims about scaffold safety. A generalisability analysis yields G = 0.000: model safety rankings reverse so completely across benchmarks that no composite safety index achieves non-zero reliability, making per-model, per-configuration testing a necessary minimum standard. We release all code, data, and prompts as ScaffoldSafety.

AI.tldr: 本文是目前规模最大的关于「代理脚手架（scaffold）如何影响安全基准测量结果」的对照研究之一（主分析 N=60,112，收集 62,808 条记录），结论是：真正主导「测得的安全分数」的不是脚手架架构，而是评测格式与基准选择。Map-reduce 委托式脚手架使合并安全率下降 7.3 个百分点（NNH=14），而 ReAct 与多智能体 critic 在预注册的 ±2 pp 等价边界内与直接调用等价；但在完全相同的题目上，把多选题（MC）改为开放式（OE）就会使测得安全分数变动 5–20 pp，方向还随基准而反转（BBQ +4.8 pp、谄媚 +19.6 pp、TruthfulQA +5.7 pp、MMLU 能力对照 −9.2 pp）。模型×脚手架交互幅度可达 35.6 pp 且方向相反（Opus 4.6 在 map-reduce 下谄媚抗性 −16.8 pp，Llama 4 +18.8 pp），因此不存在「脚手架普遍提升/降低安全」的结论。方差分解显示基准解释 15.1% 的方差，脚手架仅 0.5%（约 1/33）；泛化系数 G=0.251（95% CI [0.000, 0.879]），无法支撑单一综合安全指数用于部署 go/no-go 决策。作者主张：必须按「模型 × 部署配置 × 基准 × 格式」逐项测试，并提出 ScaffoldSafety 记分卡（安全率矩阵 + NNH + 方法学戳）。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准（BBQ、TruthfulQA、XSTest/OR-Bench、谄媚等）几乎全部以「裸模型 + 多选题」的方式测试；但真实部署把模型包进 agentic scaffold（ReAct 推理链、critic 评审、map-reduce 委托分解），会改变模型所见输入的格式与内容，存在两个缺口：(1) 架构缺口——文献、模型卡、第三方评测普遍只测直接 API 调用，而脚手架架构本身可能是一阶安全变量；(2) 表征缺口——多数安全基准是 MC，而 agentic 部署以自然语言 OE 交互，已有文献在能力评测中已证实 MC 的位置偏置、选项顺序偏置与 MC→OE 约 25 pp 的落差，但安全评测中"格式 × 脚手架"的交互基本未被研究。作者的核心问题不是"脚手架是否降低安全"，而是"脚手架是否改变了安全基准所测量的东西"。同时，AI 安全评测缺乏预注册、盲评、等价性检验等临床试验/心理学的方法论规范，存在严重的分析自由度与"不可判定性"问题。
AI.method: 设计：全因子 6 模型 × 4 部署配置 × 4 安全基准，共 2,617×6×4=62,808 条主推断记录（分析 60,112 条）。模型：Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro、Llama 4 Maverick、DeepSeek V3.2、Mistral Large 2（2026 年 2 月 API 版本，跨 6 家供应商）。配置：直接 API、ReAct（≤5 轮、本地三工具）、多智能体 critic（一次可修订）、map-reduce（分解→子问题→归并，子调用丢失 MC 选项）。基准：BBQ(800)、TruthfulQA MC1(817)、XSTest+OR-Bench(500，LLM 裁判)、谄媚(500)，外加 AI 事实回忆(12,000)作为非安全阴性对照。补充研究：选项保留版 map-reduce（200 例，测 40–91% 损失可恢复）；格式依赖实验（5 模型 × 5 基准 × MC/OE × 直接/全题聚合，4,400 条）；Phase 2 机制实验（14,400 条，4 档"语义调用强度"）；CoT 对照（200 条）；生产框架小样本比较（CrewAI/LangChain/Agents SDK，N=50）。方法论：OSF 预注册（DOI CJW92、WA9Y7）、单盲+回答净化（80.7% 确定性抽取、19.3% LLM 裁判，主裁 Gemini 3 Flash，Opus 4.6 复核 3,975 行）、case-cluster 稳健逻辑回归（替代预注册 GLMM，记为偏离 D-006）、Holm-Bonferroni、TOST 等价性检验（±2 pp）、规格曲线（主曲线 18 个规格全显著，探索曲线 384 个）、方差分解（η²/ω²）与 G 理论泛化分析、Gemini/OpenRouter 输出上限导致的解析失败作为 ITT/PP 敏感性来源。
AI.result: 1) 主效应：map-reduce 合并 RD=−7.3 pp（95% CI [−8.1,−6.4]；OR 0.64；NNH=14，逐基准 NNH 5–12）；ReAct RD=−0.8 pp、multi-agent RD=−0.8 pp，虽统计显著（Holm p=0.017）但 TOST 等价于 ±2 pp。omnibus Wald χ²=262.3 (df=3, p<10⁻⁵⁵)。2) 格式效应大于脚手架效应：MC→OE 使谄媚 +19.6 pp、TruthfulQA +5.7 pp、BBQ +4.8 pp，AI 事实回忆 −1.0 pp（不显著），MMLU 能力对照 −9.2 pp；同一批题上，全题聚合型脚手架几乎不改结果（MC 两臂均 772/1100，OE 843 vs 837）。3) 交互：模型×配置 χ²=493.2 (p<10⁻⁹⁴)，配置×基准 χ²=938.0 (p<10⁻¹⁹⁵)；map-reduce 在谄媚上使 Opus −16.8 pp、Llama 4 +18.8 pp（跨度 35.6 pp），并可改变模型排名（谄媚上 GPT-5.2 在 MC 最高、Opus 在 OE 最高）；BBQ 上 DeepSeek 有偏选项从 2.7% 升至 28.9%（10.5 倍），TruthfulQA 个别模型下降最多 38 pp，而 XSTest 上 map-reduce 反而改善。4) 机制：map-reduce 的选项标记只出现在 0/150、3/148、5/125 的 worker 输入中（reducer 仍有完整选项）；恢复选项可挽回 Opus/DeepSeek/Mistral/GPT-5.2 损失的 40–91%，但 Llama 4 为 0%；CoT 对照（−0.4 至 +5.5 pp）远小于 map-reduce（−5.5 至 −30 pp），说明效应来自分解/信息丢失而非推理链长度；Phase 2 显示"激进的偏见调用"在 6 模型上均降低 BBQ（−2.3 至 −22.0 pp）而"激进的误解调用"均提高 TruthfulQA（+0.4 至 +18.7 pp），即提示内容而非链长驱动效应。5) 评分方法敏感：用关键词式拒答分类器替代 LLM 裁判，会创建、颠倒或夸大 5 项探索性发现中的 4 项（裁判与启发式 κ=0.35）。6) 可靠性：基准解释 15.1% 方差，脚手架仅 0.5%（约 33×），配置×基准 1.5%，模型×基准 1.9%；G=0.251（95% CI [0.000, 0.879]），敏感性分析区间均含 0，D-study 外推到 8 脚手架×12 基准仅 G=0.51，故不支持使用单一综合安全指数。7) 测量完整性：作者自查发现两个实现 bug（正则 \b([A-Z])\b 误匹配 "I"，造成虚假 48 pp 差距；数据加载器未拼入 MC 选项，使 "unknown" 率为 0%），说明测量伪影可产生"方向上极具说服力"的错误结论。8) 局限与偏差控制：Opus 既是流水线构建者又是被测模型（排除 Opus 后 map-reduce 仍为 −5.6 pp，p<10⁻²⁵，但 ReAct/multi-agent 不再显著）；OE 用 LLM 裁判而 MC 用确定性抽取，格式与评分方法混淆未彻底分离；未做难度匹配的跨基准校准；未测试 scheming/欺骗对齐/CBRN 等后果性属性；仅 220 项配对格式实验，sycophancy 项每模型仅 70 题。注：摘要写 G=0.000，正文为 G=0.251 [0.000, 0.879]，以正文为准。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论有三层：(1) 测量层面——脚手架对合并安全分数的平均效应很小（η²=0.5%），格式（MC vs OE）造成的差异（5–20 pp）大于任何脚手架效应，且方向不可从单一格式预测；「脚手架是否降低安全」是错误提问，正确问题是「脚手架改变了安全基准所测量的对象吗」。(2) 实践层面——不存在通用安全结论：模型×脚手架交互可达 35.6 pp 且符号相反，基准×模型交互使模型排名在基准间反转，因此按模型×配置×基准×格式逐项测试是必要最低标准；map-reduce 部署应按 NNH=14 报告运营风险，且委托时须保留 MC 选项并做传播审计。(3) 政策层面——提出三条强制要求：成对格式评测（MC+OE 必报）、对 agentic 部署强制做「结构破坏型」脚手架测试、审计安全关键指令向终端子调用的传播率；建议以 ScaffoldSafety 记分卡（安全率矩阵、NNH、方法学戳）替代单一综合安全分，理由是 G 的置信区间宽到无法为聚合提供依据。作者同时警告：这些基准均为代理安全属性，连代理属性都对格式敏感，则当前 scheming/alignment-faking 等对齐评测（其默认假设格式不变）同样可能依赖格式，风险未被排除。整体上这是一篇把临床试验方法学（预注册、盲评、等价性检验、规格曲线）引入 AI 安全评测的高严谨度方法学论文，结论偏向「当前安全测量工具本身不可靠，须改造评测基建」，而非给出具体模型风险排序。

title: K-Join: Combining Vertex Covers for Parallel Joins
summary: Significant research effort has been devoted to improving the performance of join processing in the massively parallel computation model, where the goal is to evaluate a query with the minimum possible data transfer between machines. However, it is still an open question to determine the best possible parallel algorithm for any join query. In this paper, we present an algorithm that takes a step forward in this endeavour. Our new algorithm is simple and builds on two existing ideas: data partitioning and the HyperCube primitive. The novelty in our approach comes from a careful choice of the HyperCube shares, which is done as a linear combination of multiple vertex covers. The resulting load with input size $n$ and $p$ processors is characterized as $n/p^{1/κ}$, where $κ$ is a new hypergraph theoretic measure we call the reduced quasi vertex-cover. The new measure matches or improves on all state-of-the-art algorithms and exhibits strong similarities to the edge quasi-packing that describes the worst-case optimal load in one-round algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模并行计算(MPC)模型中连接查询的并行算法设计，旨在最小化机器间的数据传输。提出了一种结合数据分区和Hypercube原语的新算法，通过将Hypercube份额表示为多个顶点覆盖的线性组合来实现创新。算法负载为n/p^(1/κ)，其中κ是引入的新概念——约化拟顶点覆盖数。
AI.motivation: 在大规模并行计算模型中，如何以最小的机器间数据传输量评估连接查询仍是开放问题。现有研究虽已投入大量努力改进连接处理性能，但确定任何连接查询的最佳并行算法仍是未解难题。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的新算法，融合两个现有 ideas：数据分区(data partitioning)和Hypercube原语。创新点在于Hypercube份额的选择——将份额表示为多个顶点覆盖的线性组合。
AI.result: 算法负载随输入规模n和处理器数p表示为n/p^(1/κ)，其中κ是新的超图理论度量，称为约化拟顶点覆盖(reduced quasi vertex-cover)。该度量与边拟打包(edge quasi-packing)具有强相似性，后者描述了单轮算法中最坏情况下的最优负载。
AI.conclusion: 新度量约化拟顶点覆盖匹配或改进了所有当前最优算法，表明该方法在连接查询的并行处理方面取得了显著进展，为确定最佳并行算法提供了新的理论框架。

title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents
summary: The remarkable progress of vision-language models (VLMs) has enabled GUI agents to interact with computers in a human-like manner. Yet real-world computer-use tasks remain difficult due to long-horizon workflows, diverse interfaces, and frequent intermediate errors. Prior work equips agents with external memory built from large collections of trajectories, but relies on flat retrieval over discrete summaries or continuous embeddings, falling short of the structured organization and self-evolving characteristics of human memory. Inspired by the brain, we propose Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory (HyMEM), a graph-based memory that couples discrete high-level symbolic nodes with continuous trajectory embeddings. HyMEM maintains a graph structure to support multi-hop retrieval, self-evolution via node update operations, and on-the-fly working-memory refreshing during inference. Extensive experiments show that HyMEM consistently improves open-source GUI agents, enabling 7B/8B backbones to match or surpass strong closed-source models; notably, it boosts Qwen2.5-VL-7B by +22.5% and outperforms Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision and GPT-4o.

AI.tldr: HyMEM（Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory）是一种面向 GUI 智能体的图结构外部记忆：把「高层策略符号节点」与「连续轨迹嵌入」混合组织在同一张可自演化图记忆中，支持多跳检索、节点 ADD/MERGE/REPLACE 更新与推理期工作记忆实时刷新。在 WebVoyager、Multimodal-Mind2Web、MMInA 上，使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 成功率从 12.5% 提升到 35.0%（+22.5%），超过 Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision（29.6%）与 GPT-4o（19.7%），并对 UI-TARS-1.5-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 均有稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 真实电脑操作任务具有长时序流程、界面高度多样、中间步骤易出错等特征，导致 GUI 智能体频繁失败。已有工作为智能体配备外部经验记忆（把历史轨迹蒸馏为离散文本摘要，或压缩为连续嵌入），但检索是扁平的相似度匹配，既缺乏类似人脑的结构化组织（无法多跳关联检索），也缺乏持续自演化（新增/合并/替换/剪枝）能力；同时人类记忆本身是「海马体连续表征 + 新皮层离散符号」的混合系统，纯离散记忆丢失细粒度视觉证据，纯连续记忆又形成信息瓶颈、难以显式推理。故作者希望构建兼具结构化组织、可自演化、可在推理中动态刷新的混合记忆。
AI.method:
**记忆结构**：维护图 G=(V,E)，节点为成功轨迹节点 v=(c_i, A_i, m_i)——高层策略（离散启发式，如「按价格从低到高过滤」）、中层属性标签（离散词/短语，如 #search、#filter、$price）、低层轨迹嵌入（连续表示，保留细粒度多模态证据）；共享属性的节点间连无向边，形成支持多跳联想搜索的拓扑。编码用轻量 VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B），轨迹嵌入沿用 CoMEM 将整条轨迹压缩为 8 个嵌入，可直接拼接进智能体 embedding 层读取。

**自演化构建（三阶段）**：① 相关节点检索——拼接 CLIP 文本（任务 q）与 CLIP 图像（首个观察 o1）构造语义向量，用 FAISS 余弦相似度取 top-K 邻居节点；② 冗余检查——VLM 裁判（结合文本元数据与截图）判定 ADD / MERGE / REPLACE，显式衡量新轨迹的边际信息增益；③ 结构化更新——ADD 创建新策略/属性节点并连接，MERGE 合并互补证据到既有策略，REPLACE 用更优实例替换旧证据，并依据新观测的共现关系实例化/强化边，实现图连通性演化（全局演化）。

**记忆利用**：结构化检索先用多模态查询向量做 kNN 得种子节点，再反复「1-hop 邻居扩展 + 余弦重排」t 轮，兼顾相似性与多样性；工作记忆初始化为双视图——离散 Guidance Instructions（由 VLM 消化策略/属性节点，注入 system prompt 引导高层规划）与连续轨迹嵌入（与 VLM 输入拼接，提供隐式视觉/动作证据）；推理中执行 On-the-fly 工作记忆刷新：每次动作后由 VLM 比较 o_t→o_{t+1} 与当前指导指令，检测「阶段转移」（如 search→checkout），保守区分「操作错误」与「记忆失效」，决定保留/丢弃哪些要点后重检索并刷新指导与嵌入（局部演化）。

**实验设置**：ReAct 式动作接口（CLICK/TYPE/SCROLL_PAGE 等 GUI 工具 + 语义工具），SOM 标注 + UI-INS-7B 兜底定位两阶段 grounding；记忆来源为 GUIAct、Mind2Web 训练集与自 rollout，共 2,883 条成功轨迹，主表图含 1,858 节点、逾 100 万条边；连续编码器用 Q-Former+LoRA（rank 16，共享参数）微调，仅更新 1.2% 参数，单个 H100 20 小时、1 epoch 收敛；评测用 LLM-as-Judge（WebVoyager/Mind2Web）与答案比对（MMInA）。
AI.result:
**主结果**：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 基线 12.5% → HyMEM 35.0%（+22.5%），超过 Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision 5.4%、GPT-4o 15.3%，Travel/Wikipedia 等域超过 Claude-4；UI-TARS-1.5-7B 17.1%→31.2%（对比 ReasoningBank 11.2%、AWM 8.6%）；Qwen3-VL-8B 21.9%→27.6%。文本类记忆（ReasoningBank/AWM）仅带来 +5.0%/+0.6% 的有限增益；离散（17.0%）与连续（21.7%）单独使用有效但不稳定（如 UI-TARS 连续优于离散），二者混合在各骨干上均取得最佳，说明离散符号与连续多模态表征具有互补性。

**自演化消融**：全局演化使 Amazon 48.8%→61.0%（约 +25% 相对）、Google Maps 43.9%→51.2%（约 +16.6% 相对），其中约 52% 成功轨迹触发 UPDATE 合并而非新建节点，抑制无控增长；局部演化在 Amazon 上再提升约 15%，Google Maps 上触发 39 次阶段转移检测（如从导航转入筛选）。

**规模与压缩**：记忆规模从 500→8,000 条，Amazon 19.5%→63.4%、Google Maps 31.7%→56.1%、AllRecipes 11.1%→20.0%，呈稳定收益与边际递减；图节点数随原始轨迹数亚线性增长，具备压缩特性。

**检索权衡**：|N_initial|=5（5 种子 + 5 邻居）最优（Amazon 63.4%、Coursera 54.8%、GMap 53.7%），纯相似（=10）与纯多样（=1）均明显下降。

**案例与可视化**：t-SNE 显示连续记忆按域（Amazon/Coursera/Google Maps）清晰聚类，Travel 与 Shopping 邻近；Amazon USB-C 扩展坞案例中，+HyMEM 的 7B 模型正确应用筛选并达成目标，基座模型则反复打开商品页、丢失任务状态直至超出步数。
AI.conclusion: 现有 GUI 智能体记忆受限于扁平存储与检索，缺少结构化组织与持续演化；HyMEM 将离散高层策略符号与连续轨迹嵌入统一进图式记忆，实现「种子+扩展」的多跳多样化检索、随新轨迹到来的 ADD/MERGE/REPLACE 全局自演化、以及推理期按阶段转移刷新的工作记忆局部演化，从而在三个基准上稳定提升开源 GUI 智能体，显著缩小并在部分设定下反超强闭源系统，为低成本构建 SOTA GUI 智能体提供路径。局限：更新决策仍依赖启发式式 VLM 裁判而非优化学习（可尝试 RL 学习何时/如何更新记忆）；受算力限制未在 32B/70B 等更大骨干上验证。未来方向包括更丰富的策略抽象层次、分布漂移下的更新策略、基于记忆演化的持续学习，以及大规模部署所需的安全与权限约束。

title: MoE-SpAc: Efficient MoE Inference Based on Speculative Activation Utility in Heterogeneous Edge Scenarios
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable scalable performance but face severe memory constraints on edge devices. Existing offloading strategies struggle with I/O bottlenecks due to the dynamic, low-information nature of autoregressive expert activation. In this paper, we propose to repurpose Speculative Decoding (SD) not merely as a compute accelerator, but as an informative lookahead sensor for memory management, supported by our theoretical and empirical analyses. Hence, we introduce MoE-SpAc, an MoE inference framework that integrates a Speculative Utility Estimator to track expert demand, a Heterogeneous Workload Balancer to dynamically partition computation via online integer optimization, and an Asynchronous Execution Engine to unify the prefetching and eviction in the same utility space. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that MoE-SpAc achieves a 42% improvement in TPS over the SOTA SD-based baseline, and an average 4.04x speedup over all standard baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/lshAlgorithm/MoE-SpAc .

AI.tldr: 提出MoE-SpAc框架，利用Speculative Decoding作为专家需求预测的"感知器"，通过Speculative Utility Estimator跟踪专家需求，Heterogeneous Workload Balancer进行在线整数优化动态分区计算，以及Asynchronous Execution Engine统一预取和驱逐。在7个基准测试中，TPS比SOTA SD基线提升42%，平均加速4.04倍。
AI.motivation: MoE模型在边缘设备推理时面临严重内存约束，现有卸载策略因自回归专家激活的动态、低信息特性而受I/O瓶颈困扰。
AI.method: 提出MoE-SpAc框架，三大核心组件：1) Speculative Utility Estimator用于跟踪专家需求；2) Heterogeneous Workload Balancer通过在线整数优化动态分区计算；3) Asynchronous Execution Engine统一预取和驱逐操作于同一效用空间。
AI.result: 在7个基准测试中，MoE-SpAc的TPS比SOTA SD基线提升42%，平均加速4.04倍。
AI.conclusion: 将Speculative Decoding重新定位为内存管理的"信息感知器"而非仅作为计算加速器是有效的，理论分析和实验验证均支持该方法可行。

title: Topological Analysis for Identifying Anomalies in Serverless Platforms
summary: The information flows in serverless platforms are complex and non-conservative. This is a direct result of how independently deployed functions interact under the platform coarse-grained control mechanisms. To manage this complexity, we introduce a topological model for serverless services. Using Hodge decomposition, we can separate observed operational flows into two distinct categories. They include components that can be corrected locally and harmonic modes that persist at any scale. Our analysis reveals that these harmonic flows emerge naturally from different types of inter-function interactions. They should be understood as structural properties of serverless systems, not as configuration errors. Building on this insight, we present an iterative method for analyzing inter-function flows. This method helps deriving practical remediation strategies. One such strategy is the introduction of "dumping effects" to contain harmonic inefficiencies, offering an alternative to completely restructuring the service's topological model. Our experimental results confirm that this approach can uncover latent architectural structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Hodge分解的拓扑模型，用于分析无服务器平台中的信息流。通过将观察到的操作流分解为局部可修正分量和全局谐波分量，揭示了无服务器系统的结构特性，并为管理谐波低效提供了实用的缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 无服务器平台中的信息流复杂且非保守，这是由于独立部署的函数在平台粗粒度控制机制下交互的结果。现有方法难以有效区分和处理这些复杂的流动模式。
AI.method: 采用Hodge分解技术，将观察到的操作流分离为两类：局部可修正分量和全局谐波分量。谐波流源于不同类型的函数交互，代表系统的结构属性而非配置错误。在此基础上提出迭代分析方法，用于推导实际的缓解策略，如引入"阻尼效应"来抑制谐波低效。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够揭示无服务器系统中潜在的架构结构，为避免完全重构服务拓扑模型提供了替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 谐波流应被视为无服务器系统的固有结构特性，而非配置错误。通过引入阻尼效应的缓解策略，可有效管理谐波低效，同时保留系统的基本拓扑结构。

title: Toward Epistemic Stability: Engineering Consistent Procedures for Industrial LLM Hallucination Reduction
summary: Hallucinations in large language models (LLMs) are outputs that are syntactically coherent but factually incorrect or contextually inconsistent. They are persistent obstacles in high-stakes industrial settings such as engineering design, enterprise resource planning, and IoT telemetry platforms. We present and compare five prompt engineering strategies intended to reduce the variance of model outputs and move toward repeatable, grounded results without modifying model weights or creating complex validation models. These methods include: (M1) Iterative Similarity Convergence, (M2) Decomposed Model-Agnostic Prompting, (M3) Single-Task Agent Specialization, (M4) Enhanced Data Registry, and (M5) Domain Glossary Injection. Each method is evaluated against an internal baseline using an LLM-as-Judge framework over 100 repeated runs per method (same fixed task prompt, stochastic decoding at $τ= 0.7$. Under this evaluation setup, M4 (Enhanced Data Registry) received ``Better'' verdicts in all 100 trials; M3 and M5 reached 80\% and 77\% respectively; M1 reached 75\%; and M2 was net negative at 34\% when compared to single shot prompting with a modern foundation model. We then developed enhanced version 2 (v2) implementations and assessed them on a 10-trial verification batch; M2 recovered from 34\% to 80\%, the largest gain among the four revised methods. We discuss how these strategies help overcome the non-deterministic nature of LLM results for industrial procedures, even when absolute correctness cannot be guaranteed. We provide pseudocode, verbatim prompts, and batch logs to support independent assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出五种提示工程策略（M1-M5）以减少LLM幻觉，无需修改模型权重。实验表明M4（增强数据注册表）效果最佳（100%），M2在改进后从34%提升至80%，为工业场景下的LLM应用提供可重复性解决方案。
AI.motivation: 解决大型语言模型在工程设计、企业资源计划和物联网遥测平台等高风险工业环境中产生幻觉（语法正确但事实错误或上下文不一致的输出）的问题，追求可重复、接地气的结果。
AI.method: 在LLM即评判框架下，对每种方法进行100次重复运行评估（相同固定任务提示词，随机解码温度τ=0.7），并开发v2版本在10次试验验证批次中进行测试。
AI.result: M4获"更好"判定率100%；M3达80%；M5达77%；M1达75%；M2为34%（净负面）。v2版本中，M2从34%恢复至80%，提升幅度最大。
AI.conclusion: M4（增强数据注册表）在所有100次试验中获得"更好"判定，展示了最稳定的效果；M2在v2版本中从34%跃升至80%，提升最为显著。所有方法均旨在克服LLM的非确定性特征，无需修改模型权重或创建复杂验证模型即可提升结果的可重复性和可靠性。

title: HiFIVE: High-Fidelity Vector-Tile Reduction for Interactive Map Exploration
summary: Interactive visualization is a common tool for exploring large open-data repositories, where users quickly explore datasets across diverse domains. When it comes to large-scale spatial data, many existing tools rely on server-side rendering to produce small images that can be viewed at the client-side. However, most users prefer client-side rendering that allows quick styling of the data for better visualization experience. This paper presents HiFIVE, a data-management framework for scalable, high-fidelity client-side geospatial visualization. We formalize the visualization-aware tile reduction problem, which captures the trade-off between tile-size and visualization distortion, and prove its NP-hardness. HiFIVE introduces a two-stage solution combining triage and sparsification to selectively prune records, attributes, and values based on information-theoretic and spatial criteria. Experiments demonstrate substantial tile-size reductions while preserving visual fidelity and interactive performance at terabyte scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiFIVE框架，解决大规模空间数据的客户端渲染问题。通过形式化"可视化感知的瓦片简化问题"并证明其NP难性，引入triage和sparsification两阶段方法，基于信息论和空间标准选择性删减记录、属性和值，实现 TB 级数据下的大幅瓦片缩减，同时保持视觉保真度和交互性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模空间数据可视化中，现有工具依赖服务器端渲染生成小图像，但用户更偏好客户端渲染以获得更好的可视化体验和快速样式调整能力。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"可视化感知瓦片简化问题"，捕捉瓦片大小与可视化失真之间的权衡，并证明其NP难性；2) 提出两阶段解决方案：triage（分诊）和sparsification（稀疏化）；3) 基于信息论和空间标准选择性地删减记录、属性和值。
AI.result: 实验表明在TB级规模下实现了显著的瓦片大小缩减，同时保持视觉保真度和交互性能。
AI.conclusion: HiFIVE是一个用于可扩展、高保真客户端地理空间可视化的数据管理框架，通过智能数据简化在保证视觉质量的前提下大幅降低数据传输和渲染开销。

title: HEAL: Hindsight Entropy-Assisted Learning for Reasoning Distillation
summary: Distilling reasoning capabilities from Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) into smaller models is typically constrained by the limitation of rejection sampling. Standard methods treat the teacher as a static filter, discarding complex "corner-case" problems where the teacher fails to explore valid solutions independently, thereby creating an artificial "Teacher Ceiling" for the student. In this work, we propose Hindsight Entropy-Assisted Learning (HEAL), an RL-free framework designed to bridge this reasoning gap. Drawing on the educational theory of the Zone of Proximal Development(ZPD), HEAL synergizes three core modules: (1) Guided Entropy-Assisted Repair (GEAR), an active intervention mechanism that detects critical reasoning breakpoints via entropy dynamics and injects targeted hindsight hints to repair broken trajectories; (2) Perplexity-Uncertainty Ratio Estimator (PURE), a rigorous filtering protocol that decouples genuine cognitive breakthroughs from spurious shortcuts; and (3) Progressive Answer-guided Curriculum Evolution (PACE), a three-stage distillation strategy that organizes training from foundational alignment to frontier breakthrough. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that HEAL significantly outperforms traditional SFT distillation and other baselines.

AI.tldr: HEAL是一种无强化学习的框架，通过借鉴教育学中的最近发展区(ZPD)理论，设计了GEAR、PURE和PACE三个模块来解决大模型推理能力蒸馏中的"教师天花板"问题。
AI.motivation: 标准蒸馏方法将教师模型视为静态过滤器，丢弃复杂"边缘案例"问题，导致教师模型无法独立探索有效解决方案，从而在学生模型中形成人为的"教师天花板"限制。
AI.method: 提出HEAL框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) GEAR通过熵动态检测推理断点并注入回顾性提示来修复断裂轨迹；(2) PURE通过困惑度-不确定性比率过滤真正的认知突破；(3) PACE采用三阶段课程学习策略，从基础对齐到前沿突破。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，HEAL显著优于传统SFT蒸馏和其他基线方法。
AI.conclusion: HEAL通过GEAR、PURE和PACE三个模块协同作用，有效突破了传统蒸馏方法中的"教师天花板"限制，显著提升了小模型从大模型蒸馏推理能力的性能。

title: Personalized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Heterogenous Preference Alignment
summary: Despite their sophisticated general-purpose capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to align with diverse individual preferences because standard post-training methods, like Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), optimize for a single, global objective. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a widely adopted on-policy reinforcement learning framework, its group-based normalization implicitly assumes that all samples are exchangeable, inheriting this limitation in personalized settings. This assumption conflates distinct user reward distributions and systematically biases learning toward dominant preferences while suppressing minority signals. To address this, we introduce Personalized GRPO (P-GRPO), a novel alignment framework that decouples advantage estimation from immediate batch statistics. By normalizing advantages against preference-group-specific reward histories rather than the concurrent generation group, P-GRPO preserves the contrastive signal necessary for learning distinct preferences. We evaluate P-GRPO across diverse tasks and find that it consistently achieves faster convergence and higher rewards than standard GRPO, thereby enhancing its ability to recover and align with heterogeneous preference signals. Our results demonstrate that accounting for reward heterogeneity at the optimization level is essential for building models that faithfully align with diverse human preferences without sacrificing general capabilities.

AI.tldr: P-GRPO通过基于偏好组特定奖励历史进行优势归一化，解决了标准GRPO在个性化对齐中的局限性，实验表明其收敛更快、奖励更高。
AI.motivation: 现有GRPO等后训练方法假设所有样本可交换，导致不同用户奖励分布被混淆，学习偏向主导偏好而抑制少数群体信号，难以实现个性化对齐。
AI.method: 提出个性化GRPO(P-GRPO)，通过针对特定偏好组的奖励历史而非并发生成组进行优势归一化，将优势估计与即时批次统计解耦。
AI.result: P-GRPO在多种任务中一致实现更快的收敛速度和更高的奖励，能够更好地恢复和对齐异质偏好信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过在优化层面考虑奖励异质性，可以在不牺牲通用能力的情况下，构建能够忠实对齐多样化人类偏好的模型。P-GRPO为个性化对齐提供了一个有效的框架。

title: Data Augmentation and Convolutional Network Architecture Influence on Distributed Learning
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have proven to be highly effective in solving a broad spectrum of computer vision tasks, such as classification, identification, and segmentation. These methods can be deployed in both centralized and distributed environments, depending on the computational demands of the task. While much of the literature has focused on the explainability of CNNs, which is essential for building trust and confidence in their predictions, there remains a gap in understanding their impact on computational resources, particularly in distributed training contexts. In this study, we analyze how CNN architectures primarily influence model accuracy and investigate additional factors that affect computational efficiency in distributed systems. Our findings contribute valuable insights for optimizing the deployment of CNNs in resource-intensive scenarios, paving the way for further exploration of variables critical to distributed learning.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses the underexplored relationship between CNN architectures and computational efficiency in distributed training environments, moving beyond the typical focus on model explainability to analyze factors affecting resource utilization and accuracy.
AI.motivation: While much literature focuses on CNN explainability, there remains a gap in understanding their impact on computational resources, particularly in distributed training contexts.
AI.method: The study analyzes how CNN architectures influence model accuracy and investigates additional factors affecting computational efficiency in distributed systems.
AI.result: The paper provides insights into optimizing CNN deployment in resource-intensive scenarios.
AI.conclusion: The findings contribute valuable insights for optimizing CNN deployment in resource-intensive scenarios and pave the way for further exploration of variables critical to distributed learning.

title: DUCTILE: Agentic LLM Orchestration of Engineering Analysis in Product Development Practice
summary: Engineering analysis automation in product development relies on rigid interfaces between tools, data formats and documented processes. When these interfaces change, as they routinely do as the product evolves in the engineering ecosystem, the automation support breaks. This paper presents a DUCTILE (Delegated, User-supervised Coordination of Tool- and document-Integrated LLM-Enabled) agentic orchestration, an approach for developing, executing and evaluating LLM-based agentic automation support of engineering analysis tasks. The approach separates adaptive orchestration, performed by the LLM agent, from deterministic execution, performed by verified engineering tools. The agent interprets documented design practices, inspects input data and adapts the processing path, while the engineer supervises and exercises final judgment. DUCTILE is demonstrated on an industrial structural analysis task at an aerospace manufacturer, where the agent handled input deviations in format, units, naming conventions and methodology that would break traditional scripted pipelines. Evaluation against expert-defined acceptance criteria and deployment with practicing engineers confirm that the approach produces correct, methodologically compliant results across repeated independent runs. The paper discusses practical consequences of adopting agentic automation, including unintended effects on the nature of engineering work and the tension between removing mundane tasks and creating an exhausting supervisory role.

AI.tldr: DUCTILE 是一种 LLM 智能体编排方法：在航空结构分析中，把“适应性编排”（由大模型代理完成：读文档、查数据、适配输入偏差）与“确定性执行”（由经验证的工程工具完成：解析、单位换算、求解）分离，让工程师保留监督与最终判断。已在 GKN Aerospace 的涡轮后机匣（Turbine Rear Structure, TRS）载荷处理任务上验证：代理正确处理了 YAML→JSON、英制→SI、节点命名变更（left/right→port/starboard）、Fx 力 1.04 修正系数这四类会击穿传统脚本流水线的偏差，10 次独立运行全部通过（pass^10=100%），两名监督风格不同的工程师获得完全相同的结果，并给出 R1–R12 需求表与基于 pass^k 的评估方法论。
AI.motivation: 工程分析自动化（脚本、KBE 系统、图形化工作流/CAE 平台）依赖工具、数据格式与文档流程之间的刚性接口，只要产品与工程生态演进，这些接口就会变化，导致自动化“脆断”（brittle），工程师大量时间耗费在数据整理与工具编排而非工程决策上。传统两类补救各有缺陷：扩展确定性规则会随变异增多而复杂度爆炸、产生新的失效模式；依赖专家逐案手工适配则慢且把关键知识集中在个人身上，形成组织脆弱性。既有 AI 研究（深度生成模型、机器学习+专家验证）多用于生成设计候选或性能预测/代理模型，不解决“安全关键产品详细设计阶段必须遵循成文流程、按序调用指定工具、输入输出须在质量保证链上可追溯”的编排问题；商用仿真软件内置的 AI 助手又封闭于自身生态，无权访问企业内外部工具与文档。因此需要一种能容纳数据、工具与实践变异性的“中介层”，同时不牺牲工程严谨性、溯源性与认证合规性。
AI.method: 核心原则：把“解释/编排”交给 LLM 代理，把“计算”委派给经验证的确定性工程工具（不做微调、不设持久记忆，只用上下文内推理，以避免模型锁定）。具体方法：(1) 文献综合提出 12 条工程编排需求 R1–R12（可检查性、可复现性、确定性执行边界、溯源审计、数据治理、人工监督、责任归工程师、对常规变异的鲁棒性、可观测性、最小耦合、pass^k 评估、变更控制、文档质量），DUCTILE 逐条对齐。(2) 智能体应用开发三要素：框架特性（开源、可暴露 prompt/轨迹、终端/IDE 内运行，如 Claude Code）、配置范围（模型连接与版本固定、系统提示、工具接口的显式类型化 I/O 契约与受控写位置；领域流程不写入静态提示，而在运行时从文档/skills 检索）、工具接入（优先外部资源，MCP 文档服务器、PyPI 工具包、llms.txt 文档）。(3) 执行：工程师给出任务与上下文 → 代理在"推理—工具调用"循环中读取设计实践 PDF、检查工作目录与历史运行、识别偏差 → 提交分步计划供工程师批准 → 抓取 API 文档、编写并执行处理脚本 → 校验输出（.inp 文件、包络表、超限对比）→ 流式暴露思考与工具调用，允许随时中断；全过程通过 OpenTelemetry 类可观测平台记录 latency/token/成本。(4) 评估：每个用例需定义设计环境、验收标准与评估方法（确定性检查／专家评审／LLM-as-a-judge）；采用 pass^k 指标，用 Clopper–Pearson 精确界给出 95% 置信下的最小连续通过次数参照（S-Basis 5、B-Basis 29、A-Basis 299），实践建议开发期 k=3、部署期 k≥10。
AI.result: 工业案例（GKN Aerospace 发动机分部，TRS 结构强度评估的载荷处理前置任务）：几何、有限元网格与分析方法不变，仅 OEM 新交付载荷引入四类偏差——文件格式（YAML 替代 JSON）、单位制（英制替代 SI）、节点命名（right/left 替代 port/starboard）、方法变更（全部 Fx 力乘 1.04 修正系数）。代理在推理轨迹中完整识别出四项偏差并提交七步计划（重命名 lug_left→lug_port、lug_right→lug_starboard；施加 1.04 Fx 修正；确认坐标系不需变换；klbs→N 单位换算；包络 downselection；写出 6 个 .inp 文件；生成包络表与超限对比），输出显示新载荷超旧包络（Mz +30%、Fx +15%、Fy +11–17%）。工程师1（全委托、事后审查）与工程师2（逐步增量确认）最终输出完全一致。评估：以专家独立复核的工程师1输出为基准，LLM-as-a-judge（Opus 4.6）检查脚本是否正确处理四项偏差 + 确定性比对载荷汇总数值，两者均通过才算通过；10 次独立运行（不改动提示、工具与上下文）全部通过，LLM 评审与 10 次人工核验的评分者间一致率 100%。评估暴露出设计实践文档中隐性知识缺失的问题，这些隐性步骤在智能体开发与评估过程中被补写进文档。代码、配置、评估脚本与完整会话记录以开源形式发布（GitHub + Zenodo 归档）。
AI.conclusion: DUCTILE 通过把适应性编排与确定性执行分离，在真实航空分析流程中吸收了会击穿传统自动化的输入变异，同时保留工程严谨性、可溯源性与认证合规性；工程师保留计划审批、执行监督与最终判断责任。论文进一步指出三点：(a) 案例暴露了企业设计实践文档的隐性知识缺口，文档质量投资同时惠及工程师与代理，并降低知识集中于个人的组织脆弱性；(b) 采用纯上下文内推理而非微调可避免模型锁定，但更复杂场景可能需要微调开源权重模型，而智能体运行过程本身会自然产生可作为训练数据的会话日志；(c) 风险在于“灵巧”（API/格式适配）被代理吸收后，组织可能不再投入培养“工程判断力”，且有反弹效应与技能退化之虞——软件工程领域已出现代理把解决小问题的乐趣替换为令人疲惫的空洞监督角色的现象，故监督角色必须被有意识地设计以维持工程师判断力；应设计为“supertools”式的能力放大而非需要监督的自主体，并避免仅为短期效率优化。局限：仅两名工程师、依赖特定模型版本、要求流程已文档化、仅覆盖文本与数据工作流（不含 CAD/网格/图形后处理）、迁移性未经实证验证。未来工作：构建智能体评估的开放基准与数据集、进行有/无代理支持的被试内对照工业影响研究。关于认证接受度，作者主张以任务评估结果（pass^k 等证据）而非先验的确定性期望来评判概率性编排。

title: A Hypergraph-Based Framework for Exploratory Business Intelligence
summary: Business Intelligence (BI) analysis is evolving towards Exploratory BI, an iterative, multi-round exploration paradigm where analysts progressively refine their understanding. However, traditional BI systems impose critical limits for Exploratory BI: heavy reliance on expert knowledge, high computational costs, static schemas, and lack of reusability. We present ExBI, a novel system that introduces the hypergraph data model with operators, including Source, Join, and View, to enable dynamic schema evolution and materialized view reuse. Using sampling-based algorithms with provable estimation guarantees, ExBI addresses the computational bottlenecks, while maintaining analytical accuracy. Experiments on LDBC datasets demonstrate that ExBI achieves significant speedups over existing systems: on average 16.21x (up to 146.25x) compared to Neo4j and 46.67x (up to 230.53x) compared to MySQL, while maintaining high accuracy with an average error rate of only 0.27% for COUNT, enabling efficient and accurate large-scale exploratory BI workflows.

AI.tldr: ExBI是一个新型探索性商业智能系统，通过超图数据模型和采样算法解决传统BI系统的局限性，在保持0.27%平均错误率的同时，相比Neo4j和MySQL分别实现了平均16.21倍和46.67倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统BI系统存在四大关键局限：严重依赖专家知识、计算成本高、模式静态化、缺乏可复用性，这些限制阻碍了探索性BI的发展。探索性BI需要迭代、多轮的探索范式，分析师需要逐步深化理解。
AI.method: ExBI系统采用超图数据模型，引入Source、Join、View等操作符支持动态模式演进和物化视图复用；使用具有可证明估计保证的采样算法来解决计算瓶颈问题。
AI.result: 在LDBC数据集上的实验表明：与Neo4j相比平均加速16.21倍（最高146.25倍），与MySQL相比平均加速46.67倍（最高230.53倍）；COUNT查询的平均错误率仅为0.27%，实现了高效且准确的大规模探索性BI工作流程。
AI.conclusion: ExBI系统通过超图数据模型、动态模式演进和物化视图复用，实现了高效且准确的大规模探索性BI工作流程。实验表明，该系统在保持高分析精度的同时，能够显著提升查询性能。

title: Beyond Scalars: Evaluating and Understanding LLM Reasoning via Geometric Progress and Stability
summary: Evaluating LLM reliability via scalar probabilities often fails to capture the structural dynamics of reasoning. We introduce TRACED, a framework that assesses reasoning quality through theoretically grounded geometric kinematics. By decomposing reasoning traces into Progress (displacement) and Stability (curvature), we reveal a distinct topological divergence: correct reasoning manifests as high-progress, stable trajectories, whereas hallucinations are characterized by low-progress, unstable patterns (stalled displacement with high curvature fluctuations). Leveraging these signatures, our probabilistic framework achieves competitive performance and superior robustness across diverse benchmarks. Crucially, TRACED bridges geometry and cognition by mapping high curvature to ''Hesitation Loops'' and displacement to ''Certainty Accumulation'', offering a physical lens to decode the internal dynamics of machine thought.

AI.tldr: TRACED通过几何运动学方法评估LLM推理质量，将推理轨迹分解为进展（位移）和稳定性（曲率），揭示了正确推理表现为高进展、稳定轨迹，而幻觉表现为低进展、不稳定模式。该框架在多个基准测试中表现出竞争力和 superior robustness。
AI.motivation: 当前通过标量概率评估LLM可靠性的方法无法捕捉推理的结构动态特性，需要新的方法来理解推理过程的内在大脑机制。
AI.method: 提出TRACED框架，通过理论驱动的几何运动学评估推理质量。将推理轨迹分解为两个核心维度：Progress（位移）和Stability（曲率），利用这些几何特征构建概率框架。
AI.result: 发现正确的推理表现出高进展、稳定的轨迹；幻觉则表现为低进展、不稳定的模式（停滞的位移伴随高曲率波动）。该框架在多样化的基准测试中实现了竞争性性能和卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TRACED框架将几何与认知联系起来，将高曲率映射为"犹豫循环"、位移映射为"确定性累积"，为解码机器思维的内部动力学提供了物理视角。

title: LWM-Temporal: Sparse Spatio-Temporal Attention for Wireless Channel Representation Learning
comment: LWM resources are publicly available at [https://lwm-wireless.net/](https://lwm-wireless.net/)
summary: LWM-Temporal is a new member of the Large Wireless Models (LWM) family that targets the spatiotemporal nature of wireless channels. Designed as a task-agnostic foundation model, LWM-Temporal learns universal channel embeddings that capture mobility-induced evolution and are reusable across various downstream tasks. To achieve this objective, LWM-Temporal operates in the angle-delay-time domain and introduces Sparse Spatio-Temporal Attention (SSTA), a propagation-aligned attention mechanism that restricts interactions to physically plausible neighborhoods, reducing attention complexity by an order of magnitude while preserving geometry-consistent dependencies. LWM-Temporal is pretrained in a self-supervised manner using a physics-informed masking curriculum that emulates realistic occlusions, pilot sparsity, and measurement impairments. Experimental results on channel prediction across multiple mobility regimes show consistent improvements over strong baselines, particularly under long horizons and limited fine-tuning data, highlighting the importance of geometry-aware architectures and geometry-consistent pretraining for learning transferable spatiotemporal wireless representations.

AI.tldr: LWM-Temporal是大型无线模型（LWM）家族的新成员，专注于无线信道的时空特性。作为任务无关的基础模型，它通过在角度-延迟-时域上引入稀疏时空注意力（SSTA）来学习可迁移的信道嵌入。SSTA将注意力限制在物理合理的邻域内，降低复杂度同时保持几何一致性。模型采用物理信息掩码课程进行自监督预训练。实验表明，该方法在信道预测任务上显著优于基线，尤其在长预测范围和少样本微调场景下。
AI.motivation: 针对无线信道的时空特性，需要一个任务无关的基础模型来学习能够捕捉移动性诱导演化的通用信道嵌入，并可跨各种下游任务复用。
AI.method: 1. 在角度-延迟-时域（angle-delay-time domain）上操作；2. 引入稀疏时空注意力（SSTA），将交互限制在物理上合理的邻域内，将注意力复杂度降低一个数量级；3. 使用物理信息掩码课程（physics-informed masking curriculum）进行自监督预训练，模拟真实遮挡、导频稀疏和测量损伤。
AI.result: 在多种移动性场景下的信道预测实验中展现出一致的改进，特别是在长 horizon 和有限微调数据条件下，优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知架构和几何一致性预训练对于学习可迁移的时空无线表示具有重要性。LWM-Temporal作为任务无关的基础模型，能够学习可跨各种下游任务重用的通用信道嵌入。

title: MALTA: Maintenance-Aware Technical Lag, Estimation to Address Software Abandonment
summary: Context: Open-source ecosystems rely on sustained package maintenance. When maintenance slows or stops, Technical Lag (TL), the gap between installed and latest dependency versions accumulates, creating security and sustainability risks. However, some existing TL metrics, such as Version Lag, struggle to distinguish between actively maintained and abandoned packages, leading to a systematic underestimation of risk. Objective: We investigate the relationship between Version Lag and software abandonment by (i) identifying which repository-level signals reliably distinguish sustained maintenance from long-term decline, (ii) quantifying how Version Lag magnitude and persistence differ across maintenance states, and (iii) evaluating how maintenance-aware metrics change the identification of high-risk dependencies. Method: We introduce Maintenance-Aware Lag and Technical Abandonment (MALTA), a scoring framework comprising three metrics: Development Activity Score (DAS), Maintainer Responsiveness Score (MRS), and Repository Metadata Viability Score (RMVS). We evaluate MALTA on a dataset of 11,047 Debian packages linked to upstream GitHub repositories, encompassing 1.7 million commits and 4.2 million pull requests. Results: MALTA achieves AUC = 0.783 for classifying active versus declining maintenance. Most significantly, 62.2% of packages classified as "Low Risk" by Version Lag alone are reclassified as "High Risk" when MALTA signals are incorporated. These discordant packages average 2019 days since their last commit, with 9.8% having archived repositories. Conclusions: Version Lag metrics systematically miss abandoned packages, a blind spot affecting the majority of dependencies in distribution ecosystems. MALTA identifies a substantial discordant population invisible to Version Lag by distinguishing resolvable lag from terminal lag caused by upstream abandonment.

AI.tldr: 研究提出MALTA框架解决开源软件包维护识别问题。该框架通过开发活动、维护者响应和仓库元数据三个维度评估软件包状态，在区分主动维护与衰退维护方面达到0.783的AUC值。研究发现62.2%的低风险软件包实为高风险，揭示了Version Lag指标在检测软件遗弃方面的系统性盲点。
AI.motivation: 开源生态系统的可持续性依赖于持续的软件包维护。当维护减缓或停止时，技术滞后（TL）会累积，造成安全和可持续性风险。然而，现有的Version Lag等TL指标难以区分积极维护和被遗弃的软件包，导致风险被系统性低估。
AI.method: 本研究提出了MALTA（Maintenance-Aware Lag and Technical Abandonment，维护感知滞后与技术遗弃）评分框架，包含三个指标：开发活动评分（DAS）、维护者响应评分（MRS）和仓库元数据可行性评分（RMVS）。研究评估了11,047个Debian软件包与上游GitHub仓库的关联数据集，涉及170万次提交和420万个拉取请求。
AI.result: MALTA在分类主动维护与衰退维护方面达到AUC = 0.783。最显著的是，62.2%仅由Version Lag分类为"低风险"的软件包在纳入MALTA信号后被重新分类为"高风险"。这些不一致的软件包平均距最后提交已过2019天，其中9.8%拥有已归档的仓库。
AI.conclusion: Version Lag指标系统性地遗漏了被遗弃的软件包，这一盲点影响了生态系统中大多数依赖项。MALTA通过区分可解决的技术滞后与上游遗弃导致的终结性滞后，识别出了大量Version Lag无法检测到的不一致软件包群体。

title: EvoSchema: Towards Text-to-SQL Robustness Against Schema Evolution
summary: Neural text-to-SQL models, which translate natural language questions (NLQs) into SQL queries given a database schema, have achieved remarkable performance. However, database schemas frequently evolve to meet new requirements. Such schema evolution often leads to performance degradation for models trained on static schemas. Existing work either mainly focuses on simply paraphrasing some syntactic or semantic mappings among NLQ, DB and SQL, or lacks a comprehensive and controllable way to investigate the model robustness issue under the schema evolution, which is insufficient when facing the increasingly complex and rich database schema changes in reality, especially in the LLM era. To address the challenges posed by schema evolution, we present EvoSchema, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess and enhance the robustness of text-to-SQL systems under real-world schema changes. EvoSchema introduces a novel schema evolution taxonomy, encompassing ten perturbation types across columnlevel and table-level modifications, systematically simulating the dynamic nature of database schemas. Through EvoSchema, we conduct an in-depth evaluation spanning different open source and closed-source LLMs, revealing that table-level perturbations have a significantly greater impact on model performance compared to column-level changes. Furthermore, EvoSchema inspires the development of more resilient text-to-SQL systems, in terms of both model training and database design. The models trained on EvoSchema's diverse schema designs can force the model to distinguish the schema difference for the same questions to avoid learning spurious patterns, which demonstrate remarkable robustness compared to those trained on unperturbed data on average. This benchmark offers valuable insights into model behavior and a path forward for designing systems capable of thriving in dynamic, real-world environments.

AI.tldr: EvoSchema 是一个面向 schema 演化（schema evolution）鲁棒性的 text-to-SQL 基准：在 BIRD 之上定义了包含 10 种扰动类型（列级：增/删/改名/拆分/合并；表级：增/删/改名/拆分/合并）的演化分类体系，用「固定 NLQ、扰动 schema 并相应改写 SQL」的混合合成框架构建评测集与训练集；并提出用多 schema 设计增强原训练三元组的训练范式。实验发现表级扰动对模型影响远大于列级，扰动训练可为 open-source 模型带来最高约 33 分（Table Match F1）提升，其效果在平均意义上优于 GPT-3.5/GPT-4。
AI.motivation: 神经 text-to-SQL 模型在静态 schema 上表现优异，但真实数据库 schema 会随业务需求持续演化（重命名、增删表列、拆表合表等），造成命名偏移、数据粒度偏移、表列关系偏移与 schema 复杂度偏移等分布漂移，使模型性能显著退化；且每次 schema 变化后重新收集数据、完整重训的生命周期成本高昂。已有鲁棒性工作多停留在 NLQ/DB/SQL 的表层改写或简单语义映射（Dr.Spider、ADVETA），缺少系统的演化类型分类（MT-TEQL 仅做不影响 SQL 的扰动，FootballDB 只为优化 FK/JOIN 设计），无法覆盖真实世界复杂且会改变 SQL 的 schema 变化，尤其在 LLM 时代结构鲁棒性问题更突出。论文由此提出两个问题：(1) 现有模型对各类 schema 变化有多敏感？(2) 如何训练既在现有 schema 上表现好、又能适应 schema 变化的鲁棒模型？
AI.method: 【分类体系】将 schema 演化引发的分布漂移归纳为四类：命名偏移、数据粒度偏移、表列关系偏移、schema 复杂度偏移；对应 10 种扰动：列级 add/remove/rename/split/merge columns，表级 add/remove/rename/split/merge tables。【数据合成】以 BIRD 为种子（比 Spider 数据库更复杂、SQL 覆盖更多关键字），对训练集与评测集同时施加扰动，NLQ 保持不变，SQL 视情况改写。采用启发式规则 + LLM 的混合策略：GPT-3.5 负责加/改名时的列与表生成（并用启发式去重、同步更新外键引用）；GPT-4 负责拆表/合表及相应 SQL 改写（主键复制/冲突列改名/JOIN 路径调整）；gold SQL 中被删列/删表的样本以「信息不足，无法生成 SQL」为标准答案（out-of-scope，期望模型拒答）。加入人类校验：5 名有 SQL 经验的标注者交叉验证，split/merge 类评测数据人工核验约 175 小时；LLM 生成的拆/合表约 30% 为低质量，说明人工校验必要。训练数据全自动生成、无需人工标注。【指标】除执行准确率外，提出 Table Match F1 与 Column Match F1 两个细粒度指标，衡量模型是否选对表/列。【训练范式】对每个 <NLQ, schema, SQL> 三元组，固定 NLQ，扩展出多种 schema 设计及对应 SQL，合并扰动训练集后随机打乱微调，使模型必须区分同名问题下不同 schema 的差异，避免学到「总是 JOIN 所有表」等伪模式。【实验】基座为 Code Llama-7B、Mistral-7B、Llama 3-8B、SQLCoder-7B，闭源 GPT-3.5/GPT-4 仅评测；含 in-context learning、CHESS（SS+CG，gpt-4o 做 schema 选择）基线；消融包括列级/表级扰动消融、out-of-scope 数据影响、无关表影响、同库内训练与跨库训练对比；人工评估 200 例/类，McNemar 检验显著性。
AI.result: 1) 表级扰动影响显著大于列级：add tables / split tables 造成 Table Match F1 大幅下降（Code Llama w/o 的 add tables 仅 57.88，低于原始 89.77），add/split/merge tables 也显著拉低 Column Match F1；列级扰动除 split columns 外影响有限。2) 扰动训练有效：加入扰动训练数据后宏平均 Table Match F1 提升约 5 分（Code Llama 83.10→88.08）、Column Match F1 约 4 分（75.68→79.43）、执行准确率提升约 4 分；add tables 最高提升 33（表匹配）/18（列匹配）/19（EX）分，split tables 提升 14/4.2/12 分，split columns 提升 5.4/10.6/24 分；但在简单列级扰动与原始数据上会有小幅性能下降（WHERE 条件冗余/遗漏、SELECT/WHERE 列选错）。3) 闭源 GPT 模型整体更稳定，而经扰动训练的 open-source 模型在列级与表级扰动上均优于 GPT-3.5/GPT-4。4) 消融显示表级扰动训练数据是表级评测提升的关键（去掉后 add tables 掉 30 分），列级扰动亦有增益；仅在输入中加入无关表虽能缓解 add tables，却拉低其他类型，故需组合全部扰动。5) Out-of-scope（删掉 SQL 依赖的列/表）训练数据会使模型过度保守，在原始与 in-scope 数据上退化 4–8 分，拒答假阳性率与性能降幅一致，out-of-scope 真阳性仅约 84%。6) 同库内训练效果优于跨库，说明改进部分源于对具体表列名的熟悉而非纯粹的演化推理。7) 人工评估显示 ICL 仅在 split columns 上稳定有效；CHESS 依赖 schema 剪枝，在 merge columns/merge tables 易过度剪枝而变差；扰动微调 Code Llama 整体最佳，对 GPT-4 ICL、无扰动微调、CHESS 的优势均具统计显著性（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: schema 演化是 text-to-SQL 系统中被忽视的关键鲁棒性挑战。EvoSchema 通过系统的 10 类演化分类、基于 BIRD 的可控扰动合成框架（含 out-of-scope 拒答场景与 Table/Column Match F1 细粒度指标），首次把 schema 演化与「schema 变化导致 SQL 变化」联合起来评测，揭示表级演化比列级更具破坏性、schema 复杂度降低有利于模型选列，同时证明「同一 NLQ 配多种 schema 设计」的训练范式可显著提升开源模型鲁棒性并可超过闭源 LLM。局限与启示：训练于同库的收益部分来自名称记忆；out-of-scope 数据会引入保守偏差；推理期 schema 剪枝（如 CHESS）存在过度剪枝风险。未来方向包括跨库泛化的 schema 演化适应、演化感知的 schema 链接/检索、以及在真实工业数据库迁移日志上构建更贴近生产的演化基准。

title: Verbalizing LLM's Higher-order Uncertainty via Imprecise Probabilities
summary: Despite the growing demand for eliciting uncertainty from large language models (LLMs), empirical evidence suggests that LLM behavior is not always adequately captured by the elicitation techniques developed under the classical probabilistic uncertainty framework. This mismatch leads to systematic failure modes, particularly in settings that involve ambiguous question-answering, in-context learning, and self-reflection. To address this, we propose novel prompt-based uncertainty elicitation techniques grounded in \emph{imprecise probabilities}, a principled framework for repesenting and eliciting higher-order uncertainty. Here, first-order uncertainty captures uncertainty over possible responses to a prompt, while second-order uncertainty (uncertainty about uncertainty) quantifies indeterminacy in the underlying probability model itself. We introduce general-purpose prompting and post-processing procedures to directly elicit and quantify both orders of uncertainty, and demonstrate their effectiveness across diverse settings. Our approach enables more faithful uncertainty reporting from LLMs, improving credibility and supporting downstream decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出基于不精确概率框架的提示式不确定性提取技术，解决传统概率方法无法捕捉LLM不确定性的问题，提取一阶和二阶不确定性以提高LLM不确定性报告的可信度。
AI.motivation: 尽管从LLMs提取不确定性的需求增长，但现有技术在经典概率框架下无法充分捕捉LLM行为，导致在模糊问答、上下文学习和自我反思等场景中出现系统性失败。
AI.method: 提出基于不精确概率（imprecise probabilities）的新型提示驱动不确定性提取技术，引入通用提示和后处理程序直接提取和量化两个层次的不确定性：一阶不确定性（对提示响应的不确定性）和二阶不确定性（不确定性本身的不确定性）。
AI.result: 在多种设置中验证了方法的有效性，实现了更忠实的不确定性报告。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使LLMs能够更准确地报告不确定性，提高了模型可信度，支持下游决策，具有广泛的适用性。

title: Gated Adaptation for Continual Learning in Human Activity Recognition
summary: Wearable sensors in Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystems increasingly support applications such as remote health monitoring, elderly care, and smart home automation, all of which rely on robust human activity recognition (HAR). Continual learning systems must balance plasticity (learning new tasks) with stability (retaining prior knowledge), yet AI models often exhibit catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on earlier ones. This challenge is especially acute in domain-incremental HAR, where on-device models must adapt to new subjects with distinct movement patterns while maintaining accuracy on prior subjects without transmitting sensitive data to the cloud. We propose a parameter-efficient continual learning framework based on channel-wise gated modulation of frozen pretrained representations. Our key insight is that adaptation should operate through feature selection rather than feature generation: by restricting learned transformations to diagonal scaling of existing features, we preserve the geometry of pretrained representations while enabling subject-specific modulation. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that gating implements a bounded diagonal operator that limits representational drift compared to unconstrained linear transformations. Empirically, freezing the backbone substantially reduces forgetting, and lightweight gates restore lost adaptation capacity, achieving stability and plasticity simultaneously. On PAMAP2 with 8 sequential subjects, our approach reduces forgetting from 39.7% to 16.2% and improves final accuracy from 56.7% to 77.7%, while training less than 2% of parameters. Our method matches or exceeds standard continual learning baselines without replay buffers or task-specific regularization, confirming that structured diagonal operators are effective and efficient under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于通道门控调制的参数高效持续学习框架，通过对冻结预训练特征进行对角缩放实现特征选择，在HAR任务中将遗忘降至16.2%、准确率提升至77.7%，仅训练2%参数。
AI.motivation: 在物联网可穿戴传感器的人类活动识别(HAR)应用中，持续学习系统面临灾难性遗忘问题——学习新任务会损害旧任务的性能。特别是在域增量HAR场景中，设备上模型需要适应具有不同运动模式的新受试者，同时保持对先前受试者的准确性，且不将敏感数据传输到云端。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于冻结预训练表示的通道门控调制参数高效持续学习框架。核心观点是适应应该通过特征选择而非特征生成来实现：通过将对学习变换限制为对角缩放来保留预训练表示的几何结构，同时实现受试者特定的调制。理论分析表明门控实现了有界对角算子，与无约束线性变换相比限制了表示漂移。
AI.result: 在PAMAP2数据集上对8个顺序受试者进行实验，方法将遗忘从39.7%降至16.2%，最终准确率从56.7%提升至77.7%，同时仅训练不到2%的参数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法匹配或超越标准持续学习基线，无需回放缓冲区或任务特定正则化，证实了结构化对角算子在分布偏移下是有效且高效的。

title: SpecOps: A Fully Automated AI Agent Testing Framework in Real-World GUI Environments
summary: Autonomous AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where reliable and robust behavior is critical. However, existing agent evaluation frameworks either rely heavily on manual efforts, operate within simulated environments, or lack focus on testing complex, multimodal, real-world agents. We introduce SpecOps, a novel, fully automated testing framework designed to evaluate GUI-based AI agents in real-world environments. SpecOps decomposes the testing process into four specialized phases - test case generation, environment setup, test execution, and validation - each handled by a distinct LLM-based specialist agent. This structured architecture addresses key challenges including end-to-end task coherence, robust error handling, and adaptability across diverse agent platforms including CLI tools, web apps, and browser extensions. In comprehensive evaluations across five diverse real-world agents, SpecOps outperforms baselines including general-purpose agentic systems such as AutoGPT and LLM-crafted automation scripts in planning accuracy, execution success, and bug detection effectiveness. SpecOps identifies 164 true bugs in the real-world agents with an F1 score of 0.89. With a cost of under 0.73 USD and a runtime of under eight minutes per test, it demonstrates its practical viability and superiority in automated, real-world agent testing.

AI.tldr: SpecOps 是首个面向真实世界 GUI 型产品级 LLM Agent 的全自动化端到端测试框架。它将测试流程分解为测试用例生成、环境搭建、测试执行、验证四个阶段，每阶段由一个基于 LLM 的“专家智能体”负责，并通过共享的 Agent Specification（自适应双专家策略）、UI 交互抽象、屏幕录制监控与类人视觉监控（Judge + Investigator + Meta-CoT）保障一致性与鲁棒性。在 5 个真实 Agent、99 个用例上，相比 LLM Scripts 与 AutoGPT 基线：提示成功率 100%（基线 49.5%/11.1%），规划步骤执行率 100%/96%（基线 53.9%/24.8%、33.5%/5%），发现 164 个真实 Bug（F1=0.89，基线 0.23），单次测试成本 <$0.73、耗时 <8 分钟。
AI.motivation: 产品级 LLM Agent 已进入邮件助手、HR 聊天机器人、金融顾问等高风险真实场景，其输出近似自由格式、行为非确定，传统 GUI 测试（Selenium/Playwright/ScenGen 等依赖预编写脚本）无法覆盖；而 OSWorld、AgentCompany、Windows Agent Arena、AgentDojo、ToolEmu 等现有评测又存在三缺陷：测试用例与环境需大量人工构造（OSWorld 1800+ 人时、369 任务）、多为模拟沙箱存在“模拟器幻觉”、关注文本玩具 Agent 而忽视多模态产品级 Agent。论文由此提出三大挑战：(1) 端到端任务连贯性——环境搭建、提示生成、执行、验证与缺陷标注需全局一致，早期错误会级联；(2) 平台多样性——Web 应用、浏览器扩展、CLI 工具的交互方式迥异；(3) 鲁棒性与早期失败检测——缺乏检查点与故障恢复会导致静默失败。动机案例（Open Interpreter 备份时误用绝对路径 ~/ 而非 ./）说明：LLM 脚本遇错即崩溃、AutoGPT 混淆“测试者”与“被测者”身份并试图替被测 Agent 修 Bug，故需结构化的专家智能体测试流水线。
AI.method: 架构：四阶段专家智能体流水线（均为 LLM 编排工具的 agent-like 设计 + 大量提示工程），共享并持续演进的 Agent Specification 作为一致性载体。Phase 1 测试用例生成：双专家自适应策略——Test Architect 负责提示完整性、自然度与隐含期望，Test Analyst 基于改进自反思复核环境可行性、Oracle 完整性与泛化性（应对自然语言变异性、提示完整性、Oracle 泛化性三大挑战）。Phase 2 环境搭建：Infrastructure Manager 将高层环境需求分解为具体 MCP 工具调用，结合工具输出做思维链调整提示与期望行为；仅依赖最小 API（send_email、固定域邮箱、非 root 文件系统），实现平台无关。Phase 3 测试执行：Engineer 专家以键盘/鼠标为统一 UI 抽象实现跨平台 MCP 工具（增强键盘工具校验文本是否真的上屏；类 SOM 的文本点击 + 相对位置消歧），并通过屏幕变化触发截图作为运行时证据。Phase 4 验证审计：Investigator 直接探查环境状态变化并以结构化文本呈现，Judge 综合评述、截图与环境状态对照 Oracle 判定缺陷（不合理偏离预期、向用户误报、影响完成度/质量、需不合理人工干预），并使用 Meta-CoT（先生成 CoT 问题再自行作答）抑制幻觉。实验：5 个真实 Agent（ProxyAI、Open Interpreter、Self-Operating Computer、TaxyAI、HR Chatbot），覆盖 Email/File System/HR Q&A 三域共 99 个可测特征；特征列表由文档自动抽取 + OSWorld/ASB/ToolEmu/AGrail/WorkBench 跨基准挖掘 + 人工增补三阶段构建；基线为 LLM Scripts（Playwright 静态脚本）与 AutoGPT（最多 50 轮、每轮 10 分钟，截图以 LLM 文本描述替代）；采用步骤离散化（UI 导航、数据提取、邮件/文件/终端命令计数规则）给出部分得分；RQ1–RQ5 分别评估规划、执行、缺陷检出、失败根因与效率。
AI.result: 规划（RQ1）：SpecOps 在 Setup 与 Execution 阶段错误步骤为 0、缺失为 0，Validation 缺失 24 步（基线 LLM Scripts 缺失 90 步且多为省略环境校验，AutoGPT 错误 13 步）；总体离散化步骤数 SpecOps 2643 > LLM Scripts 2281 > AutoGPT 1125。执行（RQ2）：SpecOps Setup 100%、Execution 100%、Validation 96.0%；LLM Scripts 为 97.6%/53.9%/24.8%，AutoGPT 为 92.3%/33.5%/5.0%，基线常因无法与被测 Agent 通信而级联失败。缺陷检出（RQ3）：提示成功率 100% vs 49.5% vs 11.1%；SpecOps 触发 190 个 Bug，TP=164、FP=15、FN=26，精确率 0.92、召回率 0.86、F1=0.89；LLM Scripts 仅 13 TP、F1=0.23；AutoGPT 未能标注任何缺陷（TP/FP 均为 0，F1 未定义）。失败根因（RQ4）：所有失败均可归为幻觉（输入冲突/UI/API 工具调用/算法/错误验证/杂项 6 类），SpecOps 共 34 次（LLM Scripts 152、AutoGPT 171），且未出现输入冲突、工具调用与算法类幻觉。效率（RQ5）：平均每测试 <$0.73（总计约 $72），99 个测试端到端 12.5 小时，单测试 <8 分钟；注入 20 次环境搭建故障（断网、存储不足、API 超时）时能重试并优雅退出、不误报缺陷。
AI.conclusion: SpecOps 通过“阶段分解 + 专家智能体隔离 + 共享自适应规格”的架构，在真实 GUI 环境中实现了首个全自动化、零人工标注的端到端 Agent 测试流水线，验证了测试者与被测者角色分离、反馈循环与内建工具校验对抑制幻觉、提升缺陷发现率与成本效率的关键作用，为生产级 LLM Agent 的可扩展自动化测试奠定了基础。局限与未来方向：验证仅基于单一基础模型（Claude 3.7 Sonnet）、环境 API 访问受限于最小权限（无法改写发件域与时间戳）、评估指标仍需人工标注步骤与缺陷类别、测试特征数量有限（Email 17 / File System 20 / HR 29）、缺少对被测 Agent 版本演进的持续回归与更广泛领域（含多模态与安全合规场景）的覆盖评估。

title: Pneuma-Seeker: A Relational Reification Mechanism to Align AI Agents with Human Work over Relational Data
summary:
When faced with data problems, many data workers cannot articulate their information need precisely enough for software to help. Although LLMs interpret natural-language requests, they behave brittly when intent is under-specified, e.g., hallucinating fields, assuming join paths, or producing ungrounded answers.
  We present Pneuma-Seeker, a system built around a central idea: relational reification. Pneuma-Seeker represents a user's evolving information need as a relational schema: a concrete, analysis-ready data model shared between user and system. Rather than answering prompts directly, Pneuma-Seeker iteratively refines this schema, then discovers and prepares relevant sources to construct a relation and executable program that compute the answer. Pneuma-Seeker employs an LLM-powered agentic architecture with conductor-style planning and macro- and micro-level context management to operate effectively over heterogeneous relational corpora.
