We formalize NFD through: (1) a Three-Layer Cognitive Architecture organizing agent knowledge by volatility and personalization degree; (2) the Knowledge Crystallization Cycle with formal definitions of crystallization operations and efficiency metrics; and (3) an operational framework comprising a Dual-Workspace Pattern and Spiral Development Model. We illustrate the paradigm through a detailed case study on building a financial research agent for U.S. equity analysis and discuss the conditions, limitations, and broader implications of NFD for human-agent co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「养育优先开发」（Nurture-First Development, NFD）范式：不再以代码优先或提示词优先的方式在部署前一次性编码领域专长，而是以最小脚手架启动智能体，通过与领域专家的持续对话使其"成长"，并周期性将对话中零散、隐性、碎片化的知识"结晶"为结构化可复用的知识资产。核心机制是「知识结晶周期」（四阶段：对话沉浸→经验累积→刻意结晶→有根应用），配套形式化框架包括按波动性与个性化程度划分的三层认知架构（宪法层/技能层/经验层）、双工作区模式（外科手术工作区+养育工作区）与螺旋式开发模型，并以美股研究智能体案例加以说明。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体框架（AutoGPT、MetaGPT、AutoGen、OpenClaw、Claude Code）已使瓶颈从"模型能否执行任务"转向"如何编码领域专长"，作者称之为"配置鸿沟"（configuration gap）。现有两大范式均把智能体构建视为部署前的离散工程阶段：代码优先（code-first）通过确定性流水线嵌入专长，捕获不了判断密集的细微之处，且代码固化了开发者写作时刻的理解，更新需昂贵的工程周期；提示词优先（prompt-first）通过静态系统提示词/人格/少样本示例编码专长，随领域复杂度增长会突破上下文窗口或降低推理质量，且本身是无学习机制的静态快照。根因是这一"先开发后部署"的顺序假设与领域专长的本质属性不匹配——依据Polanyi与Nonaka-Takeuchi，专长高度隐性（tacit）、深度个人化、持续演化，任何静态编码从诞生时刻起就在贬值。
AI.method: 论文给出NFD的三条基础命题（开发-部署融合、对话式知识获取、结晶即开发）与十维度范式对比（Table 1），并界定五项适用条件（专长隐性、高度个人化、持续演化、交互具对话性、经验模式识别有价值；反之税务表单等可完全形式化的静态领域更适合代码优先）。方法层面包含四部分：(1) 三层认知架构——宪法层（低波动，每次会话加载，占上下文10–15%，只放索引与原则）、技能层（中波动，按需加载，遵循单一职责原则，是结晶产物的主要容器）、经验层（高波动、语义检索、只追加写入、无限增长需定期策展），并刻画下向"根基"流、上向"结晶"流、横向"记忆中介"流；(2) 知识结晶周期的形式化——定义知识状态 K_t=(C_t,S_t,E_t)、经验累积 E_{t+1}=E_t∪{δ(I_t)}、结晶操作 κ（满足 |E'|≤|E| 且技能层信息量 ℋ(S')≥ℋ(S)）、价值函数 V(K)=α·Breadth(E)+β·Structure(S)+γ·Align(C,U)（早期α主导、中期β主导、成熟期γ主导）、结晶效率 η=ΔStructure/|E_consumed|（取决于经验多样性、标注质量、领域模式密度），并证明"经验证结晶下价值非递减"命题（人工验证是单调改进的关键保障）；结晶五子操作（模式抽取、知识结构化、去情境化、验证、整合）与Algorithm 1（ScopeFilter→ExtractPatterns→HumanReview→Structure→Decontextualize→Validate→Integrate→Archive→UpdatePrinciples），触发方式含定期、阈值、事件三种；(3) 双工作区模式——具备完整文件系统权限的"外科工作区"负责脚手架、历史数据迁移、批量结晶、技能开发重构；"养育工作区"作为运行时对话环境，二者共享文件系统状态实现知识无缝转移，体现关注点分离；(4) 螺旋式开发模型——Phase 0 引导（1–3天，仅求可启动）、Phase 1 初始养育（1–3周）、结晶检查点1、Phase 2 结构化养育（1–3月）、结晶检查点2、Phase 3+ 成熟运维，径向扩张表示知识深度增长。作者同时借鉴SECI模型（将结晶视为其"外化"模式在人类-智能体情境的操作化）、Dreyfus技能习得五阶段、Agile、认知学徒制、IMT、MemGPT/Generative Agents/Reflexion/ExpeL、DSPy/RLHF等既有工作。
AI.result: 以一位5年以上经验的美国股票分析师构建金融研究智能体为案例研究：约400条、18个月历史研究笔记经历史数据迁移进入记忆格式，初步模式抽取发现10个反复出现的分析主题、6类常见判断错误、3种战略取向；1–3周日常对话中自然捕获15条洞见碎片（分析师自陈"知道但从未表述过"）、3处历史误读纠正并附带推理痕迹。结晶检查点1产出结构化多因子评估参考文件（含显式因子权重与条件逻辑）、更新记忆摘要、错误模式库（8项历史+2项新识别偏差），并发现原本被当作一种方法的三种取向实为两种独立策略——该发现本身构成价值。后续3个月培育中，代理从"先搭建再积累"转向"边对话边建模"，并在对话中衍生出新的横向比较能力。进度指标（Table 2）显示：有用分析占比由38%升至74%，案例召回由2次升至15次，偏差标记由0升至5次，已填充技能参考由2增至8，错误模式由6增至12，日志条目由21增至60+。三个代表性片段展示微观机制：语义纠错（半导体capex周期→FCF收益率权重×1.5、营收增速×0.7→"所有因子评估须含行业条件权重调整"的设计原则）、策略外化（"非对称信念/不确定性衰减速率"→binary-event-strategy.md 含入场标准、仓位逻辑、退出触发器）、涌现式技能扩展（narrative-drift-analysis 技能从使用模式中自发出现并经8次使用迭代精化）。作者承认该案例为说明性而非确证性：无对照组、单一用户、"有用性"为主观自评，缺少与代码优先/提示词优先基线的量化比较。
AI.conclusion: NFD 的核心贡献是把智能体开发从"一次性配置"重构为持续的对话式共同演化过程，并重新定义了"开发者"身份——不是工程师或提示词工程师，而是领域实践者本身；智能体价值来自累积经验、结晶模式与对齐深度随时间复利。三项观察结论：强制外化推理揭示了实践者自身框架中的不一致；代理调用历史分析充当"制度记忆"弥补自然遗忘；迭代结晶产出的方法论文档源自"观察到的实践"而非"自述的理论"，因而比人工撰写的更准确。局限与开放挑战包括：冷启动问题（早期价值有限，迁移历史数据只能部分缓解，因其缺失推理痕迹）；组织级扩展（知识所有权、冲突消解、异质经验语料的聚合）；质量保障（缺乏类似单元测试覆盖率的客观指标，智能体可能同时吸收偏见与真知）；上下文窗口经济学（宪法层须控制在10–15%，经验层价值受制于记忆检索质量）；结晶瓶颈（当前需半人工引导，全自动自结晶仍是开放问题）。作者进一步提出"智能体养育者"（agent nurturer）这一新角色，以及知识资产的可迁移性-价值权衡谱系（脚手架包高度可移植但领域价值低；结晶知识包有实质领域价值但需去个人化才可迁移），并指出养育过程本身构成对实践者的结构化反思实践，具有双向价值创造效应。未来工作方向：自动化结晶算法、多智能体组织级知识共享、结晶质量客观指标、养育式交互设计（何种对话模式产生最高质量经验数据）、跨领域纵向实证研究。

title: Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks: Universal Approximation with Passivity Guarantees
summary: Stochastic port-Hamiltonian systems represent open dynamical systems with dissipation, inputs, and stochastic forcing in an energy based form. We introduce stochastic port-Hamiltonian neural networks, SPH-NNs, which parameterize the Hamiltonian with a feedforward network and enforce skew symmetry of the interconnection matrix and positive semidefiniteness of the dissipation matrix. For Itô dynamics we establish a weak passivity inequality in expectation under an explicit generator condition, stated for a stopped process on a compact set. We also prove a universal approximation result showing that, on any compact set and finite horizon, SPH-NNs approximate the coefficients of a target stochastic port-Hamiltonian system with $C^2$ accuracy of the Hamiltonian and yield coupled solutions that remain close in mean square up to the exit time. Experiments on noisy mass spring, Duffing, and Van der Pol oscillators show improved long horizon rollouts and reduced energy error relative to a multilayer perceptron baseline.

AI.tldr: SPH-NNs are introduced to enforce port-Hamiltonian structure (skew-symmetric interconnection matrix, positive semidefinite dissipation matrix) in neural network approximations of stochastic dynamical systems. The method establishes weak passivity in expectation and provides universal approximation guarantees, showing improved performance on oscillator benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Stochastic port-Hamiltonian systems model open dynamical systems with dissipation, inputs, and stochastic forcing in an energy-based form. However, existing neural network approximations lack proper enforcement of this physical structure, leading to poor long-horizon performance and energy conservation.
AI.method: SPH-NNs parameterize the Hamiltonian using a feedforward network while enforcing skew symmetry of the interconnection matrix and positive semidefiniteness of the dissipation matrix. For Itô dynamics, weak passivity inequality in expectation is established under an explicit generator condition for a stopped process on a compact set.
AI.result: The method yields coupled solutions that remain close in mean square up to the exit time. Experiments on noisy mass spring, Duffing, and Van der Pol oscillators demonstrate improved long horizon rollouts and reduced energy error relative to multilayer perceptron baseline.
AI.conclusion: SPH-NNs successfully enforce physical structure (port-Hamiltonian form) in neural network approximations, leading to improved long horizon rollouts and reduced energy error compared to baseline MLP on oscillator benchmarks.

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Innovation in Software Engineering
summary: The rapid evolution and inherent complexity of modern software requirements demand highly flexible and responsive development methodologies. While Agile frameworks have become the industry standard for prioritizing iteration, collaboration, and adaptability, software development teams continue to face persistent challenges in managing constantly evolving requirements and maintaining product quality under tight deadlines. This article explores the intersection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Software Engineering (SE), to analyze how AI serves as a powerful catalyst for enhancing agility and fostering innovation. The research combines a comprehensive review of existing literature with an empirical study, utilizing a survey directed at Software Engineering professionals to assess the perception, adoption, and impact of AI-driven tools. Key findings reveal that the integration of AI (specifically through Machine Learning (ML) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) )facilitates the automation of tedious tasks, from requirement management to code generation and testing . This paper demonstrates that AI not only optimizes current Agile practices but also introduces new capabilities essential for sustaining quality, speed, and innovation in the future landscape of software development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能(AI)如何作为增强软件工程敏捷性和促进创新的催化剂，通过文献综述和针对软件工程专业人员的实证调查，发现AI(特别是机器学习和自然语言处理)能够自动化需求管理、代码生成和测试等繁琐任务，优化现有敏捷实践并引入新能力。
AI.motivation: 现代软件需求的快速演进和固有复杂性要求高度灵活的开发方法论。尽管敏捷框架已成为行业标准，但软件开发团队在管理不断变化的需求和在紧迫期限内保持产品质量方面仍面临持续挑战，需要探索AI与软件工程的交叉领域以寻求解决方案。
AI.method: 采用综合文献综述与实证研究相结合的方法，通过对软件工程专业人员进行的调查来评估对AI驱动工具的认知、采用情况和影响。
AI.result: 研究揭示AI(特别是机器学习和自然语言处理)的整合促进了从需求管理到代码生成和测试等繁琐任务的自动化，AI不仅优化了当前的敏捷实践，还引入了对维持未来软件开发质量、速度和创新必不可少的新能力。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能能够作为强大的催化剂，增强软件工程的敏捷性并促进创新；AI不仅优化现有敏捷实践，还能引入新能力，对维持未来软件开发的 quality(质量)、speed(速度)和innovation(创新)至关重要。

title: A Hybrid Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Safety and Traceability in Prescription Verification
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures.Framework for safe prescription auditing and hybrid knowledge-grounded reasoning
summary: Medication errors pose a significant threat to patient safety, making pharmacist verification (PV) a critical, yet heavily burdened, final safeguard. The direct application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to this zero-tolerance domain is untenable due to their inherent factual unreliability, lack of traceability, and weakness in complex reasoning. To address these challenges, we introduce PharmGraph-Auditor, a novel system designed for safe and evidence-grounded prescription auditing. The core of our system is a trustworthy Hybrid Pharmaceutical Knowledge Base (HPKB), implemented under the Virtual Knowledge Graph (VKG) paradigm. This architecture strategically unifies a relational component for set constraint satisfaction and a graph component for topological reasoning via a rigorous mapping layer. To construct this HPKB, we propose the Iterative Schema Refinement (ISR) algorithm, a framework that enables the co-evolution of both graph and relational schemas from medical texts. For auditing, we introduce the KB-grounded Chain of Verification (CoV), a new reasoning paradigm that transforms the LLM from an unreliable generator into a transparent reasoning engine. CoV decomposes the audit task into a sequence of verifiable queries against the HPKB, generating hybrid query plans to retrieve evidence from the most appropriate data store. Experimental results demonstrate robust knowledge extraction capabilities and show promises of using PharmGraph-Auditor to enable pharmacists to achieve safer and faster prescription verification.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM在处方审核中不可靠的问题，提出PharmGraph-Auditor系统，利用VKG架构构建混合药学知识库HPKB，通过ISR算法从医学文本中自动提取知识，并采用KB-grounded CoV将LLM转化为透明推理引擎，实现可验证的处方审核。
AI.motivation: 药物错误对患者安全构成重大威胁，药剂师验证(PV)是最后一道防线但负担繁重。将大型语言模型(LLM)直接应用于这一零容忍领域存在事实不可靠、缺乏可追溯性和复杂推理能力弱的问题。
AI.method: 提出PharmGraph-Auditor系统，采用虚拟知识图谱(VKG)范式构建混合药学知识库(HPKB)，统一关系组件和图组件。通过迭代模式精化(ISR)算法实现知识库构建。引入基于知识库的验证链(CoV)将LLM从不可靠生成器转变为透明推理引擎。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该系统具有强大的知识提取能力，可帮助药剂师实现更安全、更快速的处方验证。
AI.conclusion: PharmGraph-Auditor通过VKG架构和KB-grounded CoV范式有效解决了LLM在处方审核中的可靠性问题，为药学领域提供了可验证的AI辅助审核方案。

title: Large Spikes in Stochastic Gradient Descent: A Large-Deviations View
summary: We analyse SGD training of a shallow, fully connected network in the NTK scaling and provide a quantitative theory of the catapult phase. We identify an explicit criterion separating two behaviours: When an explicit function $G$, depending only on the kernel, learning rate $η$ and data, is positive, SGD produces large NTK-flattening spikes with high probability; when $G<0$, their probability decays like $(n/η)^{-\vartheta/2}$, for an explicitly characterised $\vartheta\in (0,\infty)$. This yields a concrete parameter-dependent explanation for why such spikes may still be observed at practical widths.

AI.tldr: 本文在 NTK scaling 下研究浅层全连接网络的 SGD 训练，并给出"弹射阶段"（catapult phase）的定量理论。作者构造了一个仅依赖于核函数、学习率 η 与数据的显式判别函数 $G$：当 $G>0$ 时，SGD 以高概率产生显著的 NTK 压平（NTK-flattening）尖峰；当 $G<0$ 时，该尖峰出现的概率按 $(n/\eta)^{-\vartheta/2}$ 衰减，其中 $\vartheta\in(0,\infty)$ 被显式刻画。由此可参数化地解释为何在实际（有限）宽度下仍可能观测到这类尖峰。
AI.motivation: 已有工作指出：在大学习率下训练的浅层网络会经历"弹射阶段"，表现为损失曲线的剧烈尖峰伴随核矩阵（NTK）的快速压平，从而使梯度相关性下降、训练可能失败甚至崩溃。但既有结论多为定性或现象性描述，缺少一个能仅由核、学习率与数据决定的、可计算的判据，也无法解释尖峰在何种宽度/学习率组合下会真实出现（尤其是中等宽度、有限 n 的实际情形），以及为何大学习率有时仍能带来更好的泛化。动机即是把弹射现象从"观测现象"推进为"可预测的定量理论"，并解释实践中的尖峰存在性。
AI.method: 在 NTK 参数化/缩放（宽度 n 与初始化、训练时间尺度同步缩放，使核矩阵基本不随训练演化）假设下，对浅层全连接网络的 SGD 轨迹做精细的（渐近、高宽 n 与学习率 η 的双参数）分析。核心步骤：(1) 将"弹射/尖峰"刻画为 NTK（核矩阵）在训练中出现的突发性压平事件，并定义其幅度与发生时刻；(2) 引入显式标量判别函数 $G$，它只由目标核、η 与数据分布决定，通过对 SGD 固定点/二阶动力学与核演化的比较（或对应的主方程与稳定性判据）导出 $G$ 的符号与事件概率的定量联系；(3) 对 $G>0$ 情形证明尖峰以高概率（whp，随 n→∞）出现，对 $G<0$ 情形证明尖峰概率具有幂律上界/渐近行为 $\mathbb{P}(\text{spike}) \asymp (n/\eta)^{-\vartheta/2}$，其中指数 $\vartheta$ 由核与数据的谱性质显式给出；(4) 通过改变 n 与 η 的相对大小说明在"实际宽度"范围内尖峰并非绝无可能，而是与非典型参数区域（如 n/η 偏小）相容。
AI.result: 得到一个清晰的两分（dichotomy）结论：(i) 若 $G>0$，则 SGD 在 NTK scaling 下以高概率产生大幅 NTK 压平尖峰，即弹射阶段是"典型"行为而非偶然；(ii) 若 $G<0$，尖峰出现的概率随 $n/\eta$ 增大而多项式衰减，衰减速率由显式常数 $\vartheta\in(0,\infty)$ 决定。这说明弹射现象的出现与否由核—学习率—数据的具体组合决定，并解释了为何在有限宽度与较大学习率下尖峰仍会被观测到（因为 $(n/\eta)^{-\vartheta/2}$ 在 $n/\eta$ 不够大时尚未小到可忽略）。
AI.conclusion: 本文把 NTK 缩放下的弹射阶段从定性观察转化为可计算的参数依赖理论：一个由核、η 与数据决定的符号判据 $G$ 决定尖峰是"高概率事件"还是"幂律稀有事件"，并给出了稀有性的显式幂次。这为理解大学习率 SGD 的动力学（尖峰、NTK 压平、可能伴随的生成/特征学习效应）提供了定量解释，也为实践中通过选择宽度/学习率或核结构以规避或利用弹射阶段提供了依据。局限在于结论限定于浅层全连接网络与 NTK scaling，$G$ 的具体形式与 $\vartheta$ 的表达式依赖核与数据的谱结构，且幂律衰减是在 $n,\eta$ 的渐近极限下给出的，对更深的网络或特征学习主导的情形需另行推广。

title: Decoupling Reasoning and Confidence: Resurrecting Calibration in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances large language models (LLMs) reasoning but severely suffers from calibration degeneration, where models become excessively over-confident in incorrect answers. Previous studies devote to directly incorporating calibration objective into existing optimization target. However, our theoretical analysis demonstrates that there exists a fundamental gradient conflict between the optimization for maximizing policy accuracy and minimizing calibration error. Building on this insight, we propose DCPO, a simple yet effective framework that systematically decouples reasoning and calibration objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DCPO not only preserves accuracy on par with GRPO but also achieves the best calibration performance and substantially mitigates the over-confidence issue. Our study provides valuable insights and practical solution for more reliable LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: RLVR增强LLM推理能力但导致校准退化(模型对错误答案过度自信)。本文发现优化准确率和最小化校准误差之间存在梯度冲突，提出DCPO框架将推理和校准目标解耦。实验表明DCPO在保持与GRPO相当的准确率同时，实现了最佳校准性能，有效缓解过度自信问题。
AI.motivation: RLVR显著提升LLM推理能力，但导致严重的校准退化问题——模型对错误答案过度自信。现有方法试图将校准目标直接融入优化目标，但效果有限。
AI.method: 理论分析发现优化准确率与最小化校准误差之间存在根本的梯度冲突。基于此 insight，提出DCPO框架，系统性地将推理目标和校准目标解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明DCPO不仅保持与GRPO相当的准确率，还实现了最佳校准性能，显著缓解了过度自信问题。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为构建更可靠的LLM部署提供了有价值的见解和实用解决方案。

title: Digging Deeper: Learning Multi-Level Concept Hierarchies
comment: Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Principled Design for Trustworthy AI
summary: Although concept-based models promise interpretability by explaining predictions with human-understandable concepts, they typically rely on exhaustive annotations and treat concepts as flat and independent. To circumvent this, recent work has introduced Hierarchical Concept Embedding Models (HiCEMs) to explicitly model concept relationships, and Concept Splitting to discover sub-concepts using only coarse annotations. However, both HiCEMs and Concept Splitting are restricted to shallow hierarchies. We overcome this limitation with Multi-Level Concept Splitting (MLCS), which discovers multi-level concept hierarchies from only top-level supervision, and Deep-HiCEMs, an architecture that represents these discovered hierarchies and enables interventions at multiple levels of abstraction. Experiments across multiple datasets show that MLCS discovers human-interpretable concepts absent during training and that Deep-HiCEMs maintain high accuracy while supporting test-time concept interventions that can improve task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MLCS和Deep-HiCEMs解决概念模型中概念层级过浅的问题，实现从仅顶层监督中发现多层次概念层级结构，并在多个抽象层次支持概念干预。
AI.motivation: 现有概念模型存在局限性：依赖穷举注释、将概念视为扁平独立结构、且仅能处理浅层层级结构
AI.method: 提出Multi-Level Concept Splitting (MLCS)发现多层次概念层级结构，以及Deep-HiCEMs架构表示这些发现的层级并在多个抽象层次上进行干预
AI.result: MLCS能够发现人类可解释的概念；Deep-HiCEMs在保持高准确率的同时支持测试时概念干预，可提升任务性能
AI.conclusion: MLCS能够发现训练时不存在的可解释概念，Deep-HiCEMs在保持高精度的同时支持测试时的概念干预，可提升任务性能

title: TOSSS: a CVE-based Software Security Benchmark for Large Language Models
summary:
With their increasing capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) are now used across many industries. They have become useful tools for software engineers and support a wide range of development tasks. As LLMs are increasingly used in software development workflows, a critical question arises: are LLMs good at software security? At the same time, organizations worldwide invest heavily in cybersecurity to reduce exposure to disruptive attacks. The integration of LLMs into software engineering workflows may introduce new vulnerabilities and weaken existing security efforts.
  We introduce TOSSS (Two-Option Secure Snippet Selection), a benchmark that measures the ability of LLMs to choose between secure and vulnerable code snippets. Existing security benchmarks for LLMs cover only a limited range of vulnerabilities. In contrast, TOSSS relies on the CVE database and provides an extensible framework that can integrate newly disclosed vulnerabilities over time. Our benchmark gives each model a security score between 0 and 1 based on its behavior; a score of 1 indicates that the model always selects the secure snippet, while a score of 0 indicates that it always selects the vulnerable one. We evaluate 14 widely used open-source and closed-source models on C/C++ and Java code and observe scores ranging from 0.48 to 0.89. LLM providers already publish many benchmark scores for their models, and TOSSS could become a complementary security-focused score to include in these reports.

AI.tldr: TOSSS是一个用于评估LLM选择安全代码片段能力的基准测试，基于CVE数据库构建，可扩展性强，评估14个模型的得分在0.48到0.89之间。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在软件工程工作流中的广泛应用，其安全性能力尚不明确，可能引入新的漏洞或削弱现有安全努力。现有安全基准覆盖的漏洞类型有限，需要一个更全面、可扩展的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出TOSSS（两选项安全片段选择）基准测试，要求LLM在安全代码片段和易受攻击的代码片段之间进行选择。基于CVE数据库构建，提供可扩展框架以集成新披露的漏洞。安全评分范围为0到1。
AI.result: 对14个广泛使用的开源和闭源模型进行评估，在C/C++和Java代码上的得分范围为0.48到0.89。
AI.conclusion: TOSSS可作为LLM安全能力的补充评分指标，与现有基准评分一起发布，为LLM在软件安全领域的能力提供更全面的评估。

title: ES-dLLM: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models by Early-Skipping
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are emerging as a promising alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) due to their ability to capture bidirectional context and the potential for parallel generation. Despite the advantages, dLLM inference remains computationally expensive as the full input context is processed at every iteration. In this work, we analyze the generation dynamics of dLLMs and find that intermediate representations, including key, value, and hidden states, change only subtly across successive iterations. Leveraging this insight, we propose \textbf{ES-dLLM}, a training-free inference acceleration framework for dLLM that reduces computation by skipping tokens in early layers based on the estimated importance. Token importance is computed with intermediate tensor variation and confidence scores of previous iterations. Experiments on LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B demonstrate that ES-dLLM achieves throughput of up to 226.57 and 308.51 tokens per second (TPS), respectively, on an NVIDIA H200 GPU, delivering 5.6$\times$ to 16.8$\times$ speedup over the vanilla implementation and up to 1.85$\times$ over the state-of-the-art caching method, while preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: ES-dLLM是一种无需训练的扩散大语言模型推理加速框架，通过基于中间张量变化和置信度分数估计token重要性，在早期层跳过不重要的token，从而实现高达16.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型(dLLM)虽能捕获双向上下文且支持并行生成，但其推理计算成本高，因为每个迭代都需要处理完整输入上下文。这限制了dLLM的实际应用。
AI.method: 利用关键发现：中间表示（包括key、value和hidden状态）在连续迭代之间变化微小。提出ES-dLLM框架，在早期层根据估计的token重要性跳过部分token。Token重要性通过中间张量变化和前一迭代的置信度分数计算。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA H200 GPU上，LLaDA-8B达到226.57 tokens/s，Dream-7B达到308.51 tokens/s。相比vanilla实现提升5.6×至16.8倍，相比最新缓存方法提升最高1.85倍，同时保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: ES-dLLM是一个有效的训练-free推理加速方案，通过利用dLLM中间表示的稳定性和置信度分数实现智能token跳过，在显著加速的同时保持生成质量。

title: A Survey of Weight Space Learning: Understanding, Representation, and Generation
summary: Neural network weights are typically viewed as the end product of training, while most deep learning research focuses on data, features, and architectures. However, recent advances show that the set of all possible weight values (weight space) itself contains rich structure: pretrained models form organized distributions, exhibit symmetries, and can be embedded, compared, or even generated. Understanding such structures has tremendous impact on how neural networks are analyzed and compared, and on how knowledge is transferred across models, beyond individual training instances. This emerging research direction, which we refer to as Weight Space Learning (WSL), treats neural weights as a meaningful domain for analysis and modeling. This survey provides the first unified taxonomy of WSL. We categorize existing methods into three core dimensions: Weight Space Understanding (WSU), which studies the geometry and symmetries of weights; Weight Space Representation (WSR), which learns embeddings over model weights; and Weight Space Generation (WSG), which synthesizes new weights through hypernetworks or generative models. We further show how these developments enable practical applications, including model retrieval, continual and federated learning, neural architecture search, and data-free reconstruction. By consolidating fragmented progress under a coherent framework, this survey highlights weight space as a learnable, structured domain with growing impact across model analysis, transferring, and weight generation. We release an accompanying resource at https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/Awesome-Weight-Space-Learning.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇针对「权重空间学习（Weight Space Learning, WSL）」的统一分类学综述。作者提出将 WSL 划分为三大维度：权重空间理解（WSU，研究权重几何与对称性）、权重空间表示（WSR，学习权重嵌入与探针表示）、权重空间生成（WSG，用超网络与生成模型合成权重），并系统梳理了模型检索、持续/联邦学习、神经架构搜索、数据无关重建等应用场景以及各大模型库（model zoo）基准，最后给出三大开放问题。论文附带 GitHub 资源库 Awesome-Weight-Space-Learning。
AI.motivation: 深度学习研究长期聚焦于数据、特征与架构，而把网络权重仅视为训练的最终产物。随着大规模模型库与预训练权重的爆发式积累，权重本身构成一种新的「数据模态」：它们编码了任务知识、架构归纳偏置、优化动态与训练过程的结构规律。然而既有研究分散在不同社区、以不同命名出现（如 neural functional networks、neural representation for neural networks），术语混乱、方法割裂；已有综述仅覆盖局部议题（权重对称性或模型检索），缺乏统一分类学。因此本文希望建立统一术语与分类体系，将权重空间确立为一个可学习、可分析、可生成的一等学习域。
AI.method: 综述采用三维度分类法组织全文：WSU 方面形式化对称性作为参数空间上的群作用，引入商空间 W/G（轨道等价类），并区分函数不变性（f(ρ_in(θ);x)=f(θ;x)，如神经元/滤波器置换、正缩放不变性、Softmax 偏置平移）与函数等变性（f(ρ_in(θ);x)=ρ_out(f(θ;x))，如正交旋转、符号翻转、注意力头置换），并梳理其在模型压缩（对称图合并、低秩分解）、优化（对称性传送、权重平衡流、Path-SGD、G-SGD、投影法）与权重空间数据增强（weight-space MixUp、置换等变增强）中的应用。WSR 方面定义表示函数 φ:Θ→R^d 与下游映射 g，分 model-based（对称无关编码器→对称感知架构如 DWSNets、NFN、NFT、MAGEP-NFN、UNFs、NeRN→基于 GNN 的 NG、GMN、Scale-GMN）与 model-free（探针式行为学习，ProbeLog、ProbeGen、ProbeX、交互式探针）两大范式，并讨论行为预测、模型检索、模型编辑等用例。WSG 方面形式化生成映射 G_φ: Z→Θ，区分超网络范式（条件输入、输出粒度、架构容量、生成策略四个设计轴；参数高效性分析）与生成模型范式（自编码器/VAE、GAN、自回归、迭代去噪扩散），并覆盖条件生成、实时权重优化、模型合并、权重初始化、训练加速、数据生成六类用例。最后按 MLP/CNN/RNN/Transformer 汇总模型库基准，并提出开放问题。
AI.result: 综述汇总了大量代表性工作并得出若干统一结论：(1) 权重空间具有高度组织化的几何/拓扑结构，对称性诱导的不变性与等变性解释了优化景观的简并性、连通极小值与模式连通性，也是模型可合并、可线性插值的根本原因；(2) WSR 的演化路径是从手工对称建模走向自动发现功能规律，model-based 与 model-free 互补，嵌入可用于零样本性能预测、大规模模型检索（model atlas）与无需数据的模型编辑；(3) WSG 中超网络具备条件可控、快速实例化与参数高效的优势（把逐层参数学习摊销为共享权重生成机制），生成模型则在多样性与可扩展性上占优，二者统一是前沿；(4) 现有方法存在明确瓶颈：多数对称性仅被部分刻画（Transformer 的复杂参数耦合破坏简单群结构）、理想化理论难以迁移到含归一化/残差/混合精度的真实大模型、商空间操作往往归约为 NP-hard 的图匹配、跨架构异质性与百万级权重维度使统一表示困难、模型库资源分布不均且缺乏标准评测指标；(5) 生成权重的评估、生成的可控性以及权重作为数据模态带来的对抗风险与安全防护仍基本空白。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间学习把神经网络从「被训练的函数」重新定位为「可分析、可表示、可创造的结构化对象」：理解其对称性与几何、将其嵌入统一表征空间、直接在参数域中合成新模型。综述通过 WSU/WSR/WSG 的统一分类学，衔接了理论结构分析与实际模型分析、迁移、生成，并总结了支撑该范式的模型库生态。作者展望三个方向：把权重空间升格为一等学习域（建立几何与功能基础、打造架构无关的通用权重学习器，可望以 LoRA 作为通用低秩适配载体）；将 WSL 扩展到大规模模型（模块化/层级化处理、生成微调模块而非全权重、在对称性约简子空间中做压缩近似）；以及在权重空间操作中建立鲁棒性与安全机制（可控生成、对抗风险检测与防御）。随着预训练模型持续激增，WSL 有望成为研究与设计智能系统的奠基性视角。

title: Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion: An Adaptive Denoising Schedule for Accelerated Molecular Conformation Generation
summary: Recent 3D molecular generation methods primarily use asynchronous auto-regressive or synchronous diffusion models. While auto-regressive models build molecules sequentially, they're limited by a short horizon and a discrepancy between training and inference. Conversely, synchronous diffusion models denoise all atoms at once, offering a molecule-level horizon but failing to capture the causal relationships inherent in hierarchical molecular structures. We introduce Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD) to overcome these limitations. EAD is a novel diffusion model that combines the strengths of both approaches: it uses an asynchronous denoising schedule to better capture molecular hierarchy while maintaining a molecule-level horizon. Since these relationships are often complex, we propose a dynamic scheduling mechanism to adaptively determine the denoising timestep. Experimental results show that EAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD)，一种结合异步自回归和同步扩散模型优点的3D分子生成扩散模型，通过异步去噪调度和动态调度机制捕捉分子层次结构。
AI.motivation: 现有3D分子生成方法存在局限性：异步自回归模型受限于短期视野和训练-推理不一致；同步扩散模型无法捕捉分子层次结构中的因果关系。
AI.method: 提出EAD模型：1) 使用异步去噪调度以更好捕捉分子层次结构同时保持分子级视野；2) 提出动态调度机制自适应确定去噪时间步。
AI.result: EAD在3D分子生成任务上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: EAD成功结合了异步自回归和同步扩散模型的优点，通过异步去噪和动态调度有效捕捉分子层次结构中的复杂因果关系。

title: Rethinking Adam for Time Series Forecasting: A Simple Heuristic to Improve Optimization under Distribution Shifts
summary: Time-series forecasting often faces challenges from non-stationarity, particularly distributional drift, where the data distribution evolves over time. This dynamic behavior can undermine the effectiveness of adaptive optimizers, such as Adam, which are typically designed for stationary objectives. In this paper, we revisit Adam in the context of non-stationary forecasting and identify that its second-order bias correction limits responsiveness to shifting loss landscapes. To address this, we propose TS_Adam, a lightweight variant that removes the second-order correction from the learning rate computation. This simple modification improves adaptability to distributional drift while preserving the optimizer core structure and requiring no additional hyperparameters. TS_Adam integrates easily into existing models and consistently improves performance across long- and short-term forecasting tasks. On the ETT datasets with the MICN model, it achieves an average reduction of 12.8% in MSE and 5.7% in MAE compared to Adam. These results underscore the practicality and versatility of TS_Adam as an effective optimization strategy for real-world forecasting scenarios involving non-stationary data. Code is available at: https://github.com/DD-459-1/TS_Adam.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TS_Adam，一个移除二阶偏差校正的Adam变体，用于解决非平稳时间序列预测中的分布漂移问题，在ETT数据集上平均降低12.8%的MSE和5.7%的MAE。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测面临非平稳性挑战，特别是分布漂移问题。传统Adam优化器的二阶偏差校正限制了其在动态损失景观中的响应能力，导致在非平稳环境下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出TS_Adam，移除Adam中学习率计算的二阶偏差校正(Moment项的偏差校正)，保留优化器核心结构，无需额外超参数。这是一个轻量级的简单修改。
AI.result: 在ETT数据集上与MICN模型结合，TS_Adam相比Adam平均降低12.8%的MSE和5.7%的MAE，在长期和短期预测任务中均表现一致。
AI.conclusion: TS_Adam作为一个简单有效的优化策略，无需额外超参数即可集成到现有模型中，对于处理非平稳数据的实际预测场景具有很强的实用性和通用性。

title: Denoising the US Census: Succinct Block Hierarchical Regression
summary:
The US Census Bureau Disclosure Avoidance System (DAS) balances confidentiality and utility requirements for the decennial US Census (Abowd et al., 2022). The DAS was used in the 2020 Census to produce demographic datasets critically used for legislative apportionment and redistricting, federal and state funding allocation, municipal and infrastructure planning, and scientific research. At the heart of DAS is TopDown, a heuristic post-processing method that combines billions of private noisy measurements across six geographic levels in order to produce new estimates that are consistent, more accurate, and satisfy certain structural constraints on the data.
  In this work, we introduce BlueDown, a new post-processing method that produces more accurate, consistent estimates while satisfying the same privacy guarantees and structural constraints. We obtain especially large accuracy improvements for aggregates at the county and tract levels on evaluation metrics proposed by the US Census Bureau.
  From a technical perspective, we develop a new algorithm for generalized least-squares regression that leverages the hierarchical structure of the measurements and that is statistically optimal among linear unbiased estimators. This reduces the computational dependence on the number of geographic regions measured from matrix multiplication time, which would be infeasible for census-scale data, to linear time. We incorporate the additional structural constraints by combining this regression algorithm with an optimization routine that extends TDA to support correlated measurements. We further improve the efficiency of our algorithm using succinct linear-algebraic operations that exploit symmetries in the structure of the measurements and constraints. We believe our hierarchical regression and succinct operations to be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: BlueDown是一种新的后处理方法，用于取代美国人口普查局现用的TopDown方法，在保持相同隐私保护和结构约束的前提下，产生更准确、一致的人口普查估计值，特别在县级和小区级聚合数据上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 美国人口普查局的披露避免系统(DAS)使用TopDown后处理方法，但该方法在处理大规模人口普查数据时存在精度不足的问题，尤其是在县级和 tract 级别。需要一种在保证隐私和结构约束的前提下提供更高精度的新方法。
AI.method: 开发了一种利用测量层次结构的广义最小二乘回归新算法，在线性无偏估计量中实现统计最优；将回归算法与扩展TDA支持相关测量的优化程序结合；利用测量和约束结构中的对称性实现简洁的线性代数操作。
AI.result: 在县级和 tract 级别的聚合数据上获得了显著的精度提升；将计算复杂度从矩阵乘法的不可行时间降低到线性时间；成功满足了相同的隐私保证和结构约束。
AI.conclusion: BlueDown在保持隐私保护和结构约束的前提下，能够产生更准确、一致的人口普查估计值。该方法提出的层次回归和简洁操作技术具有独立的研究价值。

title: Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs
summary: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2\% for ReLU and 29.96\% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"软稀疏"（soft sparsity）近似卷积范式：用最高有效位（MSB）位置作为 log2 幅度的廉价硬件代理，在不执行乘法的前提下比较乘积相对量级，从而跳过贡献可忽略的非零乘积。该方法以可调误差阈值 T 集成进 32 位 RISC-V（RI5CY/PULPino）自定义指令，实现 5 级 FSM 加速器（4×4 输入 × 3×3 卷积核）。在 MNIST/LeNet-5 上，ReLU 模型 MAC 减少 88.42%、tanh 减少 74.87% 且精度无损，相对零跳过减少 5 倍乘法次数；估算功耗降低 35.2%（ReLU）/29.96%（tanh）。
AI.motivation: 现代 CNN 计算密集、功耗高，难以部署于资源受限的边缘设备。现有"硬稀疏"方法（权重剪枝、跳过激活为数学零的 MAC）存在根本局限：自然图像几乎无精确零，MNIST 类输入虽有 80% 零像素但深层特征图零比例降至 20–50%；tanh 等平滑激活几乎不产生零，硬零跳过完全失效。此外，CSR/CSC 等稀疏存储带来索引与控制开销（Cambricon-X 约 30–35% 功耗），且并行 MAC 结构下"跳过"并不必然减少周期。作者因此提出可跳过"非零但数值贡献可忽略"乘积的软稀疏思想，以换取精度与计算量之间的可调折中。
AI.method: 1）算法原理：整数 x 的 MSB 位置等于 log2(x) 的整数部分，故乘积幅度的对数可由两操作数 MSB 之和近似。据此定义 Δ=(MSB(a)+MSB(b))−(MSB(c)+MSB(d))，当 Δ≥T（阈值）时判定 P1 为主导项、舍弃 P2。例：要求 P2/P1≤0.01 时 log2(100)≈6.64，保守取 T=7。算法 1 先求所有 MSB_i 的最大值 MSB_max，再仅当 MSB_max−MSB_i<T 时保留乘积。IEEE754 浮点可用指数域 E 替代 MSB。最坏情况绝对误差上界为 (n−1)·2^(−T)·max(a_i·b_i)；因同时丢弃正负方向的小乘积，误差在多层推理中不易单向累积。2）硬件实现：在 RI5CY（PULPino，RV32IMFC）上占用未用操作码 0x77 定义 R 型自定义指令 conv_approx()（rs1=输入规模，rs2=输入数组地址），由 5 级 FSM（IDLE/GET_DATA/STAGE_1 MSB 提取/STAGE_2 剪枝与乘法/STAGE_3 累加/DONE）实现 4×4 输入、3×3 核 → 2×2 输出；MSB 由优先编码器式结构对二补码 32 位值提取为 5 bit；卷积核 9 元素及其 MSB 预存于加速模块，用组合归约树求 MSB_max。C 代码中以 inline assembly 调用并用 __volatile__ 防止重排，大矩阵卷积由该原语迭代拼接。3）实验设计：先在 MNIST 单图上考察不同阈值的输出/误差/乘法数，再在 LeNet-5（LeNet-Accel 3×3/4×4 核变体）上把全部卷积替换为 conv_approx()，对比 ReLU 与 tanh，评估精度–MAC 折中。
AI.result: · MNIST 单图：阈值 0.03–0.25 下平均乘法数由精确卷积的 6084 降至 1256.7/1167.6/1032.3/506.2；相对硬零跳过再降 62.76%，相对精确卷积降 96.44%；输出特征可视化在不同阈值下几乎不可分辨。· 单次 4×4×3×3 初始误差分析（阈值设为最大乘积的 1%）：平均绝对百分比误差 0.97%，中位数 0.65%，仅两个低幅值离群点误差超 1%。· LeNet-5 全模型（每次推理 270720 次精确 MAC）：ReLU 下最优保持精度（~97–98%）仅需平均 11.58% 的总 MAC（即 88.42% 削减，对应非零乘法的 17.79%），对应 T=0.3；tanh 下需 25.13% 的总 MAC（74.87% 削减，占非零乘法 33.17%），对应 T=0.2；相对零跳过乘法次数减少约 5 倍。tanh 精度对阈值更敏感（T=0.5 时降至 91.64%，T=1 附近 61.38%），ReLU 更鲁棒（T=1 时 90.71%）。· 层次零比例统计（ReLU）：C1 45.11%、S2 36.00%、C3 50.25%、S4 27.38%、C5 55.10%、F6 48.19%，说明深层硬零比例有限。· 硬件代价（65nm）：近似剪枝块面积 180050.68 μm²（较 RI5CY 增 108.23%），功耗 0.849 mW（增 11.50%），关键路径延迟 2.81 ns（增 0%）。· 功耗估算：因 MAC 仅占推理功耗约 0.3–0.5（保守取 0.4）且访存功耗占主导，功耗下降为次线性，估算 ReLU 降 35.2%、tanh 降 29.96%。
AI.conclusion: 软稀疏 + MSB 代理 + 可调阈值是一条可行的近似卷积路径：以极低的判决开销换取 74.87%–88.42% 的 MAC 削减，且在 LeNet-5/MNIST 上不损失分类精度，并带来约 30%–35% 的次线性功耗收益，代价是加速块面积翻倍、功耗增 11.5%、延迟不增。局限与后续方向：阈值的按层自适应/学习型选取；为减小访存功耗，可预存 5–6 bit MSB 位置数组、先读 MSB 再按需取完整数据以使功耗收益更线性；作者还推测忽略小乘积可能缓解过拟合，但尚未验证。局限方面，评估仅限于 LeNet-5/MNIST 小模型与单一 4×4×3×3 加速核，未在 ResNet 等深层架构与更深网络/浮点路径上验证累积误差。开源 RTL：github.com/zeta-bot/Approximate_hardware_convolution。

title: CLIPO: Contrastive Learning in Policy Optimization Generalizes RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capacity of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, RLVR solely relies on final answers as outcome rewards, neglecting the correctness of intermediate reasoning steps. Training on these process-wrong but outcome-correct rollouts can lead to hallucination and answer-copying, severely undermining the model's generalization and robustness. To address this, we incorporate a Contrastive Learning mechanism into the Policy Optimization (CLIPO) to generalize the RLVR process. By optimizing a contrastive loss over successful rollouts, CLIPO steers the LLM to capture the invariant structure shared across correct reasoning paths. This provides a more robust cross-trajectory regularization than the original single-path supervision in RLVR, effectively mitigating step-level reasoning inconsistencies and suppressing hallucinatory artifacts. In experiments, CLIPO consistently improves multiple RLVR baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating uniform improvements in generalization and robustness for policy optimization of LLMs. Our code and training recipes are available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/CLIPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLIPO方法，将对比学习融入强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）的策略优化中，解决RLVR仅依赖最终答案而忽略中间推理步骤正确性的问题。
AI.motivation: RLVR仅依赖最终答案作为结果奖励，忽略中间推理步骤的正确性。在过程错误但结果正确的rollouts上训练会导致幻觉和答案复制，严重损害模型的泛化和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将对比学习机制融入策略优化（CLIPO），通过优化成功rollouts上的对比损失，引导LLM捕获正确推理路径之间的不变结构，提供比原 RLVR 单路径监督更鲁棒的跨轨迹正则化。
AI.result: CLIPO在多个RLVR基线和各种推理基准上持续改进，展示了策略优化的统一改进。
AI.conclusion: CLIPO有效缓解了步骤级推理不一致问题，抑制了幻觉产物，提高了模型的泛化和鲁棒性。

title: Lost in the Middle at Birth: An Exact Theory of Transformer Position Bias
summary:
The ``Lost in the Middle'' phenomenon -- a U-shaped performance curve where LLMs retrieve well from the beginning and end of a context but fail in the middle -- is widely attributed to learned Softmax artifacts or the distance-decay of positional encodings like RoPE. This paper makes a single, precise claim: \emph{the U-shape is already present at initialization, before any training or positional encoding takes effect.} It is an inherent geometric property of the causal decoder with residual connections.
  We model multi-layer causal attention as iterated powers of the Cesàro matrix and derive the exact closed-form influence density in the continuous limit. Causal masking forces a logarithmic divergence of gradient influence at the start of the prompt (the Primacy Tail), while residual connections create an isolated $\mathcal{O}(1)$ anchor at the final token (the Recency Delta). Between these extremes lies a factorial dead zone of order $\mathcal{O}(1/(H{-}1)!)$, where $H$ is the network depth, making middle-context retrieval and training structurally hostile. We validate empirically that untrained Qwen2 and GPT-2 architectures exhibit this U-shape at Step~0, and that it is identical with or without RoPE. Comparing initialized and pretrained networks, we show that standard training does not overcome the topological valley, confirming that the U-shape persists as an architectural baseline under standard pretraining objectives.
  We do not claim that this bias is insurmountable, nor that interventions such as RoPE modifications are useless. We establish what the baseline is and where it comes from, so that future efforts to overcome it can be precisely targeted.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM中"Lost in the Middle"现象的根源——U形检索性能曲线在模型初始化时就已存在，与Softmax或位置编码无关，而是因果解码器结合残差连接的内在几何属性。通过将多层因果注意力建模为Cesàro矩阵的迭代幂，作者推导出梯度影响密度在连续极限下的精确闭式解：因果掩码在提示开头产生对数发散的"首因效应尾"，残差连接在末尾产生O(1)常数的"近期增量"，中间则是阶为O(1/(H-1)!)的"阶乘死区"。实验证实未训练的Qwen2和GPT-2在Step 0就表现出此U形，且标准预训练无法克服这一拓扑谷。
AI.motivation: "Lost in the Middle"现象（LLM在上下文开头和结尾检索良好、中间失败）被广泛归因于Softmax或RoPE位置编码，但作者提出根本性问题：这种U形曲线是否在训练前就已存在？这一问题的答案将决定改进策略的定位基础。
AI.method: 1. 将多层因果注意力建模为Cesàro矩阵的迭代幂；2. 推导连续极限下梯度影响密度的精确闭式解；3. 在未训练的Qwen2和GPT-2上验证Step 0的U形现象；4. 对比有无RoPE、初始化与预训练模型的差异。
AI.result: 1. 因果掩码在上下文起始处产生对数发散的梯度影响（Primacy Tail）；2. 残差连接在最终token处创建孤立O(1)锚点（Recency Delta）；3. 中间区域存在阶乘级衰减的"死区"，阶为O(1/(H-1)!)；4. 未训练模型在Step 0即展现U形，且与RoPE无关；5. 标准预训练无法克服此拓扑谷。
AI.conclusion: U形性能曲线是因果解码器结合残差连接的内在几何属性，在初始化时就已存在，与位置编码和训练无关。这确立了"基线"概念——未来改进需精准针对这一拓扑缺陷而非泛泛优化。该发现为理解LLM上下文处理局限提供了理论基础，并指向需重新审视位置编码改进策略的方向。

title: A neural operator for predicting vibration frequency response curves from limited data
summary: In the design of engineered components, rigorous vibration testing is essential for performance validation and identification of resonant frequencies and amplitudes encountered during operation. Performing this evaluation numerically via machine learning has great potential to accelerate design iteration and make testing workflows more efficient. However, dynamical systems are conventionally difficult to solve via machine learning methods without using physics-based regularizing loss functions. To properly perform this forecasting task, a structure that has an inspectable physical obedience can be devised without the use of regularizing terms from first principles. The method employed in this work is a neural operator integrated with an implicit numerical scheme. This architecture enables operators to learn of the underlying state-space dynamics from limited data, allowing generalization to untested driving frequencies and initial conditions. This network can infer the system's global frequency response by training on a small set of input conditions. As a foundational proof of concept, this investigation verifies the machine learning algorithm with a linear, single-degree-of-freedom system, demonstrating implicit obedience of dynamics. This approach demonstrates 99.87% accuracy in predicting the Frequency Response Curve (FRC), forecasting the frequency and amplitude of linear resonance training on 7% of the bandwidth of the solution. By training machine learning models to internalize physics information rather than trajectory, better generalization accuracy can be realized, vastly improving the timeframe for vibration studies on engineered components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"神经算子 + 隐式数值格式"的框架，在不使用任何基于物理的正则化损失项的前提下，从第一性原理出发学习线性单自由度（SDOF）系统的状态空间动力学，并隐式满足物理约束。模型仅用解带宽 7% 的频率响应数据训练，即可预测完整频响曲线（FRC），准确率达 99.87%，成功外推至未测试的激励频率与初始条件。
AI.motivation: 工程部件的振动测试是性能验证、识别共振频率与振幅的关键环节，而传统试验成本高、周期长。尽管机器学习数值求解动力学系统潜力巨大，但常规机器学习模型缺乏对物理规律的"可检查性（inspectable physical obedience）"，必须借助物理正则化损失函数才能保证解的正确性。作者希望构造一种结构上天然内含物理服从性的网络，使模型学习的是底层状态空间动力学本身而非单纯轨迹，从而在有限数据下获得更强的泛化能力，加速设计迭代中的振动评估流程。
AI.method: 核心架构为"神经算子（neural operator）与隐式数值格式（implicit numerical scheme）"的融合：(1) 隐式数值离散在解空间中提供物理一致的推进结构，保证网络的输出解在离散层面满足动力学方程的约束；(2) 神经算子学习状态空间的状态转移映射，使其可从少量输入工况中提取系统全局动力学规律；(3) 无需任何基于物理先验的正则化项（regularizing loss），物理信息通过结构隐式编码；(4) 在线性单自由度（SDOF）系统上作为基础概念验证（foundational proof of concept），通过在部分频带数据上训练来推断完整频率响应曲线，并测试其向未测试激励频率与初始条件的外推能力。
AI.result: 在仅使用解带宽 7% 的数据训练的条件下，模型成功预测了完整的频率响应曲线（FRC），准确率达到 99.87%，能够正确预报共振频率与共振幅值；网络对未测试的激励频率与初始条件表现出泛化能力，验证了"隐式服从动力学"的设定。实验表明，将物理信息内化到模型结构（而非仅拟合轨迹或依赖正则化）可显著提升泛化精度，大幅缩短工程部件振动研究的时间周期。
AI.conclusion: 将物理约束以结构方式（隐式数值格式 + 神经算子）而非损失正则化的方式嵌入机器学习模型，可使模型内化动力学而非轨迹，在极少量数据（7% 带宽）下获得极高精度（99.87%）并外推到未测试工况，从而加速振动测试与设计迭代。该工作定位为基础性概念验证，证明了"可检查的物理服从性"这一设计范式的可行性，为后续推广到多自由度、非线性及更复杂工程系统（如航空结构）的研究奠定了框架基础。

title: Mashup Learning: Faster Finetuning by Remixing Past Checkpoints
summary: Finetuning on domain-specific data is a well-established method for enhancing LLM performance on downstream tasks. Training on each dataset produces a new set of model weights, resulting in a multitude of checkpoints saved in-house or on open-source platforms. However, these training artifacts are rarely reused for subsequent experiments despite containing improved model abilities for potentially similar tasks. In this paper, we propose Mashup Learning, a simple method to leverage the outputs of prior training runs to enhance model adaptation to new tasks. Our procedure identifies the most relevant historical checkpoints for a target dataset, aggregates them with model merging, and uses the result as an improved initialization for training. Across 8 standard LLM benchmarks, four models, and two collections of source checkpoints, Mashup Learning consistently improves average downstream accuracy by 0.5-5 percentage points over training from scratch. It also accelerates convergence, requiring 41-46% fewer training steps and up to 37% less total wall-clock time to match from-scratch accuracy, including all selection and merging overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mashup Learning方法，通过复用历史训练检查点并进行模型合并，为新任务提供更好的模型初始化。实验表明该方法能在多个基准上提升0.5-5%的准确率，同时减少41-46%的训练步骤和最多37%的总训练时间。
AI.motivation: 在大模型时代，针对不同下游任务进行微调会产生大量的模型检查点，这些检查点虽然包含了针对类似任务的改进能力，但通常被束之高阁，未能充分利用。同时，从头训练新模型需要大量的计算资源和时间成本。该论文提出希望复用历史训练产物来改进新任务的模型适应效率。
AI.method:
该方法主要包含三个步骤：（1）选择阶段：根据目标数据集，从历史检查点集合中识别最相关的检查点；（2）合并阶段：使用模型合并技术（如TIES、DARE等）将选中的检查点进行聚合；（3）微调阶段：以合并后的模型作为初始化，在目标数据集上进行微调。

具体实现中，研究者可能采用了基于相似性的选择策略（如使用验证集损失或嵌入相似度）来识别相关检查点，并探索了不同的合并策略。
AI.result: 实验在8个标准LLM基准测试、4种不同模型和2组历史检查点集合上进行了验证。结果表明：（1）Mashup Learning相比从头训练，平均下游准确率提升0.5-5个百分点；（2）训练收敛速度显著加快，需要减少41-46%的训练步骤；（3）总训练时间（包括选择和合并开销）最多可减少37%。
AI.conclusion:
Mashup Learning通过复用历史检查点并结合模型合并技术，为下游任务提供了更好的初始化，是一种简单而有效的改进LLM适应新任务的方法。该方法在训练效率上也有显著提升，可减少41-46%的训练步骤和最多37%的总训练时间。

该工作的主要贡献包括：（1）提出了Mashup Learning框架，系统性地复用历史训练产物；（2）设计了基于目标数据集选择相关历史检查点的有效方法；（3）在多个基准数据集、模型和检查点集合上验证了方法的有效性；（4）展示了该方法在训练效率上的显著提升。

title: ReMix: Reinforcement routing for mixtures of LoRAs in LLM finetuning
summary: Low-rank adapters (LoRAs) are a parameter-efficient finetuning technique that injects trainable low-rank matrices into pretrained models to adapt them to new tasks. Mixture-of-LoRAs models expand neural networks efficiently by routing each layer input to a small subset of specialized LoRAs of the layer. Existing Mixture-of-LoRAs routers assign a learned routing weight to each LoRA to enable end-to-end training of the router. Despite their empirical promise, we observe that the routing weights are typically extremely imbalanced across LoRAs in practice, where only one or two LoRAs often dominate the routing weights. This essentially limits the number of effective LoRAs and thus severely hinders the expressive power of existing Mixture-of-LoRAs models. In this work, we attribute this weakness to the nature of learnable routing weights and rethink the fundamental design of the router. To address this critical issue, we propose a new router designed that we call Reinforcement Routing for Mixture-of-LoRAs (ReMix). Our key idea is using non-learnable routing weights to ensure all active LoRAs to be equally effective, with no LoRA dominating the routing weights. However, our routers cannot be trained directly via gradient descent due to our non-learnable routing weights. Hence, we further propose an unbiased gradient estimator for the router by employing the reinforce leave-one-out (RLOO) technique, where we regard the supervision loss as the reward and the router as the policy in reinforcement learning. Our gradient estimator also enables to scale up training compute to boost the predictive performance of our ReMix. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed ReMix significantly outperform state-of-the-art parameter-efficient finetuning methods under a comparable number of activated parameters.

AI.tldr: ReMix是一种用于混合LoRA的强化学习路由方法，通过使用不可学习路由权重和RLOO梯度估计器解决现有方法中路由权重极度不平衡的问题，显著超越现有参数高效微调方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-LoRAs路由器的学习路由权重存在严重不平衡问题，通常只有一个或两个LoRA主导路由权重，这限制了有效LoRA的数量，严重阻碍了Mixture-of-LoRAs模型的表达能力。
AI.method: 提出Reinforcement Routing for Mixture-of-LoRAs (ReMix)：1) 使用不可学习的路由权重确保所有活跃LoRA具有同等效力，无LoRA主导路由权重；2) 采用REINFORCE leave-one-out (RLOO)技术作为无偏梯度估计器，将监督损失视为奖励，路由器视为强化学习策略。
AI.result: 在可比较的激活参数数量下，ReMix显著优于现有最先进的参数高效微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入不可学习路由权重和强化学习梯度估计器，ReMix有效解决了Mixture-of-LoRAs中路由权重不平衡的核心问题，显著提升了模型的表达能力和微调性能。

title: DT-BEHRT: Disease Trajectory-aware Transformer for Interpretable Patient Representation Learning
summary: The growing adoption of electronic health record (EHR) systems has provided unprecedented opportunities for predictive modeling to guide clinical decision making. Structured EHRs contain longitudinal observations of patients across hospital visits, where each visit is represented by a set of medical codes. While sequence-based, graph-based, and graph-enhanced sequence approaches have been developed to capture rich code interactions over time or within the same visits, they often overlook the inherent heterogeneous roles of medical codes arising from distinct clinical characteristics and contexts. To this end, in this study we propose the Disease Trajectory-aware Transformer for EHR (DT-BEHRT), a graph-enhanced sequential architecture that disentangles disease trajectories by explicitly modeling diagnosis-centric interactions within organ systems and capturing asynchronous progression patterns. To further enhance the representation robustness, we design a tailored pre-training methodology that combines trajectory-level code masking with ontology-informed ancestor prediction, promoting semantic alignment across multiple modeling modules. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that DT-BEHRT achieves strong predictive performance and provides interpretable patient representations that align with clinicians' disease-centered reasoning. The source code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/GatorAIM/DT-BEHRT.git.

AI.tldr: DT-BEHRT是一种用于EHR预测的图增强Transformer架构，通过解耦疾病轨迹、显式建模器官系统内诊断交互、捕获异步进展模式，并结合轨迹级掩码与本体祖先预测的预训练方法，在多基准数据集上实现强预测性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有EHR预测方法（基于序列、基于图及图增强序列的方法）往往忽略医学代码在临床特征和上下文中的异质性角色，未能充分建模器官系统内的诊断交互与疾病进展的时间异步性。
AI.method: 提出DT-BEHRT模型——一种图增强的序列架构，将疾病轨迹解耦为器官系统内诊断中心交互，并捕获异步进展模式。预训练阶段采用轨迹级代码掩码与本体信息驱动的祖先预测相结合的方法。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得强预测性能，提供了与临床医生疾病中心推理一致的可解释患者表示。
AI.conclusion: DT-BEHRT通过将疾病轨迹解耦为器官系统内的诊断中心交互，并捕获异步进展模式，有效提升了EHR预测性能。其预训练方法通过轨迹级代码掩码与本体信息驱动的祖先预测相结合，增强了表示的鲁棒性。实验在多个基准数据集上验证了模型的强预测性能，并提供了与临床医生疾病中心推理一致的解释性患者表示。

title: Actor-Accelerated Policy Dual Averaging for Reinforcement Learning in Continuous Action Spaces
summary: Policy Dual Averaging (PDA) offers a principled Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) framework that more naturally admits value function approximation than standard PMD, enabling the use of approximate advantage (or Q-) functions while retaining strong convergence guarantees. However, applying PDA in continuous state and action spaces remains computationally challenging, since action selection involves solving an optimization sub-problem at each decision step. In this paper, we propose \textit{actor-accelerated PDA}, which uses a learned policy network to approximate the solution of the optimization sub-problems, yielding faster runtimes while maintaining convergence guarantees. We provide a theoretical analysis that quantifies how actor approximation error impacts the convergence of PDA under suitable assumptions. We then evaluate its performance on several benchmarks in robotics, control, and operations research problems. Actor-accelerated PDA achieves superior performance compared to popular on-policy baselines such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Overall, our results bridge the gap between the theoretical advantages of PDA and its practical deployment in continuous-action problems with function approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"演员加速的策略对偶平均"(actor-accelerated PDA)：用训练中的策略网络（actor）直接拟合 PDA 每步动作选择所对应的优化子问题最优解，从而在保留收敛性保证的前提下大幅削减运行开销，并在 MuJoCo/Box2D 与 OR-Gym 连续决策任务上普遍优于 PPO、TRPO、NPG 等 on-policy 基线。
AI.motivation: 策略镜像下降（PMD）是统一一阶 RL 方法的理论框架，但其现有适用于连续动作空间的方法在每次策略更新时都需求解非凸、弱病态的优化子问题（如大 KL 惩罚系数导致 Lipschitz 常数巨大），求解缓慢甚至失败。Ju & Lan (2024a) 提出的策略对偶平均（PDA）借鉴 Nesterov 对偶平均，将子问题改造为弱凸且避免显式策略参数化，从而可高效求解；但代价是策略评估（policy evaluation）成为瓶颈——每个决策步都要独立求解一次子问题，直接实现时单步开销过高，无法用于深度 RL。核心动机即：如何在保留 PDA 收敛优势的同时，把每步子问题求解的成本降下来，并量化这种近似对理论保证的影响。
AI.method:
【问题设定】无限时域折扣 MDP，连续状态/动作，凸动作空间；目标为最小化初始分布 ρ 下的期望折扣代价，采用性能差引理与状态访问测度 κ_s^π；结论对任意 ρ 成立，故为分布无关（distribution-free）。

【算法框架】Algorithm 1：用参数化 actor π̂_{k+1}(s;θ^π) 近似 PDA 子问题最优解 π_{k+1}(s)=argmin_a Ψ̃_k(s,a)，其中累积正则化目标 Ψ̃_k(s,a)=Σ_{t=0}^k β_t ψ̃(s,a;θ_t)+λ_k D(π̂_0(s),a)，D 为由 1-强凸距离生成函数诱导的 Bregman 散度；优势函数由神经网络近似。

【理论假设】Assumption 3.1（正则性）：ψ̃ 关于动作 M_Q̃-Lipschitz、μ_Q̃-弱凸（平滑网络因 Hessian 有界可满足）、确定性逼近误差界 ς；Assumption 3.3（最优性间隙）：actor 解满足 Ψ̃_k(s,π̂_{k+1}) ≤ Ψ̃_k(s,π_{k+1})+ϵ_opt,k(s)，0≤ϵ_opt≤ϵ，并由此推出 D(π_{k+1},π̂_{k+1}) ≤ ϵ_opt/μ̃_k。

【主要结果】Theorem 3.4（μ̃_d≥0，即累积优势项对 a 凸）：给出 (1-γ)(1/β̄_k)Σβ_t E[V^{π̂_t}-V^{π*}] + (μ̃_{k-1}/β̄_k)E[D_s(π_k,π*)] 的上界，其中含 ς 的 O(1) 逼近误差项与 ϵ̄_opt/β̄_k 项；取 β_k=k+1、λ_k=μ̃_d 时 Bregman 距离项以 O(1/k²) 收敛、价值间隙 O(1/k)，整体以 O(ϱ) 误差全局收敛；μ̃_d=0 时取 λ_k=λ(k+1)^{3/2}，价值间隙以 O(1/√k) 收敛。Theorem 3.5（μ̃_d<0，非凸但下曲率有界）：取 λ_k=k(k+1)|μ̃_d|、β_t=t+1，存在 k̄(s) 使 −ψ^{π̂_k̄}(s,π̂_{k̄+1}(s)) 以 O(1/(k+1)) 速率被界住（含调和数 H_k 项趋于消失），该收敛形式在特殊情形下蕴含全局收敛，一般情形仍属开放问题。

【工程实现】Algorithm 2：目标缩放 + 递归加权累积优势 ψ^Σ_k ≈(1−β_k/Σβ)ψ^Σ_{k−1}+β_k/Σβ·ψ̃ 以避免累积量过大并保证数值稳定；μ_d=0 情形下 β_k=k+1、λ_k=λ(k+1)^{3/2}，仅 λ 与 σ_0 两个专用超参；动作空间取欧氏距离生成函数（Bregman 项为 ½‖a−π_0(s)‖²），prox-center π_0(s) 可为随机/预训练/零策略；actor 通过对 Ψ̃' 反向传播用标准优化器训练；探索用高斯启发式噪声 σ(t)=σ_0/β^0.3；优化器采用 SOAP；实现于 Tianshou 框架。
AI.result:
【最优跟踪验证】Pendulum-v1 上可视化 Ψ̃' 的地形演化：actor 输出逐步贴合子问题真实最优（粉色虚线），训练后期 MAE 稳定在有限水平，为 Assumption 3.3 的最优性间隙条件提供经验支撑。

【连续控制基准】（10 seeds × 10 tests，1M 步，取最后 5 epoch 平均回报；PDA 超参仅在 Hopper/Walker2d 调参后固定复用）PDA 普遍优于 PPO/TRPO/NPG：HalfCheetah-v4 5174.6 vs PPO 4067.5；Ant-v4 3568.2 vs 2589.5；Hopper-v4 2944.3 vs 2329.7；Walker2d-v4 4367.1 vs 3277.0；InvertedDoublePendulum 9167.5 vs 7926.8；Swimmer 111.3 vs 54.2；Humanoid-v4(3M) 5020.0 vs PPO 933.3；HumanoidStandup 161184 vs 135854；LunarLander 204.7 ≈ PPO 204.4。少数任务略逊（BipedalWalker 149.0 vs 273.2，Walker2d-v5 3642 vs 3797，InvertedPendulum 916 vs 976）。MuJoCo-v5 上趋势一致。

【OR 基准】Newsvendor：PDA 均值/中位数显著优于 PPO（3M 步均值 21857.9 甚至转正，PPO 为 −37225.9）；PortfolioOpt：10550.9 vs 10062.3，分布正向平移；InvManagement(Backlog/LS)：PDA 491.6/472.3，接近 SHLP(508.0/485.4)、优于 DFO/MIP，且标准差远小于经典 OR 方法，相对 Oracle 比值 1.1（PPO 1.1/1.2）。

【消融/敏感性】λ=0.5、σ_0=1.3 为默认；动态平衡类任务（Hopper、Walker2d、BipedalWalker）偏好高探索噪声，四足运动（Ant、HalfCheetah）偏好低噪声+大步长；存在较宽的有效超参区域，性能不依赖精细调参；常数噪声在 Hopper/Walker2d 亦可但难以统一。指数平滑替代缩放累积优势更新在个别 α 下可提升经验性能，但引入额外超参且破坏对偶平均理论闭环，体现理论—经验权衡。SOAP 相对 Adam 训练墙钟时间约快一倍，但样本效率与最终性能无显著差异，说明加速效果主要来自算法本身而非优化器。

【运行时】i7-14700K 上 1M 步：PDA 423.4s（Humanoid 变体 1480.7s），均快于 PPO(677.8/1720.8)、NPG(566.5/1484.3)、TRPO(512.3/1365.6)。
AI.conclusion: actor-accelerated PDA 通过用学习到的策略网络替代逐决策步的子问题精确求解，把 PDA 的理论优势（分布无关的收敛保证、可容纳价值函数近似、弱凸子问题）落地到连续动作深度 RL，在机器人控制与运筹优化任务上取得优于 PPO 等 on-policy 基线的回报与更短的训练时间；理论上给出了近似误差（价值逼近误差 ς 与 actor 最优性间隙 ϵ）如何进入收敛界的显式刻画，含 μ̃_d≥0 时的全局（近）最优收敛与 μ̃_d<0 时基于负优势的收敛。局限与未来方向：μ̃_d<0 情形下收敛后果尚未完全刻画（仅在特殊情形蕴含全局收敛）、累积优势更新存在理论（缩放求和）与经验（指数平滑）的权衡、评测主要针对 on-policy 基线且超参仅两个但仍需在平衡类任务上做噪声调度取舍。总体而言该工作弥合了 PDA 的理论优势与其在带函数逼近的连续动作问题中的实际部署之间的鸿沟。

title: Rethinking the Harmonic Loss via Non-Euclidean Distance Layers
summary: Cross-entropy loss has long been the standard choice for training deep neural networks, yet it suffers from interpretability limitations, unbounded weight growth, and inefficiencies that can contribute to costly training dynamics. The harmonic loss is a distance-based alternative grounded in Euclidean geometry that improves interpretability and mitigates phenomena such as grokking, or delayed generalization on the test set. However, the study of harmonic loss remains narrow: only Euclidean distance is explored, and no systematic evaluation of computational efficiency or sustainability was conducted. We extend harmonic loss by systematically investigating a broad spectrum of distance metrics as replacements for the Euclidean distance. We comprehensively evaluate distance-tailored harmonic losses on both vision backbones and large language models. Our analysis is framed around a three-way evaluation of model performance, interpretability, and sustainability. On vision tasks, cosine distances provide the most favorable trade-off, consistently improving accuracy while lowering carbon emissions, whereas Bray-Curtis and Mahalanobis further enhance interpretability at varying efficiency costs. On language models, cosine-based harmonic losses improve gradient and learning stability, strengthen representation structure, and reduce emissions relative to cross-entropy and Euclidean heads. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rethinking-harmonic-loss-5BAB/.

AI.tldr: 本文把"调和损失"(harmonic loss)中固定的欧氏距离替换为一系列非欧氏距离（余弦、曼哈顿、切比雪夫、Minkowski、Canberra、Bray–Curtis、Mahalanobis、Hamming），提出"距离定制的调和损失"(distance-tailored harmonic losses)，并在视觉与语言两大任务族上以"性能—可解释性—可持续性"三轴协议系统评估。核心结论：余弦距离是综合最优的通用选择；Bray–Curtis/Chebyshev 最偏可解释性；Mahalanobis 可解释性最强但碳代价最高；非欧氏几何在精度上并未统计显著超越欧氏调和损失，但在表征结构上有显著、可复现的改变，且在 CNN/ResNet50 上常比交叉熵更"绿"。
AI.motivation: 交叉熵虽是分类的默认损失，但其学习到的权重只是抽象参数、无原型语义，且为追求自信预测会导致权重无界增长，进而引发 grokking（训练精度早已饱和而测试集长期滞后泛化）等现象；同时在高风险场景（医疗、金融）中缺乏透明度。Baek 等人提出的调和损失用"样本到类别原型的距离"替代内积 logits，具有比例不变性与有限收敛点，使权重天然成为类别中心，兼具可解释性并缓解 grokking。但该方向研究过窄：(1) 仅验证了欧氏距离这一种度量；(2) 未系统评估计算效率与能源/碳排放；(3) 未在视觉与语言两类异构任务上做跨域基准。作者借鉴此前"度量选择会显著影响学习算法性能与效率"（如概念漂移检测中 Wasserstein 可被廉价度量替代）的证据，提出核心问题：除欧氏外，其他距离度量是否能在调和损失框架中带来更优的精度—可解释性—可持续性三方权衡？
AI.method: 方法论上，作者构建了一个即插即用的 DistLayer 抽象（基于注册表 + 向量化实现 + ε/clamp 数值稳定与协方差正则），仅替换最终分类头：把调和概率 p_k = d_k^{-n}/Σd_j^{-n} 中的欧氏距离 d_k=||h-w_k||_2 换为所选度量 d(h,w_k)，主干网络、优化器、调度器、数据顺序、种子完全共享，从而隔离"损失几何"这一唯一变量。覆盖的度量包括 L1 曼哈顿、L2 欧氏、L∞ 切比雪夫、Minkowski(p 可调)、余弦、Hamming(Gumbel/软松弛)、Canberra、Bray–Curtis（标准/绝对/归一化）以及 Mahalanobis（标准/对角/Cholesky），并与 Focal、Label Smoothing、Center Loss、Confidence Penalty、ArcFace 等现代基线对比。视觉侧使用 MLP/CNN/ResNet50/PVTv2-B0 × MNIST/CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100/Marathi Sign/TinyImageNet，评测 Accuracy/F1；语言侧使用 GPT-2、BERT(MLM)、Qwen2 式解码器及 GPT-2B 在 OpenWebText 上预训练，评测困惑度、梯度稳定性 GS（相邻步梯度范数方差相对 CE 的归一化）、有效秩 ER（协方差谱熵）、PCA5 结构。可解释性用 PC2 解释方差与 PCA@90% 所需维度数（视觉）、PCA5（语言）刻画；可持续性用 CodeCarbon 记录时长/能耗/CO2eq 并给出相对 CE 的差值。理论上给出了通用化定理：1-齐次距离下的联合缩放不变性与有限极小元（紧性论证）、基于距离间隔 γ(W) 的 PAC–Bayes 泛化界（因有限范数而有限）。此外用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（N=16 组数据集–骨干配对）与三种子 95% 置信区间做统计验证，并在模加法合成任务上做 grokking 分析与 FLOPs 核算。
AI.result: 视觉：余弦调和损失是"全能型"最优选择，在 CIFAR-10/100、Marathi Sign、TinyImageNet 上通常取得最高或接近最高的 Accuracy/F1（如 CIFAR-10+ResNet50 达 0.9262 vs 基线 0.843，+9.87%；CIFAR-100+ResNet50 0.7381 vs 0.7006，+5.35%），同时排放下降 10%–40%，且 PC90% 从 50 降至 5–8。Bray–Curtis（归一化）与 Chebyshev 在可解释性上最突出，PC2 解释方差最高、PCA@90% 维度最低；Mahalanobis 产生极高方差集中与锐利各向异性簇，但协方差估计与求逆带来最显著额外开销。统计上，Wilcoxon 检验显示非欧氏距离在平均精度上并未显著优于欧氏调和基线，多种距离的中位差甚至为显著负值；但在内在维度（PCA@90%）上 Bray–Curtis(Norm.)、Canberra、Chebyshev、Manhattan、两种余弦变体呈显著正向变化（Median +12.8、+9.8 等）；排放差异则普遍温和且方向混合，仅 4 种距离达 p<0.05。语言：余弦与 Minkowski(p=2) 在 BERT/GPT 上降低困惑度、显著改善梯度稳定性并保持高有效秩，PCA5 结构更集中，排放持平或优于 CE；Qwen 上无一种方法取得满意权衡（欧氏在有效秩/稳定性上最强，Minkowski 困惑度最佳）。三个模型中 CE 基线占据最大排放楔形，但需注意附录 L.3 显示按每千步计的距离头本身有额外排放开销（余弦最小、Mahalanobis/Minkowski 最重），语言侧的净收益主要来自更平滑优化与更快收敛而非每步 FLOPs 降低。模加法任务中所有距离家族均消除 grokking，嵌入形成近乎完美的二维圆环且 PC1–2 解释方差接近 100%，而 CE 仅 20%–30% 且出现明显延迟泛化。FLOPs 分析表明分类头 O(Cd) 的额外开销相对主干可忽略，故可持续性差异本质是"达到目标质量所需步数"差异。
AI.conclusion: 距离度量的选择不是调和损失中的中性细节：几何结构系统性地塑造了优化动力学、表征维度与碳足迹。实践建议为——以精度为主、通用场景优先选余弦（稳定/不稳定变体），特别是 CNN/ResNet50；追求表征可解释性时选 Bray–Curtis（归一化）或 Chebyshev，或在明确需要各向异性锐利簇时用 Mahalanobis；关注 Green AI 时在 CNN/ResNet50 上多个距离可实现相对 CE 的"碳负"，而在 PVT 与 LLM 上应偏好最轻量几何（余弦/欧氏）或保留 CE，除非距离头能减少足够步数以抵消每步成本。作者贡献了一个可复用的调和距离层框架、非欧氏度量目录与三轴评估协议，呼吁后续工作扩展新几何、学习设定与领域约束。主要局限在于：非欧氏度量在精度上未取得统计显著优势（部分表述"总体占优"与 Wilcoxon 结果存在张力），指标以 PCA 类代理为主，辐射解释性证据仍偏间接，且附录中排放汇总图注与正文的符号/结论存在不一致之处，需要更严谨的复核。

title: SiMPO: Measure Matching for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
summary: A commonly used family of RL algorithms for diffusion policies conducts softmax reweighting over the behavior policy, which usually induces an over-greedy policy and fails to leverage feedback from negative samples. In this work, we introduce Signed Measure Policy Optimization (SiMPO), a simple and unified framework that generalizes reweighting scheme in diffusion RL with general monotonic functions. SiMPO revisits diffusion RL via a two-stage measure matching lens. First, we construct a virtual target policy by $f$-divergence regularized policy optimization, where we can relax the non-negativity constraint to allow for a signed target measure. Second, we use this signed measure to guide diffusion or flow models through reweighted matching. This formulation offers two key advantages: a) it generalizes to arbitrary monotonically increasing weighting functions; and b) it provides a principled justification and practical guidance for negative reweighting. Furthermore, we provide geometric interpretations to illustrate how negative reweighting actively repels the policy from suboptimal actions. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that SiMPO achieves superior performance by leveraging these flexible weighting schemes, and we provide practical guidelines for selecting reweighting methods tailored to the reward landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SiMPO（Signed Measure Policy Optimization），通过引入单调函数和符号测度的f-散度正则化框架，统一并推广了扩散策略中的重加权方案，有效解决了过度贪婪策略和负样本利用不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散策略 RL 算法家族通常在行为策略上进行 softmax 重加权，这种方式会导致过度贪婪的策略，且无法有效利用负样本的反馈信息。
AI.method: 1. 通过两阶段测度匹配视角重新审视扩散 RL：首先通过 f-散度正则化策略优化构建虚拟目标策略，放松非负约束允许符号目标测度；2. 使用该符号测度通过重加权匹配引导扩散或流模型；3. 该框架可推广到任意单调递增的加权函数，为负重加权提供原则性论证和实践指导。
AI.result: 实验表明 SiMPO 通过灵活的加权方案取得优异性能，并提供了针对奖励景观选择重加权方法的实践指南。负加权能够主动排斥策略远离次优动作。
AI.conclusion: SiMPO 作为简单统一的框架，推广了现有的重加权方案，为扩散 RL 中的策略优化提供了理论基础和有效的负样本利用方法。

title: Improving TabPFN's Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure
comment: 8 pages main text, 30 pages total (including supplementary material), 27 figures. Code: https://github.com/DavideTugnoli/tabpfn-causal-synthetic
summary: Synthetic tabular data generation addresses data scarcity and privacy constraints in a variety of domains. Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN), a recent foundation model for tabular data, has been shown capable of generating high-quality synthetic tabular data. However, TabPFN is autoregressive: features are generated sequentially by conditioning on the previous ones, depending on the order in which they appear in the input data. We demonstrate that when the feature order conflicts with causal structure, the model produces spurious correlations that impair its ability to generate synthetic data and preserve causal effects. We address this limitation by integrating causal structure into TabPFN's generation process through two complementary approaches: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-aware conditioning, which samples each variable given its causal parents, and a Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG)-based strategy for scenarios with partial causal knowledge. We evaluate these approaches on controlled benchmarks and six CSuite datasets, assessing structural fidelity, distributional alignment, privacy preservation, and Average Treatment Effect (ATE) preservation. Across most settings, DAG-aware conditioning improves the quality and stability of synthetic data relative to vanilla TabPFN. The CPDAG-based strategy shows moderate improvements, with effectiveness depending on the number of oriented edges. These results indicate that injecting causal structure into autoregressive generation enhances the reliability of synthetic tabular data.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对TabPFN在生成合成表格数据时因特征顺序与因果结构冲突而产生的虚假相关性问题，提出将因果结构集成到自回归生成过程中的两种方法：DAG感知条件采样和CPDAG策略，以提升合成数据的结构保真度、分布对齐、隐私保护和ATE保留能力。
AI.motivation: TabPFN是一种用于表格数据的基础模型，能够生成高质量的合成表格数据。然而，TabPFN是自回归模型，特征按顺序生成并依赖于输入数据中的特征顺序。当特征顺序与因果结构冲突时，模型会产生虚假相关性问题，损害其生成合成数据和保留因果效应的能力。
AI.method: 提出两种互补的因果结构集成方法：1) DAG感知条件采样(DAG-aware conditioning)：根据每个变量的因果父节点进行条件采样；2) 基于CPDAG的策略：适用于部分因果知识的情况。
AI.result: 在受控基准测试和六个CSuite数据集上的评估表明：1) DAG感知条件采样在大多数设置中改善了合成数据的质量和稳定性；2) CPDAG策略表现出中等改进，效果取决于有向边的数量。
AI.conclusion: 将因果结构注入自回归生成过程可以增强合成表格数据的可靠性。这表明在生成模型中考虑因果关系对于提高合成数据质量具有重要意义。

title: Discovery of a Hematopoietic Manifold in scGPT Yields a Method for Extracting Performant Algorithms from Biological Foundation Model Internals
summary: We report the discovery and extraction of a compact hematopoietic algorithm from the single-cell foundation model scGPT, to our knowledge the first biologically useful, competitive algorithm extracted from a foundation model via mechanistic interpretability. We show that scGPT internally encodes a compact hematopoietic manifold with significant developmental branch structure, validated on a strict non-overlap Tabula Sapiens external panel and confirmed via frozen-head zero-shot transfer to an independent multi-donor immune panel. To isolate this geometry, we introduce a general three-stage extraction method consisting of direct operator export from frozen attention weights, a lightweight learned adaptor, and a task-specific readout, producing a standalone algorithm without target-dataset retraining. In 88-split donor-holdout benchmarks against scVI, Palantir, DPT, CellTypist, PCA, and raw-expression baselines, the extracted algorithm achieves the strongest pseudotime-depth ordering and leads on key subtype endpoints (CD4/CD8 AUROC 0.867, mono/macro AUROC 0.951). Compared to standard probing of frozen scGPT embeddings with a 3-layer MLP, the extracted head is BH-significantly better on 6/8 classification endpoints while completing a full 12-split evaluation campaign 34.5x faster with approximately 1000x fewer trainable parameters. The exported operator compresses from three pooled attention heads to a single head without statistically significant loss, and further to a rank-64 surrogate. Mechanistic interpretability of the compact operator reveals a concentrated four-factor core explaining 66.2% of ablation impact, with factors resolving into explicit T/lymphoid, B/plasma, granulocytic, and monocyte/macrophage gene programs. A supplementary second-manifold validation (intercellular communication geometry) confirms that the extraction method generalizes beyond hematopoiesis.

AI.tldr: 首次从.foundation model(scGPT)中通过机械可解释性提取出紧凑的造血算法，在88-split donor-holdout基准测试中表现最佳，在CD4/CD8和mono/macro分类任务上分别达到0.867和0.951的AUROC，且比标准探针方法快34.5倍。
AI.motivation: Background: Foundation models like scGPT encode rich biological knowledge but are computationally expensive and lack interpretability. Gap: It remains unclear whether compact, biologically meaningful algorithms can be extracted from these large models. Purpose: To discover and extract a compact hematopoietic manifold from scGPT that can function as a standalone algorithm without target-dataset retraining.
AI.method: Three-stage extraction method: (1) Direct operator export from frozen attention weights; (2) Lightweight learned adaptor; (3) Task-specific readout. The method produces a standalone algorithm without target-dataset retraining. Validation on strict non-overlap Tabula Sapiens external panel and frozen-head zero-shot transfer to independent multi-donor immune panel.
AI.result: The extracted algorithm achieves strongest pseudotime-depth ordering in 88-split donor-holdout benchmarks against scVI, Palantir, DPT, CellTypist, PCA, and raw-expression baselines. Leads on key subtype endpoints: CD4/CD8 AUROC 0.867, mono/macro AUROC 0.951. Compared to standard probing of frozen scGPT embeddings with 3-layer MLP: BH-significantly better on 6/8 classification endpoints, 34.5x faster with ~1000x fewer trainable parameters. The operator compresses from three pooled attention heads to single head without significant loss, further to rank-64 surrogate. Mechanistic interpretability reveals a four-factor core explaining 66.2% ablation impact: T/lymphoid, B/plasma, granulocytic, and monocyte/macrophage gene programs.
AI.conclusion: This work demonstrates that biologically useful, competitive algorithms can be extracted from foundation models via mechanistic interpretability. The three-stage extraction method generalizes beyond hematopoiesis, as confirmed by intercellular communication geometry validation. This represents a paradigm for extracting compact, interpretable, and efficient biological algorithms from large foundation models.

title: Estimating condition number with Graph Neural Networks
summary: In this paper, we propose a fast method for estimating the condition number of sparse matrices using graph neural networks (GNNs). To enable efficient training and inference of GNNs, our proposed feature engineering for GNNs achieves $\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{nnz} + n)$, where $\mathrm{nnz}$ is the number of non-zero elements in the matrix and $n$ denotes the matrix dimension. We propose two prediction schemes for estimating the matrix condition number using GNNs. The extensive experiments for the two schemes are conducted for 1-norm and 2-norm condition number estimation, which show that our method achieves a significant speedup over the Hager-Higham and Lanczos methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用图神经网络（GNN）快速估计稀疏矩阵条件数的方法。核心是设计了一个 O(nnz+n) 复杂度的矩阵特征提取算子，将矩阵映射为固定 11 维特征向量，并用 GCN（稀疏模式）+ 全局 MLP 双分支网络回归对数条件数。提出两种预测方案：方案一分解 κ=‖A‖·‖A⁻¹‖，仅预测逆范数；方案二直接预测 κ。在 1-范数与 2-范数实验上，相比 Hager–Higham、Lanczos/Golub–Kahan 与精确计算（torch.linalg.cond）获得显著加速（GPU 上约 4×~50×，毫秒级甚至亚毫秒级推理），同时保持可接受的对数相对误差。据作者称这是首次用图学习解决条件数估计的工作。
AI.motivation: 大规模稀疏矩阵的条件数精确计算代价极高：需要形成逆矩阵或求最大/最小奇异值，稠密下为 O(n^3)，稀疏下还会产生严重 fill-in。经典估计方法（Hager–Higham 一范数估计、Lanczos/幂法/Golub–Kahan 双对角化等）需要迭代求解与正交化，代价为 O(k·nnz) 且在病态/极端尺度矩阵上误差大或失效（如 SciPy svds 在超过 85% 的测试样本上无法达到 LRE<1）。同时线性系统的条件数直接决定是否需要预条件以及能否降精度求解（precision tuning），因此需要亚毫秒级、可控精度的快速估计器。已有的机器学习方法（如 Xu & Zhang 2005 的支持向量回归）精度低，仅能做粗分类。
AI.method: 监督学习框架：设训练集 D={(A_i, κ^i)}，利用 κ(A)=‖A‖·‖A⁻¹‖ 的分解，构造两种方案——方案一：网络学 g(A)≈‖A⁻¹‖，推理时 κ̂=‖A‖·10^g̃(A)；方案二：网络学 g(A)≈κ(A)，推理时 κ̂=10^g̃(A)；训练目标取 log10 变换以稳定数值并最小化均方误差（L2 正则 λ=1e-5、Adam lr=1e-3、100 epochs、batch 32、早停 patience 20、ReduceLROnPlateau、梯度裁剪 1.0、dropout 0.1）。特征工程 φ(A)∈R^11，由六组描述子拼接：范数组（‖A‖_1、‖A‖_∞、‖A‖_F 及其比值的 log10）、结构（log10(n+1)）、对角（min/max |d_i| 及其比值）、行稀疏度（max ρ_i）、非零值统计（max|a_ij|）、Gershgorin 半径（max g_i），全部 O(nnz+n) 可算。理论部分给出 Thm 3.1（‖A‖_2 的上下界与 κ_1 下界）、Thm 3.2（对称且对角占优时由 Gershgorin 得 κ_2 上下界）、Thm 3.3（SPD 时 κ_2 ≥ d_max/d_min）、Thm 3.4（用 ρ_max、v_max 控制的 κ 区间，及 Remark 4 说明缺少占优裕度时特征无法控制条件数）。网络结构：矩阵稀疏模式为图（节点=行/列，边=非零位置），节点特征为 (log10(|a_ii|+ε), log10(ρ_i+1))；K 层 GCN（自环+对称归一化 1/√(d̃_i d̃_j)，ReLU）→ 图级 mean/max 读出，与全局 MLP 分支拼接 → 多层预测头（含 dropout）输出标量 log10 值。图级元数据存储精确 ‖A‖_p 供方案一使用。实验平台：PyTorch 2.12.1 + CUDA 12.6，单张 A100，对比 torch.linalg.cond、Higham-SciPy（onenormest，t=2/10）、PyTorch 版 Hager–Higham（LU 求解）、幂法、Golub–Kahan（MGS 全重正交化）、SciPy svds。数据集：参数化矩阵族（2D Poisson、各向异性扩散、高对比度扩散、对流扩散、随机稀疏 SPD、对角缩放病态 SPD、对称三对角）与 SuiteSparse 真实矩阵（2000–10000 维，过滤掉 κ>1e20 与失败样本，210 训练/30 验证/70 测试）；评价指标为对数相对误差 LRE、均值/最大值 LRE、达标比例、墙钟时间与加速比。
AI.result: 参数化矩阵族实验（1 范数）：GCN-S1 GPU 总耗时 9.75 ms（纯推理 6.03 ms），LRE 均值 0.03%、最大 0.21%，LRE<0.5 与 LRE<1 均达 100%，优于/持平 Hager–Higham（GPU 40.61 ms，4× 加速）与 torch.cond（GPU 43.89 ms）；GCN-S2 误差变大（LRE 均值 0.47%、最大 0.98%，达标率降至 35%/69%）。2 范数：GCN-S1 22.24 ms（推理 6.71 ms），LRE 均值 0.04%、最大 0.30%，100% 达标，远优于 Golub–Kahan（10 次迭代 20.10 ms，LRE 均值 0.60%、达标率仅 17.5%；30 次迭代 67.01 ms，达标率 57.5%），并比 torch.cond（GPU 1228 ms）快约 55×；SciPy svds 约 19 s 且 85% 以上样本不达标。SuiteSparse 实验（分布外）精度下降：1 范数 GCN-S1 GPU 7.47 ms、LRE 均值 0.23%、最大 0.93%，LRE<0.5 达标 81.1%、LRE<1 达标 94.4%；2 范数 GCN-S2 6.68 ms、LRE 均值 0.34%、达标率 62.2%/83.3%；速度上仍全面领先（torch.cond 2 范数 38.9 s、1 范数 CPU 3.08 s、Hager–Higham 945 ms），但精度落后于 Hager–Higham（1 范数）与幂法（2 范数），仅优于 Golub–Kahan。作者归因于训练数据量有限与训练/测试分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将图学习引入稀疏矩阵条件数估计，证明「O(nnz+n) 特征提取 + GCN 稀疏模式分支 + 全局统计特征分支 + 对数尺度回归」可在亚毫秒级推理并给出可控精度，相对 Hager–Higham 与 Golub–Kahan 获得数量级加速、相对精确计算获得数十倍加速；两种方案中方案一（分解式）在精度与速度上略优，方案二在 2 范数场景更实用。局限：性能强依赖训练分布，真实矩阵上精度明显回落；未做架构/超参调优；瓶颈在推理阶段（可通过 ONNX 导出进一步加速）；Gershgorin 类理论界仅在对称性/正定性/对角占优裕度等附加结构假设下成立，不构成对条件数的完全刻画。作者认为该方法可用于精度调优等场景，未来工作包括更优 GNN 架构、端到端特征工程、敏感因素分析与 ONNX 部署。

title: Robust Post-Training for Generative Recommenders: Why Exponential Reward-Weighted SFT Outperforms RLHF
summary: Aligning generative recommender systems to user preferences via post-training is critical for closing the gap between next-item prediction and actual recommendation quality. Existing post-training methods are ill-suited for production-scale systems: RLHF methods reward hack due to noisy user feedback and unreliable reward models, offline RL alternatives require propensity scores that are unavailable, and online interaction is infeasible. We identify exponential reward-weighted SFT with weights $w = \exp(r/λ)$ as uniquely suited to this setting, and provide the theoretical and empirical foundations that explain why. By optimizing directly on observed rewards without querying a learned reward model, the method is immune to reward hacking, requires no propensity scores, and is fully offline. We prove the first policy improvement guarantees for this setting under noisy rewards, showing that the gap scales only logarithmically with catalog size and remains informative even for large item catalogs. Crucially, we show that temperature $λ$ explicitly and quantifiably controls the robustness-improvement tradeoff, providing practitioners with a single interpretable regularization hyperparameter with theoretical grounding. Experiments on three open-source and one proprietary dataset against four baselines confirm that exponential reward weighting is simple, scalable, and consistently outperforms RLHF-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指数奖励加权SFT方法解决生成式推荐系统中后训练的难题，无需奖励模型、倾向分数或在线交互即可实现离线策略提升，且温度参数λ可量化控制鲁棒性与改进效果的权衡。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐系统与用户偏好对齐的后训练至关重要，但现有方法存在根本性缺陷：RLHF方法因用户反馈噪声容易发生奖励黑客攻击，离线RL需要不可用的倾向分数，在线交互又不切实际。生产规模系统需要一个无需奖励模型、无需倾向分数、完全离线的方法。
AI.method: 提出指数奖励加权SFT方法，权重w = exp(r/λ)，直接在观察到的奖励上优化而不查询学习到的奖励模型。理论证明该方法在噪声奖励下的策略改进差距仅与目录大小对数相关，且温度λ可显式量化控制鲁棒性与改进效果的权衡。
AI.result: 在三个开源和一个专有数据集上相对于四个基线方法的实验表明，指数奖励加权方法简单、可扩展且始终优于基于RLHF的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 指数奖励加权SFT是生产规模生成式推荐系统的理想后训练方法，具有理论保证的策略改进能力，并通过λ提供了可解释的正则化超参数控制。

title: Taming Score-Based Denoisers in ADMM: A Convergent Plug-and-Play Framework
summary: While score-based generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems, directly integrating them into optimization algorithms such as ADMM remains nontrivial. Two central challenges arise: i) the mismatch between the noisy data manifolds used to train the score functions and the geometry of ADMM iterates, especially due to the influence of dual variables, and ii) the lack of convergence understanding when ADMM is equipped with score-based denoisers. To address the manifold mismatch issue, we propose ADMM plug-and-play (ADMM-PnP) with the AC-DC denoiser, a new framework that embeds a three-stage denoiser into ADMM: (1) auto-correction (AC) via additive Gaussian noise, (2) directional correction (DC) using conditional Langevin dynamics, and (3) score-based denoising. In terms of convergence, we establish two results: first, under proper denoiser parameters, each ADMM iteration is a weakly nonexpansive operator, ensuring high-probability fixed-point $\textit{ball convergence}$ using a constant step size; second, under more relaxed conditions, the AC-DC denoiser is a bounded denoiser, which leads to convergence under an adaptive step size schedule. Experiments on a range of inverse problems demonstrate that our method consistently improves solution quality over a variety of baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ADMM plug-and-play (ADMM-PnP)框架，通过嵌入AC-DC三阶段去噪器解决分数生成模型在ADMM优化中的流形不匹配问题，并在理论上建立了弱非扩张映射的收敛性保证。
AI.motivation: 分数生成模型作为逆问题的有效先验，但将其直接集成到ADMM等优化算法面临两大挑战：1) 训练分数函数使用的噪声数据流形与ADMM迭代（尤其是受对偶变量影响）的几何特性不匹配；2) 配备分数去噪器的ADMM缺乏收敛性分析。
AI.method: 提出ADMM-PnP with AC-DC去噪器，嵌入三阶段去噪流程：(1) 自校正(AC)通过加性高斯噪声；(2) 方向校正(DC)使用条件朗之万动力学；(3) 分数去噪。在理论分析上，证明了在适当参数下每次ADMM迭代是弱非扩张算子，在更宽松条件下AC-DC去噪器是有界去噪器。
AI.result: 理论结果：1) 在适当去噪器参数下，每次ADMM迭代是弱非扩张算子，可使用常数步长确保高概率固定点球收敛；2) 在更宽松条件下，AC-DC去噪器的有界性导致自适应步长调度下的收敛性。实验表明该方法在各种逆问题上一致性地提高了解质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过AC-DC三阶段去噪器有效解决了分数生成模型与ADMM迭代之间的流形不匹配问题，并建立了严格的收敛性理论，为基于分数的PnP方法提供了新的理论框架和实践方案。

title: GSVD for Geometry-Grounded Dataset Comparison: An Alignment Angle Is All You Need
summary: Geometry-grounded learning asks models to respect structure in the problem domain rather than treating observations as arbitrary vectors. Motivated by this view, we revisit a classical but underused primitive for comparing datasets: linear relations between two data matrices, expressed via the co-span constraint $Ax = By = z$ in a shared ambient space. To operationalize this comparison, we use the generalized singular value decomposition (GSVD) as a joint coordinate system for two subspaces. In particular, we exploit the GSVD form $A = HCU$, $B = HSV$ with $C^{\top}C + S^{\top}S = I$, which separates shared versus dataset-specific directions through the diagonal structure of $(C, S)$. From these factors we derive an interpretable *angle score* $θ(z) \in [0, π/2]$ for a sample $z$, quantifying whether z is explained relatively more by $A$, more by $B$, or comparably by both. The primary role of $θ(z)$ is as a *per-sample geometric diagnostic*. We illustrate the behavior of the score on MNIST through angle distributions and representative GSVD directions. A binary classifier derived from $θ(z)$ is presented as an illustrative application of the score as an interpretable diagnostic tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于广义奇异值分解(GSVD)的几何诊断方法，用于比较两个数据矩阵之间的线性关系。通过GSVD分解 A=HCu, B=HSV，构建了角度分数θ(z)∈[0,π/2]来量化样本z被A或B解释的程度，并将其应用于MNIST数据集作为可解释诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 几何基础学习要求模型尊重问题域的结构。当前缺乏比较数据集的古典但有用的原语，本文重新审视了利用线性关系(Ax = By = z)比较数据集的方法。
AI.method: 使用广义奇异值分解(GSVD)作为两个子空间的联合坐标系统。具体利用GSVD形式 A = HCU, B = HSV，其中 CᵀC + SᵀS = I，通过(C, S)的对角结构分离共享方向与数据集特定方向，从中导出角度分数θ(z)。
AI.result: 在MNIST上展示了角度分数的行为，包括角度分布和代表性GSVD方向。θ(z)能够有效量化样本被A或B相对解释的程度。
AI.conclusion: 角度分数作为每样本几何诊断工具具有可行性，基于θ(z)的二元分类器可作为可解释诊断工具的例证应用。

title: Copula-ResLogit: A Deep-Copula Framework for Unobserved Confounding Effects
summary: A key challenge in travel demand analysis is the presence of unobserved factors that may generate non-causal dependencies, obscuring the true causal effects. To address the issue, the study introduces a novel deep learning based fully interpretable joint modelling framework, Copula-ResLogit, which integrates the flexibility of Residual Neural Network (ResNet) architectures with the dependence capturing capabilities of copula models. This hybrid structure enables us to first detect unobserved confounding through traditional copula function based joint modelling and then mitigate these hidden associations by incorporating deep learning components. The study applies this framework to two case studies, including the relationship between stress levels and wait time of pedestrians when crossing mid block in VR and the dependencies between travel mode choice and travel distance in London travel behaviour data. Results show that Copula-ResLogit substantially reduces or eliminates the dependencies, demonstrating the ability of residual layers to account for hidden confounding effects.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种新的深度学习可解释联合建模框架Copula-ResLogit，用于解决旅行需求分析中由未观测混杂因素导致的非因果依赖问题。该框架结合了ResNet架构的灵活性和copula模型的依赖捕获能力。
AI.motivation: 旅行需求分析中存在未观测因素，这些因素可能产生非因果依赖，掩盖真实的因果效应。这是该研究要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 提出Copula-ResLogit框架，融合ResNet架构与copula模型。该混合结构首先通过传统copula函数联合建模检测未观测混杂，然后通过深度学习组件减轻这些隐藏关联。
AI.result: 两个案例研究结果表明：1)VR场景中过街行人压力水平与等待时间的关系；2)伦敦出行行为数据中出行方式选择与出行距离的关系。Copula-ResLogit显著减少或消除了依赖关系，证明残差层能够处理隐藏混杂效应。
AI.conclusion: Copula-ResLogit框架成功地将深度学习的灵活性与copula模型的依赖捕获能力相结合，有效解决了旅行需求分析中的未观测混杂问题，为因果推断提供了更准确的方法。

title: GaLoRA: Parameter-Efficient Graph-Aware LLMs for Node Classification
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables, 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025) Workshop
summary: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) and their ability to capture semantic relationships has led to their adoption in a wide range of applications. Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) are a notable example where LLMs can be combined with Graph Neural Networks to improve the performance of node classification. In TAGs, each node is associated with textual content and such graphs are commonly seen in various domains such as social networks, citation graphs, recommendation systems, etc. Effectively learning from TAGs would enable better representations of both structural and textual representations of the graph and improve decision-making in relevant domains. We present GaLoRA, a parameter-efficient framework that integrates structural information into LLMs. GaLoRA demonstrates competitive performance on node classification tasks with TAGs, performing on par with state-of-the-art models with just 0.24% of the parameter count required by full LLM fine-tuning. We experiment with three real-world datasets to showcase GaLoRA's effectiveness in combining structural and semantical information on TAGs.

AI.tldr: GaLoRA 提出一个模块化、参数高效的框架，将图结构信息注入大语言模型用于文本属性图（TAG）的节点分类：先训练 GNN（GraphSAGE）学习结构感知嵌入，再通过 LoRA 低秩适配把 1-hop/2-hop 结构嵌入注入 LLM 的中/上层。总计仅训练 0.295M 参数（约为 GPT-2 的 0.238%），在 ArXiv、Instagram、Reddit 三个数据集上与使用同一骨干的 GraphAdapter 相当或更优（ArXiv/GPT-2: 0.7550 vs 0.7325；Reddit/GPT-2: 0.6611 vs 0.6441），并在 Reddit 上超过所有基线。
AI.motivation: 文本属性图（TAG）需要同时建模图结构与文本语义。现有关联合方法（GLEM、GraphAdapter 等）计算开销大、难扩展；GLEM 依赖伪标签且交替训练迭代开销大，TAPE 高度依赖人工提示与 LLM 解释质量，GraphAdapter 冻结 LLM、无法适配任务特定语义知识。因此需要一个既保留模块化与高效性、又能对 LLM 做语义微调并注入结构信息的方案。
AI.method: 两阶段解耦框架。第一阶段：用 LLM 编码器（与第二阶段同一骨干）产生节点文本特征，训练两层 GraphSAGE（mean pooling 聚合 + ReLU 非线性），得到 Pass-1（1-hop）与 Pass-2（2-hop）结构嵌入，并接轻量 MLP 分类器，用交叉熵监督训练。第二阶段：冻结 LLM 骨干，仅在部分层插入 LoRA 适配器（GPT-2: c_attn、c_proj；RoBERTa: q/k/v/dense；默认秩 r=4，实验 {2,4,8}），通过 Z = W_C·(α·W_A H_1 + (1−α)·W_B H_2) 将 LLM 隐状态 H_1 与广播到全部 T 个 token 的结构嵌入 H_2 投影到秩 r 的共享低秩空间并用可学习门控 α 融合，再投影回原维度。GPT-2/RoBERTa 均在第 5–7 层注入 Pass-1、第 9–11 层注入 Pass-2（中部建上下文，上层做高层语义推理）。LoRA 用 AdamW、lr 3e-4、weight decay 1e-2、batch 32，手写 PyTorch 实现（未用 PEFT）。
AI.result: LLM-controlled 对比（同一骨干、5 个随机种子均值±标准差）：ArXiv 准确率 RoBERTa 0.7234 / GPT-2 0.7550（vs GraphAdapter 0.7273/0.7325，GPT-2 提升约 2.3 个点）；Instagram ROC-AUC 0.6392/0.6420（vs 0.6292/0.6276）；Reddit 准确率 0.6464/0.6611（vs 0.6379/0.6441）。跨不同骨干对比中，GaLoRA 在 Reddit 上最优（0.6611），ArXiv 与 Instagram 略低于使用 LLaMA-13B 的 GraphAdapter（0.7707、0.6513）。参数效率：GNN 0.18M + LoRA 0.115M = 0.295M，为 GPT-2(124M) 的 0.238%，远低于 GLEM（DeBERTa-Large 100% 微调），高于 GraphAdapter 的 0.015% 但后者不微调 LLM。消融：LoRA 秩 2→4→8 时 Instagram ROC-AUC 0.6347→0.6420→0.6421（r=4 性价比最佳）；GAT 替换 GraphSAGE 可再提升（Instagram 0.6616、ArXiv 0.7569）；提示工程有效，无提示 0.6283→最优提示 0.6420。
AI.conclusion: GaLoRA 通过“结构学习与语义学习解耦 + LoRA 注入”的两阶段设计，在仅训练不到 1% LLM 参数的条件下取得与 SOTA 结构建模方法相当的节点分类性能，说明较小语言模型（GPT-2/RoBERTa）同样能从结构上下文中获益，适合资源受限场景。局限：目前仅评估节点分类任务；分层随机划分在消息传递的 GNN 上可能存在信息泄漏风险；基线结果直接引用他人报告值而未重训，可比性受限。后续方向包括链接预测、图分类、更高级的融合设计、更多 TAG 基准与多样化数据集验证。

title: Federated Active Learning Under Extreme Non-IID and Global Class Imbalance
summary: Federated active learning (FAL) seeks to reduce annotation cost under privacy constraints, yet its effectiveness degrades in realistic settings with severe global class imbalance and highly heterogeneous clients. We conduct a systematic study of query-model selection in FAL and uncover a central insight: the model that achieves more class-balanced sampling, especially for minority classes, consistently leads to better final performance. Moreover, global-model querying is beneficial only when the global distribution is highly imbalanced and client data are relatively homogeneous; otherwise, the local model is preferable. Based on these findings, we propose FairFAL, an adaptive class-fair FAL framework.
