To further ensure lossless optimization, we incorporate group-relative regularization and advantage-aware calibration, which dynamically adapt length budgets to instance difficulty and preserve the advantage signal of high-quality trajectories. Empirically, across both RLHF and RLVR settings, GR$^3$~maintains training dynamics and downstream performance comparable to standard GRPO while significantly mitigating length inflation, outperforming state-of-the-art length-regularized baselines.

AI.tldr: GR³通过乘法重缩放范式解决LLM强化学习中的长度膨胀问题，结合群组相对正则化和优势感知校准，在保持训练动态的同时显著减轻长度膨胀。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升LLM能力，但存在关键的长度膨胀问题：模型通过冗长或低效推理来最大化奖励。先前方法难以通用且无损地解决此问题，因为加性惩罚会产生补偿效应导致优化捷径，而启发式门控策略缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出群组相对奖励重缩放(GR³)，将长度控制重新定义为乘法重缩放范式，建立通用、连续且奖励依赖的门控机制。同时引入群组相对正则化和优势感知校准，根据实例难度动态调整长度预算，并保留高质量轨迹的优势信号。
AI.result: 在RLHF和RLVR两种设置下，GR³保持了与标准GRPO相当的训练动态和下游性能，同时显著减轻了长度膨胀，优于现有的长度正则化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GR³通过乘法重缩放范式成功解决了强化学习中的长度膨胀问题，为LLM训练提供了一种通用、无损的长度控制方法。

title: Historical Consensus: Preventing Posterior Collapse via Iterative Selection of Gaussian Mixture Priors
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) frequently suffer from posterior collapse, where latent variables become uninformative and the approximate posterior degenerates to the prior. Recent work has characterized this phenomenon as a phase transition governed by the spectral properties of the data covariance matrix. In this paper, we propose a fundamentally different approach: instead of avoiding collapse through architectural constraints or hyperparameter tuning, we eliminate the possibility of collapse altogether by leveraging the multiplicity of Gaussian mixture model (GMM) clusterings. We introduce Historical Consensus Training, an iterative selection procedure that progressively refines a set of candidate GMM priors through alternating optimization and selection. The key insight is that models trained to satisfy multiple distinct clustering constraints develop a historical barrier -- a region in parameter space that remains stable even when subsequently trained with a single objective. We prove that this barrier excludes the collapsed solution, and demonstrate through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets that our method achieves non-collapsed representations regardless of decoder variance or regularization strength. Our approach requires no explicit stability conditions (e.g., $σ^{\prime 2} < λ_{\max}$) and works with arbitrary neural architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/tsegoochang/historical-consensus-vae.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为历史共识训练(Historical Consensus Training)的方法,通过利用高斯混合模型(GMM)聚类的多重性来消除VAE中的后验崩溃问题。该方法通过交替优化和选择逐步细化候选GMM先验,使模型在参数空间中形成稳定的历史屏障,排除崩溃解。
AI.motivation: VAE经常遭受后验崩溃问题(latent变量变得无信息,近似后验退化到先验),现有方法通过架构约束或超参数调优来避免崩溃。该论文提出根本不同的方法:完全消除崩溃的可能性。
AI.method: 提出历史共识训练(Historical Consensus Training):1)迭代选择程序,通过交替优化和选择来细化候选GMM先验;2)核心观点是满足多个不同聚类约束的模型会形成"历史屏障"——即使后续用单一目标训练也能保持稳定的参数空间区域;3)证明了该屏障排除崩溃解;4)无需显式稳定性条件(如σ'² < λ_max),适用于任意神经架构。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上广泛实验证明,该方法无论decoder方差或正则化强度如何,都能实现非崩溃表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过GMM聚类多重性和历史屏障机制,可以完全消除VAE后验崩溃,为VAE训练提供了一种无需手动稳定性条件的新范式。

title: Safe RLHF Beyond Expectation: Stochastic Dominance for Universal Spectral Risk Control
summary: Safe Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) typically enforces safety through expected cost constraints, but the expectation captures only a single statistic of the cost distribution and fails to account for distributional uncertainty, particularly under heavy tails or rare catastrophic events. This limitation is problematic when robustness and risk sensitivity are critical. Stochastic dominance offers a principled alternative by comparing entire cost distributions rather than just their averages, enabling direct control over tail risks and potential out-of-distribution failures that expectation-based constraints may overlook. In this work, we propose Risk-sensitive Alignment via Dominance (RAD), a novel alignment framework that replaces scalar expected cost constraints with First-Order Stochastic Dominance (FSD) constraints. We operationalize this constraint by comparing the target policy's cost distribution to that of a reference policy within an Optimal Transport (OT) framework, using entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations to obtain a differentiable and computationally efficient objective for stable end-to-end optimization. Furthermore, we introduce quantile-weighted FSD constraints and show that weighted FSD universally controls a broad class of Spectral Risk Measures (SRMs), so that improvements under weighted dominance imply guaranteed improvements in the corresponding spectral risk. This provides a principled mechanism for tuning a model's risk profile via the quantile weighting function. Empirical results demonstrate that RAD improves harmlessness over baselines while remaining competitive in helpfulness, and exhibits greater robustness on out-of-distribution harmlessness evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAD框架，通过使用一阶随机占优(FSD)约束替代传统的期望成本约束来解决RLHF中的尾部风险问题。该方法利用最优传输框架比较策略的成本分布，并通过谱风险度量提供可调的风险配置。
AI.motivation: 传统RLHF使用期望成本约束仅捕获成本分布的单一统计量，无法处理分布不确定性特别是尾部风险和稀有灾难性事件。当需要鲁棒性和风险敏感性时，这一局限性问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出风险敏感对齐(RAD)框架：1)用FSD约束替代标量期望成本约束；2)在最优传输框架内操作化FSD约束，使用熵正则化和Sinkhorn迭代获得可微且计算高效的目标函数；3)引入分位数加权FSD约束以控制谱风险度量(SRM)。
AI.result: 实验表明RAD在保持有帮助性的同时提高了无害性，并在分布外无害性评估中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FSD约束提供了一种原则性的机制来控制尾部风险，通过分位数加权函数可调整模型的风险画像。期望成本约束可视为FSD约束的特例，RAD框架为安全对齐提供了更灵活的风险控制能力。

title: Learning to Score: Tuning Cluster Schedulers through Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Efficiently allocating incoming jobs to nodes in large-scale clusters can lead to substantial improvements in both cluster utilization and job performance. In order to allocate incoming jobs, cluster schedulers usually rely on a set of scoring functions to rank feasible nodes. Results from individual scoring functions are usually weighted equally, which could lead to sub-optimal deployments as the one-size-fits-all solution does not take into account the characteristics of each workload. Tuning the weights of scoring functions, however, requires expert knowledge and is computationally expensive.
  This paper proposes a reinforcement learning approach for learning the weights in scheduler scoring algorithms with the overall objective of improving the end-to-end performance of jobs for a given cluster. Our approach is based on percentage improvement reward, frame-stacking, and limiting domain information. We propose a percentage improvement reward to address the objective of multi-step parameter tuning. The inclusion of frame-stacking allows for carrying information across an optimization experiment. Limiting domain information prevents overfitting and improves performance in unseen clusters and workloads. The policy is trained on different combinations of workloads and cluster setups. We demonstrate the proposed approach improves performance on average by 33\% compared to fixed weights and 12\% compared to the best-performing baseline in a lab-based serverless scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的集群调度器权重学习方法来优化大规模集群中的作业分配。通过使用百分比改进奖励、帧堆叠和限制领域信息等技术，训练策略在不同的 workload 和集群设置组合上。实验表明，该方法相比固定权重提升33%，相比最佳基线提升12%。
AI.motivation: 集群调度器通常使用加权评分函数对可行节点进行排名，但各评分函数结果通常等权重分配，导致次优部署。现有一刀切方案未考虑每个workload的特性，而调整权重需要专家知识且计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出基于百分比改进奖励、帧堆叠和限制领域信息的强化学习方法。百分比改进奖励解决多步参数调优的目标；帧堆叠允许携带跨优化实验的信息；限制领域信息防止过拟合并提高在未见过的集群和workload上的性能。
AI.result: 在实验室无服务器场景中，该方法相比固定权重平均提升33%，相比最佳基线提升12%。
AI.conclusion: 该强化学习方法能有效学习调度器评分算法中的权重，提升作业的端到端性能，且具有良好的泛化能力。

title: A Bipartite Graph Approach to U.S.-China Cross-Market Return Forecasting
summary: This paper studies cross-market return predictability through a machine learning framework that preserves economic structure. Exploiting the non-overlapping trading hours of the U.S. and Chinese equity markets, we construct a directed bipartite graph that captures time-ordered predictive linkages between stocks across markets. Edges are selected via rolling-window hypothesis testing, and the resulting graph serves as a sparse, economically interpretable feature-selection layer for downstream machine learning models. We apply a range of regularized and ensemble methods to forecast open-to-close returns using lagged foreign-market information. Our results reveal a pronounced directional asymmetry: U.S. previous-close-to-close returns contain substantial predictive information for Chinese intraday returns, whereas the reverse effect is limited. This informational asymmetry translates into economically meaningful performance differences and highlights how structured machine learning frameworks can uncover cross-market dependencies while maintaining interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨市场收益可预测性，提出一种保留经济结构的机器学习框架。通过构建有向二部图捕捉美中股市间的时间序列预测联系，使用滚动窗口假设检验筛选边作为特征选择层，并应用多种正则化和集成方法预测开盘至收盘收益。研究发现明显的方向不对称性：美股隔夜收益对A股日内收益有显著预测能力，反之则较弱。
AI.motivation: 跨市场收益预测研究通常忽视经济结构解释性，本文旨在填补这一空白。传统机器学习方法缺乏经济可解释性，难以揭示市场间具体预测关系的本质特征。
AI.method: 1) 利用美中股市非重叠交易时段构建有向二部图；2) 通过滚动窗口假设检验筛选边，构建稀疏且经济可解释的特征选择层；3) 应用多种正则化方法（Lasso、Elastic Net）和集成方法（随机森林、梯度提升）进行收益预测。
AI.result: 发现显著的方向不对称性：美股前一交易日收盘至当日收盘收益对A股日内收益具有显著预测能力，而反向预测效果有限。这种信息不对称转化为经济意义上显著的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: structured机器学习框架能够在保持可解释性的同时有效揭示跨市场依赖关系，为跨境信息传导研究提供了新方法论视角。

title: Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation
summary: We propose Neural Field Thermal Tomography (NeFTY), a differentiable physics framework for the quantitative 3D reconstruction of material properties from transient surface temperature measurements. While traditional thermography relies on pixel-wise 1D approximations that neglect lateral diffusion, and soft-constrained Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) often fail in transient diffusion scenarios due to gradient stiffness, NeFTY parameterizes the 3D diffusivity field as a continuous neural field optimized through a rigorous numerical solver. By leveraging a differentiable physics solver, our approach enforces thermodynamic laws as hard constraints while maintaining the memory efficiency required for high-resolution 3D tomography. Our discretize-then-optimize paradigm effectively mitigates the spectral bias and ill-posedness inherent in inverse heat conduction, enabling the recovery of subsurface defects at arbitrary scales. Experimental validation on synthetic data demonstrates that NeFTY significantly improves the accuracy of subsurface defect localization over baselines. Additional details at https://cab-lab-princeton.github.io/nefty/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Neural Field Thermal Tomography (NeFTY)：一个面向脉冲热成像无损检测的「硬约束 + 神经场」可微物理框架。它把未知热扩散率 α(x,y,z) 参数化为连续坐标 MLP（位置编码 + 余弦频率退火 + 有界 sigmoid 输出），在每一步优化中将其送入可微的隐式 Euler 有限体积求解器（面系数取调和平均以保证有效热流连续），并用离散伴随梯度把表面温度残差回传到网络权重，内存为 O(N_g) 而非 O(K·N_g·N_t)。在 1000 样本合成基准上，NeFTY 的 3D 体缺陷 IoU 达 0.45（均质）/0.37（分层），而 PINN、Causal-PINN、DCGD、SPINN 与体素网格优化均接近零；在真实 PVC 数据上取得 2D IoU 0.431、Dice 0.597、深度 Abs Rel 0.465，全面优于 PPT/TSR/SPINN/零样本 Swin-UNETR。
AI.motivation:
核心问题是三维逆热传导问题（IHCP）：仅由脉冲激光加热后的表面瞬态温度序列反演体材料热扩散率场 α(x,y,z)，实现无标签的体积级缺陷（分层、孔洞、夹杂）定量定位。这一问题被公认为最严重的病态反问题之一：抛物型前向算子强光滑，内部高频结构在到达边界前被指数衰减。
现有方法的缺陷明确：(1) 经典热成像流程（TSR、PPT、VWC）本质是逐像素一维反演，忽略横向扩散，对浅层或低展弦比缺陷有系统偏差；(2) 软约束 PINN 在刚性瞬态扩散下存在结构性梯度病理——温度代理网络 T_φ 由边界数据驱动，扩散率网络 α_θ 只能通过 PDE 残差项间接更新，导致「表面拟合很好但体场近似常数」的失败模式；(3) 监督式体学习需要真实不可得的 3D 体标签。
论文还给出理论与实验双重论证：软约束不是调参问题而是结构问题（数据梯度对 θ 恒为零），且前向映射的强光滑使低表面误差无法保证正确体重建（数据拟合悖论）。
AI.method:
**方法三要素**：(1) 神经扩散率场——坐标 MLP（10 层、宽 512、中层 skip 连接、Xavier 初始化）对归一化坐标做 Fourier 位置编码（带宽 N=12），用 Nerfies 式余弦调度逐带解掩（退火地平线 2500 步）以对抗频谱偏置与噪声放大，输出经 sigmoid 硬截断到 [α_min, α_max]=[0.003, 0.25] 保证正性与系统矩阵条件数；(2) 硬约束可微物理——均匀笛卡尔网格上的二阶有限体积扩散算子 L(α_θ)，面系数用调和平均 ā=2α_iα_{i+1}/(α_i+α_{i+1})，命题 1 证明这是单 α 有效模型下有效热流 j_α 连续性的唯一离散实现（算术平均会在高对比界面虚假漏热）；时间推进用无条件稳定的隐式 Euler，A(α_θ)=I−Δt·L 为稀疏 SPD 系统，内层以 K=50 次展开 Jacobi 迭代（7 点模板卷积 + torch.compile）求解；(3) 离散伴随优化——把状态方程写成约束 F^n=A T^n−T^{n−1}=0，构造增广拉格朗日与伴随变量 μ^n，得后向递推 A^T μ^n = μ^{n+1}+(∂ℓ^n/∂T^n)^T 及参数梯度装配公式，梯度对 θ 的数据通路非零，恢复了 θ→α_θ→T^n→J 的依赖链。目标函数为表面数据保真项 + λ·各向同性全变差正则（λ=1e-3，匹配分段常数缺陷结构）。
**理论分析**：命题 2 证明 dK_{α0}:H¹→L² 有界紧，奇异值 σ_n ≤ C(1+λ_n)^{−1/2}，由 Weyl 定律在板状域上 σ_n ≲ n^{−1/3}；推论 1 给出 Hadamard 病态性（伪逆无界，噪声沿 n 阶左奇异向量被放大 ~λ_n^{1/2}）。附录 C 证明 PINN 的梯度解耦 ∇_θ L_data = ∇_θ L_IC = 0，且 GradNorm（只缩放 λ_PDE）、SPINN（分离式 T_φ）、Causal-PINN（因果权重）、DCGD（双锥投影）均不改变这一解耦。
**实验设置**：合成数据由独立有限体积引擎 PhiFlow 生成（显式格式 + 自适应子步，避免逆犯罪），Ω=[0,10]²×[0,1]，64×64×16 网格，100 帧、Δt=0.05，每样本 1–4 个椭球/柱/盒状缺陷，缺陷-基体扩散率对比约 1:20（1:1000 时系统严重病态而迭代停滞）；真实数据为 PVC-Infrared（19 序列）与 PVC-Depth（38 序列），需三项物理适配：近均匀前面闪光初值、Fourier 数无量纲重标定、背面对流 Robin 边界。基线包括 PINN+GradNorm、SPINN、Causal-PINN、DCGD、体素网格优化、Sound-Only U-Net、PPT、TSR、Swin-UNETR 零样本迁移。
AI.result:
**合成 3D 重建**（1000 样本，95% CI）：均质设置 NeFTY MSE 3.66e-4、PSNR 18.48 dB、SSIM 0.77、体 IoU 0.45；分层设置 MSE 9.26e-4、PSNR 15.88 dB、SSIM 0.74、IoU 0.37。PINN/Causal-PINN/DCGD 的 α_θ 结果逐位相同（塌缩为近平凡常数，IoU≤0.018，PSNR 甚至为负），SPINN IoU≈0，Grid Opt. IoU 仅 0.04/0.03 且界面出现振铃。监督上界 U-Net(Full) IoU 0.72。**数据拟合悖论**：PINN 表面 PSNR 达 ~63 dB 而体 IoU 仅 0.01，SPINN ~61 dB 对 IoU 0.000，NeFTY ~82 dB 对 IoU 0.45；频域诊断 Edge F1：NeFTY 0.470±0.137，Grid Opt. 0.029，所有 PINN 变体为 0，径向功率谱仅 NeFTY 跟踪真值到 Nyquist 极限。分缺陷数/层数切片显示 NeFTY IoU 稳定在 0.34–0.51 区间。
**真实 PVC**：NeFTY 2D IoU 0.431 / Dice 0.597；深度 Abs Rel 0.465、RMSE 0.541 mm、δ<1.25 0.385、δ<1.25² 0.621、δ<1.25³ 0.743，为所有无标签方法最优。PPT/TSR 分割尚可（0.419/0.346）但深度急剧劣化（Abs Rel 3.416/13.366），因其反演公式假设半无限一维几何；零样本 Swin-UNETR 因域偏移崩溃（IoU 0.085）。
**消融**（均质/分层 IoU）：Base 0.03/0.02 → +PE 0.09/0.09 → +PE+FA 0.14/0.14 → +σ 0.18/0.14 → +HM 0.24/0.22 → 全量 +TV 0.45/0.37；TV 是最大单项增益。
**效率**：离散伴随与 Autograd 精度逐位一致（仿真误差 3.73e-8），峰值显存 21.9 MB vs 18.63 GB（降低三个数量级），反向时间减半（0.50 s vs 1.30 s），前向 0.46 s 约为 PhiFlow 隐式求解的 1/7；训练级 NeFTY 9.6 min/样本，优于 PINN 家族的 18.2–58.3 min（且基线获得 2.2× 迭代与 2× 参数）。求解器正确性另经高斯扩散验证：实测 dσ²/dt = 0.1997 vs 理论 2α = 0.2，相对误差 0.16%。
**失败模式**：浅层近源缺陷时背面边界出现与表面衰减相容但与真值不符的低 α 伪影，虽不影响 2D 分割但会传导至深度指标。
AI.conclusion:
结论与意义：NeFTY 证明在强光滑前向算子下，把离散化物理以「硬约束」嵌入优化回路比把 PDE 残差作为软惩罚更可靠；可微求解器（discretize-then-optimize）路线首次应用于热学 IHCP，填补了可微物理与热成像 NDT 之间的空白，并给出 PINN 失败的结构性（而非调参性）解释。工程上它提供了一条无需 3D 标签、可在单 GPU 上测试时反演的体积缺陷定量成像路径。
局限：(1) 测试时优化延迟约 10 min/样本，限制高-throughput 产线应用，需元学习/超网络摊销初始化；(2) 缺陷-基体对比 >1:1000 时系统严重病态、Jacobi 停滞，几何可恢复但空腔内 α 的定量幅值困难，需预条件/多重网格；(3) 缺乏真实 3D 体真值，只能以投影后的 2D/2.5D 标签评估（获取体标签需破坏性剖切或 X 射线 CT，5–96 h/样本）；(4) 浅层缺陷的背面伪影需更强背面先验、多面采集或深度自适应 TV 权重来缓解。作者定位其输出为决策支持而非安全关键部件的替代性认证，并建议对低表面敏感区随场一并报告不确定度。

title: Riemannian Geometry-Preserving Variational Autoencoder for MI-BCI Data Augmentation
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of generating synthetic electroencephalogram (EEG) covariance matrices for motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) applications. Objective: We aim to develop a generative model capable of producing high-fidelity synthetic covariance matrices while preserving their symmetric positive-definite nature. Approach: We propose a Riemannian geometry-preserving variational autoencoder (RGP-VAE) integrating geometric mappings with a composite loss function combining Riemannian distance, tangent space reconstruction accuracy and generative diversity. Results: The model generates valid, representative EEG covariance matrices, while learning a subject-invariant latent space. Synthetic data proves practically useful for MI-BCI, with its impact depending on the paired classifier. Contribution: This work introduces and validates the RGP-VAE as a geometry-preserving generative model for EEG covariance matrices, highlighting its potential for signal privacy, scalability and data augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种黎曼几何保持的变分自编码器(RGP-VAE)，用于生成Motor Imagery脑机接口的高保真EEG协方差矩阵，同时保留对称正定性质。
AI.motivation: Motor Imagery脑机接口(MI-BCI)中EEG数据获取困难且涉及隐私问题，需要生成高质量的合成协方差矩阵来解决数据不足和隐私保护的挑战。
AI.method: 提出RGP-VAE模型，集成几何映射与复合损失函数(结合黎曼距离、正切空间重建精度和生成多样性)，在保持黎曼流形结构的同时学习主体不变的潜在空间。
AI.result: 模型生成有效且具有代表性的EEG协方差矩阵，学习到主体不变的潜在空间。合成数据对MI-BCI实际有用，但其效果取决于配对分类器。
AI.conclusion: RGP-VAE作为EEG协方差矩阵的几何保持生成模型得到验证，在信号隐私、可扩展性和数据增强方面具有潜力。

title: Implicit Statistical Inference in Transformers: Approximating Likelihood-Ratio Tests In-Context
comment: Accepted at the Latent and Implicit Thinking Workshop (ICLR 2026)
summary: In-context learning (ICL) allows Transformers to adapt to novel tasks without weight updates, yet the underlying algorithms remain poorly understood. We adopt a statistical decision-theoretic perspective by investigating simple binary hypothesis testing, where the optimal policy is determined by the likelihood-ratio test. Notably, this setup provides a mathematically rigorous setting for mechanistic interpretability where the target algorithmic ground truth is known. By training Transformers on tasks requiring distinct geometries (linear shifted means vs. nonlinear variance estimation), we demonstrate that the models approximate the Bayes-optimal sufficient statistics from context up to some monotonic transformation, matching the performance of an ideal oracle estimator in nonlinear regimes. Leveraging this analytical ground truth, mechanistic analysis via logit lens and circuit alignment suggests that the model does not rely on a fixed kernel smoothing heuristic. Instead, it appears to adapt the point at which decisions become linearly decodable: exhibiting patterns consistent with a voting-style ensemble for linear tasks while utilizing a deeper sequential computation for nonlinear tasks. These findings suggest that ICL emerges from the construction of task-adaptive statistical estimators rather than simple similarity matching.

AI.tldr: 论文从统计决策理论角度研究Transformer的上下文学习能力，证明模型通过构建任务自适应的统计估计器（而非简单相似性匹配）实现ICL，并利用二元假设检验框架为机制可解释性提供了数学严格的研究范式。
AI.motivation: In-context learning (ICL)允许Transformer无需权重更新即可适应新任务，但其底层算法机制尚不清晰，缺乏严格的理论解释
AI.method: 采用统计决策理论视角，研究二元假设检验问题（最优策略为似然比检验）；训练Transformer处理不同几何结构任务：线性移位均值任务 vs 非线性方差估计任务；使用logit lens和电路对齐进行机制分析
AI.result: 模型能够近似贝叶斯最优的充分统计量（经过某种单调变换），在非线性情况下可匹配理想oracle估计器的性能；机制分析表明模型不依赖固定核平滑启发式，而是自适应调整决策的线性可解码点——线性任务呈现投票式集成模式，非线性任务使用更深层的序列计算
AI.conclusion: ICL源于任务自适应统计估计器的构建，而非简单的相似性匹配；为ICL提供了数学严格且具有可解释性的理论框架

title: HAPEns: Hardware-Aware Post-Hoc Ensembling for Tabular Data
summary: Ensembling is commonly used in machine learning on tabular data to boost predictive performance and robustness, but larger ensembles often lead to increased hardware demand. We introduce HAPEns, a post-hoc ensembling method that explicitly balances accuracy against hardware efficiency. Inspired by multi-objective and quality diversity optimization, HAPEns constructs a diverse set of ensembles along the Pareto front of predictive performance and resource usage. Existing hardware-aware post-hoc ensembling baselines are not available, highlighting the novelty of our approach. Experiments on 83 tabular classification datasets show that HAPEns significantly outperforms baselines, finding superior trade-offs for ensemble performance and deployment cost. Ablation studies also reveal that memory usage is a particularly effective objective metric. Further, we show that even a greedy ensembling algorithm can be significantly improved in this task with a static multi-objective weighting scheme.

AI.tldr: HAPEns是一种后验集成方法，在多目标优化和质量多样性优化的启发下，在预测性能和资源使用的帕累托前沿上构建多样化的集成集合，以平衡准确性和硬件效率。实验在83个表格分类数据集上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 集成方法常用于表格数据以提升预测性能和鲁棒性，但更大的集成往往导致硬件需求增加。现有硬件感知的后验集成基线不存在，因此需要一种明确平衡准确性与硬件效率的方法。
AI.method: 受多目标优化和质量多样性优化启发，HAPEns在预测性能和资源使用的帕累托前沿上构建多样化的集成集合。进一步证明，即使是贪婪集成算法也可以通过静态多目标加权方案显著改进。
AI.result: 在83个表格分类数据集上的实验表明，HAPEns显著优于基线，找到 了集成性能和部署成本的更优权衡。消融研究还表明内存使用是一个特别有效的目标指标。
AI.conclusion: HAPEns成功实现了精度与硬件效率的平衡，为硬件感知的机器学习部署提供了新的研究方向。内存使用作为目标指标具有显著效果，静态多目标加权方案也可有效改进贪婪算法。

title: Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network: Explaining Causalities With Attention
summary: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) underpin critical infrastructure and face growing cyber-physical threats due to the convergence of operational technology and networked environments. While machine learning-based anomaly detection approaches in ICS shows strong theoretical performance, deployment is often limited by poor explainability, high false-positive rates, and sensitivity to evolving system behavior, i.e., baseline drifting. We propose a Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network (STA-GNN) for unsupervised and explainable anomaly detection in ICS that models both temporal dynamics and relational structure of the system. Sensors, controllers, and network entities are represented as nodes in a dynamically learned graph, enabling the model to capture inter-dependencies across physical processes and communication patterns. Attention mechanisms provide influential relationships, supporting inspection of correlations and potential causal pathways behind detected events. The approach supports multiple data modalities, including SCADA point measurements, network flow features, and payload features, and thus enables unified cyber-physical analysis. To address operational requirements, we incorporate a conformal prediction strategy to control false alarm rates and monitor performance degradation under drifting of the environment. Our findings highlight the possibilities and limitations of model evaluation and common pitfalls in anomaly detection in ICS. Our findings emphasise the importance of explainable, drift-aware evaluation for reliable deployment of learning-based security monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向工业控制系统（ICS）的时空注意力图神经网络 STA-GNN：结合因果掩码的多头时间自注意力与动态图构建（上下文相似度 + 静态先验/可学习嵌入）、top-k 稀疏化空间注意力，再以 MLP 解码器在仅含正常运行数据的半监督设置下训练，用 MSE+BCE 混合损失做重构式异常评分，并通过注意力图/相似度图提供可解释的实体关联与因果路径；同时引入基于差分非一致性分数的共形预测阈值（α=1e-3）以控制误报率并监测基线漂移。基于 SWaT 2015/2017/2019 数据集的实验表明：物理层数据上 STA-GNN 取得 F1=0.77、FPR=0.004、检出 15 次攻击（共形阈值下 FPR=0.001、检出 20 次），NetFlow+Payload 检出能力相当，而纯 NetFlow 不可用（误报率 0.89）；约 68–75% 的告警可正确定位攻击源，60–63% 的注意力关系符合或部分符合已知因果结构。论文更重要的贡献是方法论层面的：F1 分数在 SWaT 这类高度不平衡数据上被单次级联攻击严重扭曲，需配合检出攻击数、FPR 与漂移感知评测来评估模型。
AI.motivation: ICS 支撑电力、水处理、制造业等关键基础设施，IT/OT 融合与 IIoT 使 OT 网络成为攻击目标（Stuxnet、Industroyer、Colonial Pipeline 等；近年 OT 入侵年报告数从 300 增至 1600，50–75% 勒索事件导致部分停产）。基于机器学习的异常检测虽在论文中表现良好，但落地受三重限制：(1) 可解释性差——深度模型对操作员是黑箱，而 ICS 高维、上下文强、多数 XAI 工具对时序/图模型计算昂贵且不稳定，难以给出领域可行动的归因；(2) 误报率高（高 FPR 导致告警疲劳、削弱信任）；(3) 对系统演化的基线漂移（covariate/concept drift）高度敏感。此外，ICS 缺少高质量开放数据集、攻击样本极度不平衡，使仅依赖 F1/accuracy 的基准评测失真（本文指出 SWaT 中单次级联攻击即占全部异常点的 40–60%）。作者因此寻求一个无监督、可解释、误报可控且具备漂移感知能力的检测框架。
AI.method: 模型：STA-GNN。每个实体（传感器/执行器/PLC/网络 IP）为节点，可携带多特征向量，支持多模态；输入 X∈R^{B×W×N×F}，逐时刻线性投影加可学习位置编码 P_t。①时间块：对每个节点在观测窗内做带因果掩码的多头自注意力（防信息泄漏），捕捉短期波动与长程依赖，跨时间步均值池化 + LayerNorm 得到 H∈R^{B×N×d}。②空间块：由 H_b H_b^T 得动态上下文相似度 S_ctx；静态项 S_st 或来自外部先验图 A_static（同阶段全连接、跨阶段按系统描述连接），或来自可学习实体嵌入 E E^T（ℓ2 归一化后缩放余弦相似度）；合并 S=S_ctx+λS_st（λ 可学习）。再用独立的 Q/K/V 投影做跨实体多头缩放点积注意力，logits 加 S 并以可学习温度 T 缩放，按 top-k（k=6）稀疏化、逐头独立，输出 H^(sp)=AV+βH（β 残差）。③解码器：逐实体两层 MLP + ReLU，输出 Ŷ∈R^{B×N×F}。训练：仅用假定正常数据，MixedLoss = γ_cont·MSE(连续特征) + γ_bool·BCE(布尔特征)；异常评分：逐特征误差（MSE/BCE）按同一权重聚合为实体级 e_{w,i}，再平均得窗口分数 s_w；推理时对每告警给出 top-3 贡献特征。解释：输出两张互补图——G_cs（上下文相似度图，实体间时间动态相似性，保留 top-5 边）与 G_a（有向注意力图，编码实体间影响强度与方向，仅保留与异常节点相连的强注意力边），与已知因果图/文献对照评估“定位正确性”与“因果正确性”（可判为正确/部分正确/错误）。阈值与评估：除验证集上最大化 F1 的阈值外，引入归纳式共形预测——以差分非一致性分数 c_t=max(0, s_t−s_{t−1}) 强调突增、对缓变不敏感，取校准分数的 1−α 分位数为阈值（α=1e-3，10 秒采样下约每 3 小时一次误报），在可交换性假设下给出有限样本误报保证；阈值超越次数随时间上升即提示协变量漂移，可通过再校准调整阈值。数据：SWaT 2015（7 天正常+4 天攻击、41 次攻击）、2017、2019 Jul、2019 Dec；物理层（51 节点，min–max 归一化+独热离散状态）、NetFlow（9 节点，源/目的 IP，端口熵、协议熵、收发字节/流数等）、NetFlow+Payload（追加 CIP 字节熵、字段熵、CIP 数值均值，并加入小时/星期等外生时间特征），均重采样至 10 秒；按时间顺序 80/10/10 划分训练/校准/测试，不打乱、不折叠，归一化参数仅由训练集估计以避免时间窥探。
AI.result: 1) 模型对比（F1-max 阈值）：物理层 STA-GNN 最佳（F1 0.77、FPR 0.004、检出 15 次攻击），优于简化版 STA-GNN*（0.74/0.002/11）、AE（0.72/0.003/5）、LSTM-AE（0.71/0.016/6）、LSTM-VAE（0.72/0.001/5）；K-means（0.29/0.829/26）与 SVM（0.24/0.860/33）误报极高、不可用；自回归模型 F1 接近最优却只检出 5–6 次攻击，说明 F1 具误导性。NetFlow 模态全部失败（FPR 0.83–0.90），因流级特征语义弱、噪声大；NetFlow+Payload 恢复可用（F1 0.74、FPR 0.006、检出 16 次），并与物理层联合可覆盖更多攻击。2) 共形阈值：FPR 统一降至 0.001，检出攻击数反而上升（物理层 15→20、NetFlow+Payload 16→22），但 F1 骤降至 0.01–0.03，说明 F1 与实际运维目标不一致；差分分数还抑制同一攻击episode内的重复告警，短瞬态攻击仅报一次、长时级联故障持续告警；6 天基线数据不足以支撑低于 1e-3 的保证（可交换性失效），而工业部署要求 FPR 约 1e-6（半年一次误报）。3) 漂移：2015 训练模型在 2017 数据上 FPR 升至约 1e-2（每小时 3–4 次告警），反复由 AIT201 等少数传感器触发，提示基线漂移；用 2017 重校准可恢复 FPR 保证但丧失检测能力（概念漂移证据：测试床配置/问题空间改变）；2019 Dec（NetFlow+Payload）再校准/重训练仅检出 2/6 次攻击，且逐节点平方误差上升，长期部署仍需重训练。4) 可解释性：物理层 20 次告警中 15 次正确定位攻击源、12 次正确给出因果；NetFlow+Payload 22 次告警中 15 次定位正确、14 次因果正确，整体约 68–75% 正确检测并追溯、60–63% 注意力关系正确或部分正确（如 DPIT301 攻击中 DPIT301 成为注意力中枢，与 FIT601 双向耦合，MV301/303/304 指向其，下游 PIT502 反映传播而非根因）；NetFlow 模态虽报出 9 次攻击但属“猜测”，告警落在错误 PLC 且注意力边无意义。加入弱结构先验图可显著抑制“行为相似但物理无关”的伪相关边，但可能同时滤掉长程真实依赖，属可解释性与准确性的权衡。5) 人工检查发现相当比例误报紧邻攻击发生（去掉攻击相邻告警后物理层 FPR 下降 40%），说明标准指标未反映运维相关性。
AI.conclusion: ICS 异常检测的主要瓶颈不在模型结构，而在评测与运维范式：单次长时级联攻击主导 SWaT 异常点分布，使 F1 最大化既掩盖了低检出率模型（如自回归模型仅检出 5 次却 F1≈0.72），又与真实部署目标（低误报、可行动告警）脱节；因此应联合报告 FPR、检出攻击数（AD）、定位与因果正确性，并采用基于攻击事件而非时间点的评估思路。共形预测提供可操作的误报上限并把阈值超越率变成漂移监测信号：协变量漂移可通过再校准缓解，概念漂移只能重训练，因此推荐再校准+重训练+持续 FPR 监测的漂移感知运维流程。模型层面，STA-GNN 在物理（SCADA）数据上表现最佳，NetFlow+Payload 效率更高但可解释性下降（只能定位到 PLC/IP），建议物理+网络多模态组合部署以平衡可解释性与可扩展性；注意力权重并非天然因果，需借助结构先验做归纳偏置才有意义。未来工作：集成 LLM 自动生成面向非专家的图结构化解释，在更大规模、更贴近真实的 ICS 环境中验证因果可解释性假设，并改进网络侧特征工程（写标签、更丰富的载荷级描述）。

title: Surrogate models for nuclear fusion with parametric Shallow Recurrent Decoder Networks: applications to magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) effects play a key role in the design and operation of nuclear fusion systems, where electrically conducting fluids (such as liquid metals or molten salts in reactor blankets) interact with magnetic fields of varying intensity and orientation, which affect the resulting flow. The numerical resolution of MHD models involves highly nonlinear multiphysics systems of equations and can become computationally expensive, particularly in multi-query, parametric, or real-time contexts. This work investigates a fully data-driven framework for MHD state reconstruction that combines dimensionality reduction via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) with the SHallow REcurrent Decoder (SHRED), a neural network architecture designed to recover the full spatio-temporal state from sparse time-series measurements of a limited number of observables. The methodology is applied to a parametric MHD test case involving compressible lead-lithium flow in a stepped channel subjected to thermal gradients and magnetic fields spanning a broad range of intensities. To improve efficiency, the full-order dataset is first compressed using SVD, yielding a reduced representation used as reference truth for training. Only temperature measurements from three sensors are provided as input, while the network reconstructs the full fields of velocity, pressure, and temperature. To assess robustness with respect to sensor placement, thirty randomly generated sensor configurations are tested in ensemble mode. Results show that SHRED accurately reconstructs the full MHD state even for magnetic field intensities not included in the training set. These findings demonstrate the potential of SHRED as a computationally efficient surrogate modeling strategy for fusion-relevant multiphysics problems, enabling low-cost state estimation with possible applications in real-time monitoring and control.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将 SHRED（浅层递归解码网络）结合 SVD 降维用于聚变相关 MHD 状态重构：以三个温度传感器的稀疏时间序列为输入，重构铅锂可压缩 MHD 阶梯通道流的全场（温度、速度、压力）。在 19 个磁场强度（0.01–0.5 T）数据上训练后，模型可外推至未参与训练的 0.06 T 与 0.3 T 工况，相对 L2 误差均低于 3%（强磁场场约 2%），且对传感器位置不敏感（30 组随机配置结果近乎一致），推理时间 <1 s，可用于聚变堆包层实时监测与控制。
AI.motivation: 磁流体动力学（MHD）方程是强耦合、高非线性的多物理场偏微分方程组求解代价高昂，在多工况查询、参数化研究与实时控制场景中难以承担；即使在磁约束聚变（MCF）装置中，来自等离子体腔室的残余磁场线会影响包层内的熔盐或液态金属（如铅锂）流动，堆层设计中必须考虑磁场方向与强度的影响，且需要对未预见工况做出预测。已有基于降阶模型（ROM）的数据驱动方法在 MHD/液态金属领域应用仍很有限，而纯深度学习路线需要极大训练数据集与算力，在高保真仿真昂贵、实验数据稀缺的聚变包层场景中并不可行。因此需要一种既能显著降低训练成本与内存占用、又具备跨参数泛化能力、可从少数易测物理量（温度）推断全部多物理场状态的代理模型方法。
AI.method: 框架采用“SVD 降维 + SHRED”两层结构。①高保真 FOM：二维带台阶通道内铅锂可压缩、黏-电阻 MHD 流动，采用 OpenFOAM 的 magnetoHDFoam 求解器，网格 14460 单元，台阶壁面设定冷/热温度边界（550 K/650 K）产生热梯度与浮力，垂直外加磁场 B0 均匀施加；共 19 个磁场强度工况（0.01–0.5 T），每例模拟至 3 s、每 0.025 s 存帧（N_t=120），HPC 单例约 20 min。②数据处理：各工况快照按列堆叠为统一矩阵，min-max 归一化（压力去静水项 p'=p−ρgh），划分为训练/验证/测试 ≈73.7%/15.8%/10.5%，且低磁场工况采样更密。③降维：对训练快照做 SVD，依据奇异值衰减与丢弃能量（r=20 时丢弃 <0.1%）取秩 r=20，构造覆盖整个参数空间的公共降阶基 U，得到时间系数 V 作为训练真值（构成重构误差的下界）。④SHRED 网络（PyTorch）：LSTM（2 隐藏层×64 单元）编码 3 个温度传感器的时间延迟轨迹，再经浅层解码网络 SDN（350/400 神经元）映射到 SVD 系数空间，最后由 SVD 逆投影回全阶状态空间；训练约 10 min/模型于个人电脑。⑤鲁棒性评估：30 组随机三点传感器配置分别训练 30 个模型（ensemble 模式），输出取平均并统计标准差。
AI.result: ①SHRED 仅凭 3 点温度测量即可准确重构全几何尺度的温度、速度、压力场，在 t=2 s 的快照与 FOM 几乎重合，残差仅在台阶后复杂流动区域略有可见；强磁场（0.3 T）下残差更低，因洛伦兹力抑制涡结构、流动完全层流化更易重构。②时间演化上空间平均量与 FOM 曲线在整个时窗内高度吻合；相对 L2 误差在低磁场工况随时间温和增长（速度与压力 <6%、温度 <3%），高磁场工况误差更平稳并最终稳定在约 2%，时间平均误差对所有场均 <3%，标准差很小。③30 组随机传感器配置的结果标准差在全几何与全时窗内保持低位，证明 SHRED 对传感器位置具有强鲁棒性/位置无关性。④单个跨越宽磁场区间训练的模型同时重建弱磁化动态演化流态与强磁阻尼层流流态，具备跨参数泛化能力；推理时间 <1 s（相对 FOM 每例 20 min），训练成本降至笔记本级。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将 SHRED 应用于聚变相关 MHD 物理，证明“SVD 降维 + 浅层递归解码”能在低维物理约束空间内学习 MHD 时空动力学，实现基于最易测量的温度信号的完整多物理场状态反演，且泛化到训练未覆盖的磁场强度、对传感器位置不敏感，兼具低训练成本与准实时推理能力，适合作为聚变堆层监测、诊断与实时控制的代理模型。局限与展望：当前仅为二维、单一参数（垂直磁场强度）、特定台阶通道几何；未来将推广至三维与更真实的堆层几何，并处理时变磁场剖面、多空间分量磁场及多参数空间（如入口速度、磁场方向）。

title: Riemannian MeanFlow for One-Step Generation on Manifolds
summary: Flow Matching enables simulation-free training of generative models on Riemannian manifolds, yet sampling typically still relies on numerically integrating a probability-flow ODE. We propose Riemannian MeanFlow (RMF), extending MeanFlow to manifold-valued generation where velocities lie in location-dependent tangent spaces. RMF defines an average-velocity field via parallel transport and derives a Riemannian MeanFlow identity that links average and instantaneous velocities for intrinsic supervision. We make this identity practical in a log-map tangent representation, avoiding trajectory simulation and heavy geometric computations. For stable optimization, we decompose the RMF objective into two terms and apply conflict-aware multi-task learning to mitigate gradient interference. RMF also supports conditional generation via classifier-free guidance. Experiments on spheres, tori, and SO(3) demonstrate competitive one-step sampling with improved quality-efficiency trade-offs and substantially reduced sampling cost.

AI.tldr: RMF将MeanFlow扩展到黎曼流形上的生成式建模，通过平行移动定义平均速度场，并建立黎曼MeanFlow恒等式连接平均速度与瞬时速度进行内在监督。在对数映射切空间表示中实现，避免了轨迹模拟和繁重几何计算。通过冲突感知多任务学习缓解梯度干扰。支持无分类器引导的条件生成。在球面、环面和SO(3)上实现竞争性单步采样，显著降低采样成本。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching在黎曼流形上实现了无模拟训练，但采样仍需数值积分概率流ODE，效率较低。需要一种流形上的高效单步采样方法。
AI.method: 1) 通过平行移动定义平均速度场，建立黎曼MeanFlow恒等式连接平均与瞬时速度 2) 在对数映射切空间表示中实现，避免轨迹模拟 3) 分解RMF目标为两项，应用冲突感知多任务学习缓解梯度干扰 4) 支持无分类器引导的条件生成
AI.result: 在球面、环面和SO(3)上实现竞争性单步采样，改善质量-效率权衡，显著降低采样成本
AI.conclusion: RMF成功将MeanFlow扩展到流形值生成，在保持训练无模拟的同时实现高效单步采样，为黎曼流形上的生成式模型提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Reliability and Uncertainty Estimation in Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have become integral to a wide range of scientific and practical applications due to their flexibility and strong predictive performance. Despite their accuracy, however, DNNs frequently exhibit poor calibration, often assigning overly confident probabilities to incorrect predictions. This limitation underscores the growing need for integrated mechanisms that provide reliable uncertainty estimation. In this article, we compare two prominent approaches for uncertainty quantification: a Bayesian approximation via Monte Carlo Dropout and the nonparametric Conformal Prediction framework. Both methods are assessed using two convolutional neural network architectures; H-CNN VGG16 and GoogLeNet, trained on the Fashion-MNIST dataset. The empirical results show that although H-CNN VGG16 attains higher predictive accuracy, it tends to exhibit pronounced overconfidence, whereas GoogLeNet yields better-calibrated uncertainty estimates. Conformal Prediction additionally demonstrates consistent validity by producing statistically guaranteed prediction sets, highlighting its practical value in high-stakes decision-making contexts. Overall, the findings emphasize the importance of evaluating model performance beyond accuracy alone and contribute to the development of more reliable and trustworthy deep learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Fashion-MNIST 上对两种主流不确定性量化方法——贝叶斯近似的蒙特卡罗 Dropout（MC Dropout）与非参数的归纳式保形预测（ICP）——在两种结构迥异的 CNN（层级式 H-CNN VGG16 与 Inception 结构的 GoogLeNet）上做并列实证比较。研究显示：H-CNN VGG16 准确率更高（92.99% vs 89.72%）但参数规模庞大（1.8 亿 vs 1200 万）、训练慢近十倍且呈现明显过自信（ECE 5.66%→5.61%，改善微弱）；GoogLeNet 虽准确率较低但校准显著更好（ECE 2.82%→1.37%），能更诚实地分解并表达认知/偶然不确定性。CP 在两模型上均达到 95% 名义覆盖，具统计有效性保证，但预测集较宽、效率较低。结论强调：评估深度模型不应只看准确率，而应同时考察校准与不确定性可靠性，两方法具有互补性——MC Dropout 捕捉模型内部不确定性，CP 则提供不受校准质量影响的覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络虽预测性能强，但普遍存在校准不良（过度自信）问题，softmax 输出的置信度与真实正确率不匹配，在医疗诊断、自动驾驶等高风险场景中直接依赖 softmax 置信度具有误导性。目前文献中对贝叶斯类方法（MC Dropout）与保形预测（Conformal Prediction）在同一基准、跨不同 CNN 架构上的系统对比十分匮乏，且"高准确率是否等于可信预测"仍不明确——模型往往在错误时仍给出高置信度。此外，架构设计如何影响不确定性量化行为几乎未被系统考察。
AI.method: 在 Fashion-MNIST（60,000 训练 / 2,000 校准 / 8,000 测试）上对比 H-CNN VGG16（Seo & Shin, 2019，层级分类 + dropout + loss weight scheduling）与 GoogLeNet（Szegedy et al., 2015，Inception 并行卷积路径），统一 batch size、学习率、epoch 数，采用 5 折交叉验证，硬件为 RTX 3080。UQ 方法：(1) MC Dropout，测试时保留 dropout，做 T=50 次随机前向传播，均值给预测，方差/互信息（epistemic）与平均熵（aleatoric）量化不确定性；(2) 归纳式保形预测 ICP，用 2,000 样本校准集计算非一致性分数 s_i = 1 - f̂(X_i)_{y_i}，取第 ⌈(n+1)(1-α)/n⌉ 小的分位数阈值 q̂ 构造预测集。评估指标：准确率、训练时长、参数量、混淆矩阵、过拟合曲线（Global Magnitude Pruning 阈值下的稀疏度诊断）、ECE、预测熵（样本级与类别级、正确/错误对比）、互信息、平均熵、CP 的经验覆盖率（validity）与平均预测集大小（efficiency），以及 CP 集大小与 MC Dropout 预测熵的相关性散点分析。
AI.result: 1）准确率与效率：H-CNN VGG16 最佳 92.99%（5 折均值 92.62%），GoogLeNet 最佳 89.72%（均值 88.24%）；但参数量 1.8 亿 vs 1,196 万，单折训练 12,342s vs 1,429s。MC Dropout 使两者准确率略降（92.47% / 88.68%），且推理需 50 次前向传播。2）校准：GoogLeNet ECE 从 2.82% 降至 1.37%，改善显著；H-CNN VGG16 仅从 5.66% 微降至 5.61%，仍严重过自信。3）过拟合：H-CNN VGG16 训练/验证差距明显（验证准确率约 93% 早停），GoogLeNet 训练验证曲线平行、泛化更稳。4）稀疏度：两模型稀疏度曲线均在阈值约 0.001 处出现"肘部"，MC Dropout 不改变权重分布（推理期 dropout 不影响已训练权重），与完整贝叶斯先验正则化形成对照。5）CP：两模型经验覆盖率均达 95%（ICP 框架下自适应置信带），H-CNN VGG16 预测集更紧凑（1 个标签 7,551 例，2 个 398 例），GoogLeNet 更保守分散（1 个 6,431，2 个 1,377，3 个 185，4 个 7）；Shirt 类预测集最宽，与混淆矩阵中高误分类一致。6）不确定性分解：H-CNN VGG16 预测熵与期望熵分布相近而互信息很低 → 不确定性以偶然不确定性为主、认知不确定性被低估；GoogLeNet 三者均更高更宽 → 同时捕捉参数与数据歧义。7）熵-集大小关系：H-CNN VGG16 中两者单调一致（低熵对应单标签集），GoogLeNet 中相关性弱（保守概率分配导致低熵仍产生大集合）。8）混淆矩阵：两模型共同难点为 Shirt/T-shirt/Pullover/Coat。
AI.conclusion: 研究的核心结论是"准确率之外必须评估可靠性"：H-CNN VGG16 虽准确率高，却表现出持续性过度自信，其 MC Dropout 互信息极低说明对认知不确定性的估计不足，且模型规模过大（1.8 亿参数）导致过拟合与训练成本高昂；GoogLeNet 准确率低约 3 个百分点，但 ECE 更低、熵分布更宽、能区分正确/错误样本并显式暴露 Shirt、Coat、Pullover 等视觉相近类别的歧义，因此是更可靠、更具实用价值的选择。两种 UQ 范式互补：MC Dropout 提供模型内部（参数级）不确定性的可解释量化，CP 则在无分布假设下给出有限样本覆盖保证（实测 95%），可作为对弱校准模型的"纠偏机制"，代价是预测集偏宽、效率下降。总体而言，二者都表明高准确率不等于高可信度，实践部署（尤其高风险决策、需转交人工审核的场景）应联合考察校准误差、覆盖率与预测集效率，并兼顾精度—可靠性—算力成本三者权衡。局限方面：仅在 Fashion-MNIST 单数据集与两个架构上验证、仅使用 ICP 与 50 次 MC 采样、缺少分布外/协变量偏移与多随机种子显著性检验。

title: A Grammar of Machine Learning Workflows
comment: 37 pages, 1 figure, 15 tables. Three implementations: Python (PyPI: mlw), R (CRAN: ml), Julia. Code: github.com/epagogy/ml
summary: Data leakage affected 294 published papers across 17 scientific fields (Kapoor & Narayanan, 2023). The dominant response has been documentation: checklists, linters, best-practice guides. Documentation does not prevent these failures. This paper proposes a structural remedy: a grammar that decomposes the supervised learning lifecycle into 7 kernel primitives connected by a typed directed acyclic graph (DAG), with four hard constraints that reject the two most damaging leakage classes at call time. The grammar's core contribution is the terminal assess constraint: a runtime-enforced evaluate/assess boundary where repeated test-set assessment is rejected by a guard on a nominally distinct Evidence type. A companion study across 2,047 experimental instances quantifies why this matters: selection leakage inflates performance by d_z = 0.93 and memorization leakage by d_z = 0.53-1.11. Three separate implementations (Python, R, and Julia) confirm the claims. The appendix specification lets anyone build a conforming version.

AI.tldr: 针对监督学习中的数据泄漏问题，论文提出一种基于7个内核原语和类型化DAG的语法结构，通过运行时终端评估约束在调用时拒绝两类最严重的泄漏。实验证明该方法能有效检测和防止选择泄漏和记忆泄漏。
AI.motivation: 数据泄漏影响了17个科学领域的294篇已发表论文，现有的文档化解决方案（清单、linter、最佳实践指南）无法防止此类失败发生，需要一种结构性的技术手段来从根本上解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一种将监督学习生命周期分解为7个内核原语的语法，通过类型化有向无环图（DAG）连接，原语通过四个硬约束进行规范，其中终端评估约束作为核心创新，在运行时通过守卫机制拒绝重复测试集评估。
AI.result: 跨2,047个实验实例的伴随研究表明：选择泄漏使性能膨胀d_z = 0.93，记忆泄漏使性能膨胀d_z = 0.53-1.11。三个独立实现（Python、R、Julia）确认了claims的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种基于语法的结构化解决方案，通过7个内核原语和类型化DAG构建监督学习生命周期，并引入终端评估约束在运行时强制执行评估/评估边界。实验证明该方法能有效抵抗选择泄漏和记忆泄漏，d_z值分别为0.93和0.53-1.11。三个实现版本（Python、R、Julia）验证了可行性。

title: Prioritizing Gradient Sign Over Modulus: An Importance-Aware Framework for Wireless Federated Learning
summary: Wireless federated learning (FL) facilitates collaborative training of artificial intelligence (AI) models to support ubiquitous intelligent applications at the wireless edge. However, the inherent constraints of limited wireless resources inevitably lead to unreliable communication, which poses a significant challenge to wireless FL. To overcome this challenge, we propose Sign-Prioritized FL (SP-FL), a novel framework that improves wireless FL by prioritizing the transmission of important gradient information through uneven resource allocation. Specifically, recognizing the importance of descent direction in model updating, we transmit gradient signs in individual packets and allow their reuse for gradient descent if the remaining gradient modulus cannot be correctly recovered. To further improve the reliability of transmission of important information, we formulate a hierarchical resource allocation problem based on the importance disparity at both the packet and device levels, optimizing bandwidth allocation across multiple devices and power allocation between sign and modulus packets. To make the problem tractable, the one-step convergence behavior of SP-FL, which characterizes data importance at both levels in an explicit form, is analyzed. We then propose an alternating optimization algorithm to solve this problem using the Newton-Raphson method and successive convex approximation (SCA). Simulation results confirm the superiority of SP-FL, especially in resource-constrained scenarios, demonstrating up to 9.96\% higher testing accuracy on the CIFAR-10 dataset compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sign-Prioritized FL (SP-FL)框架，通过对梯度符号进行优先级传输和资源分层分配，解决无线资源受限环境下联邦学习的通信可靠性问题，在CIFAR-10数据集上实现最高9.96%的测试精度提升。
AI.motivation: 无线联邦学习(FL)支持无线边缘的智能应用，但有限无线资源导致的不可靠通信成为主要挑战，亟需一种能够在资源受限场景下保证模型训练质量的方案。
AI.method: 1. 识别梯度下降方向的重要性，将梯度符号单独传输；2. 当梯度模值无法正确恢复时，重复利用梯度符号进行梯度下降；3. 在数据包和设备两个层面构建分层资源分配问题，优化多设备带宽分配和符号/模值数据包的功率分配；4. 分析SP-FL的一步收敛行为，采用Newton-Raphson方法和连续凸近似(SCA)求解优化问题。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集上，SP-FL相比现有方法最高提升9.96%的测试精度，尤其在资源受限场景下表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度符号优先传输和分层资源分配策略，SP-FL有效解决了无线FL中的通信可靠性问题，为资源受限环境下的边缘智能应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Dynamics-Informed Deep Learning for Predicting Extreme Events
summary: Predicting extreme events in high-dimensional chaotic dynamical systems remains a fundamental challenge, as such events are rare, intermittent, and arise from transient dynamical mechanisms that are difficult to infer from limited observations. Accordingly, real-time forecasting calls for precursors that encode the mechanisms driving extremes, rather than relying solely on statistical associations. We propose a fully data-driven framework for long-lead prediction of extreme events that constructs interpretable, mechanism-aware precursors by explicitly tracking transient instabilities preceding event onset. The approach leverages a reduced-order formulation to compute finite-time Lyapunov exponent (FTLE)-like precursors directly from state snapshots, without requiring knowledge of the governing equations. To avoid the prohibitive computational cost of classical FTLE computation, instability growth is evaluated in an adaptively evolving low-dimensional subspace spanned by Optimal Time-Dependent (OTD) modes, enabling efficient identification of transiently amplifying directions. These precursors are then provided as input to a Transformer-based model, enabling forecast of extreme event observables. We demonstrate the framework on Kolmogorov flow, a canonical model of intermittent turbulence. The results show that explicitly encoding transient instability mechanisms substantially extends practical prediction horizons compared to baseline observable-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种完全数据驱动的框架，用于长期预测高维混沌系统中的极端事件。该框架通过显式跟踪事件发生前的瞬态不稳定性来构建可解释的、机制感知的预兆器，并利用降阶公式计算有限时间Lyapunov指数（FTLE）类预兆器。为避免经典FTLE计算的高计算成本，使用自适应演化的低维子空间（由最优时变模式OTD模式张成）来评估不稳定性增长。然后将这些预兆器输入基于Transformer的模型，以预测极端事件可观测量。在Kolmogorov流上的实验表明，显式编码瞬态不稳定性机制显著延长了实际预测时间范围。
AI.motivation: 高维混沌系统中的极端事件预测是一个根本性挑战，因为这些事件稀少、间歇性，并且源于难以从有限观测中推断的瞬态动力学机制。现有方法主要依赖统计关联，缺乏对驱动极端事件机制的编码，导致预测时间范围有限。
AI.method: 1) 使用降阶公式直接根据状态快照计算FTLE类预兆器，无需知道控制方程；2) 引入最优时变模式（OTD）模式，在自适应演化的低维子空间中评估不稳定性增长，避免经典FTLE的高计算成本；3) 将预兆器输入基于Transformer的模型预测极端事件可观测量。
AI.result: 在Kolmogorov流（典型的间歇湍流模型）上验证框架，结果表明显式编码瞬态不稳定性机制显著延长了实际预测时间范围，优于仅基于可观测量的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了高维混沌系统中极端事件的长期预测，通过机制感知的预兆器（OTD-FTLE）结合深度学习（Transformer），为实际应用中的实时预测提供了可行途径。

title: Evaluating randomized smoothing as a defense against adversarial attacks in trajectory prediction
summary: Accurate and robust trajectory prediction is essential for safe and efficient autonomous driving, yet recent work has shown that even state-of-the-art prediction models are highly vulnerable to inputs being mildly perturbed by adversarial attacks. Although model vulnerabilities to such attacks have been studied, work on effective countermeasures remains limited. In this work, we develop and evaluate a new defense mechanism for trajectory prediction models based on randomized smoothing -- an approach previously applied successfully in other domains. We evaluate its ability to improve model robustness through a series of experiments that test different strategies of randomized smoothing. We show that our approach can consistently improve prediction robustness of multiple base trajectory prediction models in various datasets without compromising accuracy in non-adversarial settings. Our results demonstrate that randomized smoothing offers a simple and computationally inexpensive technique for mitigating adversarial attacks in trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动驾驶轨迹预测模型易受对抗攻击的问题，提出基于随机平滑的防御机制，实验表明该方法可提升模型鲁棒性且不牺牲正常情况下的准确性。
AI.motivation: 安全高效的自动驾驶需要准确且鲁棒的轨迹预测，但现有研究表明即使是先进的预测模型也容易受到轻微对抗扰动攻击，而针对此类攻击的有效防御措施研究有限。
AI.method: 提出基于随机平滑的防御机制，通过在轨迹预测模型中应用不同策略的随机平滑来抵御对抗扰动攻击。
AI.result: 该方法在多种数据集上对多个基础轨迹预测模型进行评估，结果显示能够持续提升预测鲁棒性，且不影响非对抗环境下的预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 随机平滑是一种简单且计算成本低廉的技术，可有效缓解轨迹预测中的对抗攻击，在不牺牲非对抗环境下准确性的前提下，显著提升多种基础轨迹预测模型的预测鲁棒性。

title: 6ABOS: An Open-Source Atmospheric Correction Framework for the EnMAP Hyperspectral Mission Based on 6S
summary: The Environmental Mapping and Analysis Program (EnMAP) mission has opened new frontiers in the monitoring of optically complex environments. However, the accurate retrieval of surface reflectance over water bodies remains a significant challenge, as the water-leaving signal typically accounts for only a small fraction of the total radiance, being easily obscured by atmospheric scattering and surface reflection effects. This paper introduces 6ABOS (6S-based Atmospheric Background Offset Subtraction), a novel open-source Python framework designed to automate the atmospheric correction (AC) of EnMAP hyperspectral imagery. By leveraging the Second Simulation of the Satellite Signal in the Solar Spectrum (6S) radiative transfer model, 6ABOS implements a physically-based inversion scheme that accounts for Rayleigh scattering, aerosol interactions, and gaseous absorption. The framework integrates automated EnMAP metadata parsing with dynamic atmospheric parameter retrieval via the Google Earth Engine (GEE) Application Programming Interface (API). Validation was conducted over two Mediterranean inland water reservoirs with contrasting trophic states: the oligotrophic Benag{'e}ber and the hypertrophic Bell{'u}s. Results demonstrate a high degree of spectral similarity between in situ measurements and EnMAP-derived water-leaving reflectances. The Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) values remained consistently low (SAM $<$ 10$^\circ$) across both study sites. 6ABOS is distributed via conda-forge, providing the scientific community with a scalable, transparent, and reproducible open-science tool for advancing hyperspectral aquatic research in the cloud-computing era.

AI.tldr: 6ABOS是一个基于6S辐射传输模型的开源Python框架，用于自动处理EnMAP高光谱图像的大气校正。该框架通过整合EnMAP元数据自动解析和Google Earth Engine动态大气参数检索，实现了对水体表面反射率的精确反演，并在两个地中海水库验证取得良好效果（SAM < 10°）。
AI.motivation: EnMAP任务为监测光学复杂环境开辟了新前沿，但水体表面反射率的准确获取仍面临重大挑战。水体信号通常只占总辐射的一小部分，容易被大气散射和表面反射效应所掩盖。
AI.method: 采用6S辐射传输模型实现物理基础的反演方案，考虑瑞利散射、气溶胶相互作用和气体吸收；集成EnMAP元数据自动解析与GEE API动态大气参数检索。
AI.result: 在两个具有不同营养状态的地中海水库（贫营养的Benagáber和富营养的Bellús）进行验证，原位测量与EnMAP反演的水体离水反射率呈现高度光谱一致性，光谱角 mapper（SAM）值始终保持在10°以下。
AI.conclusion: 6ABOS通过conda-forge分发，为科学界提供了可扩展、透明且可复现的开源工具，推动了云计算时代高光谱水体研究的进展。

title: SNPgen: Phenotype-Supervised Genotype Representation and Synthetic Data Generation via Latent Diffusion
summary: Polygenic risk scores and other genomic analyses require large individual-level genotype datasets, yet strict data access restrictions impede sharing. Synthetic genotype generation offers a privacy-preserving alternative, but most existing methods operate unconditionally, producing samples without phenotype alignment, or rely on unsupervised compression, creating a gap between statistical fidelity and downstream task utility. We present SNPgen, a two-stage conditional latent diffusion framework for generating phenotype-supervised synthetic genotypes. SNPgen combines GWAS-guided variant selection (1,024-2,048 trait-associated SNPs) with a variational autoencoder for genotype compression and a latent diffusion model conditioned on binary disease labels via classifier-free guidance. Evaluated on 458,724 UK Biobank individuals across four complex diseases (coronary artery disease, breast cancer, type 1 and type 2 diabetes), models trained on synthetic data matched real-data predictive performance in a train-on-synthetic, test-on-real protocol, approaching genome-wide PRS methods that use $2$-$6\times$ more variants. Privacy analysis confirmed zero identical matches, near-random membership inference (AUC $\approx 0.50$), preserved linkage disequilibrium structure, and high allele frequency correlation ($r \geq 0.95$) with source data. A controlled simulation with known causal effects verified faithful recovery of the imposed genetic association structure.

AI.tldr: SNPgen是一种用于生成表型监督合成基因型的两阶段条件潜在扩散框架，通过GWAS引导的变异选择、变分自编码器压缩和潜在扩散模型，在仅使用1,024-2,048个SNP的情况下实现与全基因组PRS相当的预测性能，同时保证隐私安全。
AI.motivation: 多基因风险评分和其他基因组分析需要大规模个体级基因型数据集，但严格的数据访问限制阻碍了数据共享。现有合成基因型生成方法要么无条件产生样本（无表型对齐），要么依赖无监督压缩，导致统计保真度与下游任务实用性之间存在差距。
AI.method: 两阶段条件潜在扩散框架：1）GWAS引导的变异选择（1,024-2,048个性状相关SNP）；2）变分自编码器用于基因型压缩；3）潜在扩散模型通过无分类器引导以二元疾病标签为条件进行训练。
AI.result: 在458,724名英国生物银行个体上针对四种复杂疾病（冠状动脉疾病、乳腺癌、1型和2型糖尿病）进行评估。在"在合成数据上训练、在真实数据上测试"协议中，合成数据训练的模型匹配了真实数据的预测性能，接近使用2-6倍变异的全基因组PRS方法。隐私分析确认零相同匹配、接近随机的成员推断（AUC≈0.50）、保留的连锁不平衡结构以及与源数据的高等位基因频率相关性（r≥0.95）。具有已知因果效应的受控模拟验证了所施加遗传关联结构的忠实恢复。
AI.conclusion: SNPgen成功生成了表型监督的合成基因型，在保护隐私的同时保持了下游任务的实用性。通过条件潜在扩散模型，在仅使用1,024-2,048个SNP的情况下，实现了与全基因组PRS方法相当的预测性能（后者使用2-6倍的变异数量）。隐私分析证实了零相同匹配、接近随机的成员推断（ AUC≈0.50）、保留的连锁不平衡结构以及与源数据的高等位基因频率相关性（r≥0.95）。

title: LAtte: Hyperbolic Lorentz Attention for Cross-Subject EEG Classification
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) classification is critical for applications ranging from medical diagnostics to brain-computer interfaces, yet it remains challenging due to the inherently low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and high inter-subject variability. To address these issues, we propose LAtte, a novel framework that integrates a Lorentz Attention Module with an InceptionTime-based encoder to enable robust and generalizable EEG classification. Unlike prior work, which evaluates primarily on single-subject performance, LAtte focuses on cross-subject training. First, we learn a shared baseline signal across all subjects using pretraining tasks to capture common underlying patterns. Then, we utilize novel Lorentz low-rank adapters to learn subject-specific embeddings that model individual differences. This allows us to learn a shared model that performs robustly across subjects, and can be subsequently finetuned for individual subjects or used to generalize to unseen subjects. We evaluate LAtte on three well-established EEG datasets, achieving a substantial improvement in performance over current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: LAtte是一个用于脑电信号分类的创新框架，通过结合Lorentz注意力模块和InceptionTime编码器，解决脑电信号低信噪比和高度受试者间差异性的难题。该方法采用跨受试者训练策略，通过预训练学习共享基线信号，并利用Lorentz低秩适配器学习受试者特定嵌入，在三个脑电数据集上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 脑电信号分类在医学诊断和脑机接口等领域具有重要应用，但面临两个核心挑战：一是信号本身信噪比低，二是受试者间存在高度变异性。现有方法主要关注单受试者性能，缺乏有效的跨受试者泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出LAtte框架，包含三个关键技术组件：1) Lorentz注意力模块，用于捕获脑电信号的内在几何结构；2) InceptionTime编码器，提取多尺度时序特征；3) Lorentz低秩适配器，用于学习受试者特定嵌入。训练策略采用两阶段：首先通过预训练任务学习所有受试者的共享基线信号，然后利用低秩适配器建模个体差异，最终实现跨受试者的鲁棒分类。
AI.result: 在三个公认的脑电数据集上，LAtte相比当前最先进方法实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: LAtte框架成功地实现了跨受试者的脑电分类，通过共享模型与受试者特定适配器的结合，既保证了跨受试者的泛化能力，又保留了对个体进行微调的灵活性，为脑电信号的鲁棒分类提供了新的有效途径。

title: Ergodicity in reinforcement learning
comment: Accepted article to appear in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences
summary: In reinforcement learning, we typically aim to optimize the expected value of the sum of rewards an agent collects over a trajectory. However, if the process generating these rewards is non-ergodic, the expected value, i.e., the average over infinitely many trajectories with a given policy, is uninformative for the average over a single, but infinitely long trajectory. Thus, if we care about how the individual agent performs during deployment, the expected value is not a good optimization objective. In this paper, we discuss the impact of non-ergodic reward processes on reinforcement learning agents through an instructive example, relate the notion of ergodic reward processes to more widely used notions of ergodic Markov chains, and present existing solutions that optimize long-term performance of individual trajectories under non-ergodic reward dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了非遍历性奖励过程对强化学习的影响，指出标准RL优化的期望值在非遍历情况下无法反映单个智能体在部署时的实际长期表现，并介绍了相关解决方案。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习中，通常优化期望累积奖励，但当奖励过程非遍历时，期望值（无限多条轨迹的平均）无法代表单条无限长轨迹的平均表现。这对于关心智能体实际部署表现的应用场景是个问题。
AI.method: 本文通过示例说明非遍历性奖励过程的影响，将遍历性奖励过程的概念与更广泛的遍历性马尔可夫链概念联系起来，并综述了现有解决方案。
AI.result: 本文阐明了非遍历性奖励过程的问题，提供了理解该问题的直观例子，并将相关概念系统化，同时总结了优化非遍历动态下单条轨迹长期性能的方法。
AI.conclusion: 在非遍历性奖励过程下，传统的期望值优化目标不适用，需要采用针对单条轨迹长期性能的优化方法。

title: NCAA Bracket Prediction Using Machine Learning and Combinatorial Fusion Analysis
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Published in Proceedings of the 2024 IEEE Cyber Science and Technology Congress (CyberSciTech)
summary: Machine learning models have demonstrated remarkable success in sports prediction in the past years, often treating sports prediction as a classification task within the field. This paper introduces new perspectives for analyzing sports data to predict outcomes more accurately. We leverage rankings to generate team rankings for the 2024 dataset using Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a new paradigm for combining multiple scoring systems through the rank-score characteristic (RSC) function and cognitive diversity (CD). Our result based on rank combination with respect to team ranking has an accuracy rate of $74.60\%$, which is higher than the best of the ten popular public ranking systems ($73.02\%$). This exhibits the efficacy of CFA in enhancing the precision of sports prediction through different lens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将组合融合分析（CFA）应用于体育预测，通过RSC函数和认知多样性整合多个排名系统，在2024数据集上实现74.60%准确率，优于单一最佳公共排名系统的73.02%。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型通常将体育预测视为分类任务，作者认为需要引入新视角来提高预测准确性。现有排名系统众多，但单一系统存在局限性，因此提出通过组合多个排名系统来提升预测效果。
AI.method: 采用组合融合分析（CFA）方法，利用秩-分数特征（RSC）函数和认知多样性（CD）将多个评分系统进行组合融合，生成球队排名。
AI.result: 基于排名组合的CFA方法达到74.60%的准确率，高于十个流行公共排名系统中最佳系统的73.02%，提升了约1.58个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CFA通过RSC函数和认知多样性结合多种排名系统，在2024数据集上实现了74.60%的准确率，优于最佳公共排名系统（73.02%），证明了该方法在体育预测中的有效性和优越性。

title: ECoLAD: Deployment-Oriented Evaluation for Automotive Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary:
Time-series anomaly detectors are commonly compared on workstation-class hardware under unconstrained execution. In-vehicle monitoring, however, requires predictable latency and stable behavior under limited CPU parallelism. Accuracy-only leaderboards can therefore misrepresent which methods remain feasible under deployment-relevant constraints.
  We present ECoLAD (Efficiency Compute Ladder for Anomaly Detection), a deployment-oriented evaluation protocol instantiated as an empirical study on proprietary automotive telemetry (anomaly rate ${\approx}$0.022) and complementary public benchmarks. ECoLAD applies a monotone compute-reduction ladder across heterogeneous detector families using mechanically determined, integer-only scaling rules and explicit CPU thread caps, while logging every applied configuration change. Throughput-constrained behavior is characterized by sweeping target scoring rates and reporting (i) coverage (the fraction of entities meeting the target) and (ii) the best AUC-PR achievable among measured ladder configurations satisfying the target. On constrained automotive telemetry, lightweight classical detectors sustain both coverage and detection lift above the random baseline across the full throughput sweep. Several deep methods lose feasibility before they lose accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ECoLAD（效率计算阶梯异常检测），一种面向部署的评估协议，用于在有限CPU并行性条件下评估时序异常检测器。传统的准确率排行榜未能考虑实际部署中的延迟和资源约束，ECoLAD通过单调计算减少阶梯、整数缩放规则和明确的CPU线程上限来评估检测器在吞吐量约束下的覆盖率和AUC-PR表现。
AI.motivation: 当前时序异常检测器通常在工作站级硬件上仅针对准确率进行评估，忽略了实际部署中的资源约束。在车辆监控场景中，需要可预测的延迟和有限的CPU并行性下的稳定行为。传统准确率排行榜可能无法真实反映哪些方法在实际部署条件下仍可行。
AI.method: ECoLAD采用单调计算减少阶梯方法，跨异构检测器家族使用机械确定的、仅整数缩放规则和明确的CPU线程上限进行评估。记录每个配置变更，通过扫描目标评分率来表征吞吐量约束行为，报告覆盖率（在目标下满足条件的实体比例）和满足目标的可达到的最佳AUC-PR。
AI.result: 在约束条件下的汽车遥测数据上，轻量级经典检测器在整个吞吐量扫描范围内维持了覆盖率和检测提升（高于随机基线）。若干深度学习方法在失去准确性之前就失去了可行性。
AI.conclusion: 准确率-only的排行榜可能无法准确反映检测器在实际部署约束下的可行性。轻量级经典方法在资源受限环境中更具实用性，而部分深度学习方法虽然准确率高但因计算成本过高而不适合部署。

title: Quantifying Membership Disclosure Risk for Tabular Synthetic Data Using Kernel Density Estimators
summary: The use of synthetic data has become increasingly popular as a privacy-preserving alternative to sharing real datasets, especially in sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and demography. However, the privacy assurances of synthetic data are not absolute, and remain susceptible to membership inference attacks (MIAs), where adversaries aim to determine whether a specific individual was present in the dataset used to train the generator. In this work, we propose a practical and effective method to quantify membership disclosure risk in tabular synthetic datasets using kernel density estimators (KDEs). Our KDE-based approach models the distribution of nearest-neighbour distances between synthetic data and the training records, allowing probabilistic inference of membership and enabling robust evaluation via ROC curves. We propose two attack models: a 'True Distribution Attack', which assumes privileged access to training data, and a more realistic, implementable 'Realistic Attack' that uses auxiliary data without true membership labels. Empirical evaluations across four real-world datasets and six synthetic data generators demonstrate that our method consistently achieves higher F1 scores and sharper risk characterization than a prior baseline approach, without requiring computationally expensive shadow models. The proposed method provides a practical framework and metric for quantifying membership disclosure risk in synthetic data, which enables data custodians to conduct a post-generation risk assessment prior to releasing their synthetic datasets for downstream use. The datasets and codes for this study are available at https://github.com/PyCoder913/MIA-KDE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于核密度估计(KDE)的成员泄露风险量化方法，用于评估表格合成数据的隐私风险。该方法通过建模合成数据与训练记录之间的最近邻距离分布，实现成员关系的概率推断，无需影子模型即可进行风险评估。
AI.motivation: 合成数据虽作为隐私保护替代方案日益流行，但其隐私保证并非绝对，仍易受成员推断攻击(MIA)影响。现有的风险量化方法存在局限，需要计算昂贵的影子模型，缺乏实用的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出基于核密度估计(KDE)的方法，通过对合成数据与训练数据之间最近邻距离的分布进行建模，实现成员关系的概率推断，并使用ROC曲线进行鲁棒评估。设计了两种攻击模型：1)真实分布攻击(True Distribution Attack)，假设对训练数据具有特权访问；2)现实攻击(Realistic Attack)，使用辅助数据而不依赖真实成员标签。实验在四个真实世界数据集和六个合成数据生成器上评估。
AI.result: 该方法在四个真实世界数据集和六个合成数据生成器上的实证评估表明，其F1分数始终高于基线方法，风险表征更精确，且无需使用计算昂贵的影子模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的KDE方法在F1分数和风险表征方面均优于基线方法，且无需计算昂贵的影子模型。该方法为数据管理者提供了一个实用的框架和度量指标，可在发布合成数据集前进行成员泄露风险评估。

title: When should we trust the annotation? Selective prediction for molecular structure retrieval from mass spectra
summary: Machine learning methods for identifying molecular structures from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) have advanced rapidly, yet current approaches still exhibit significant error rates. In high-stakes applications such as clinical metabolomics and environmental screening, incorrect annotations can have serious consequences, making it essential to determine when a prediction can be trusted. We introduce a selective prediction framework for molecular structure retrieval from MS/MS spectra, enabling models to abstain from predictions when uncertainty is too high. We formulate the problem within the risk-coverage tradeoff framework and comprehensively evaluate uncertainty quantification strategies at two levels of granularity: fingerprint-level uncertainty over predicted molecular fingerprint bits, and retrieval-level uncertainty over candidate rankings. We compare scoring functions including first-order confidence measures, aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty estimates from second-order distributions, as well as distance-based measures in the latent space. All experiments are conducted on the MassSpecGym benchmark. Our analysis reveals that while fingerprint-level uncertainty scores are poor proxies for retrieval success, computationally inexpensive first-order confidence measures and retrieval-level aleatoric uncertainty achieve strong risk-coverage tradeoffs across evaluation settings. We demonstrate that by applying distribution-free risk control via generalization bounds, practitioners can specify a tolerable error rate and obtain a subset of annotations satisfying that constraint with high probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统评估了面向质谱（MS/MS）分子结构检索的"选择性预测"（selective prediction）框架：模型可在不确定性过高时拒绝（弃权）标注。作者在 MassSpecGym 基准上于三个粒度（输入表示距离、分子指纹位级不确定性、检索候选排序级不确定性）系统对比了 12 类评分函数（一阶置信度/得分差、基于 Deep Ensemble/MC Dropout/末层 Laplace 近似的总/偶然/认知不确定性、top-K 秩方差、kNN 与 Mahalanobis 距离、候选集大小），并用 SGR 无分布风险控制给出有限样本保证。核心结论：不确定性量化所在的"粒度"比"偶然 vs 认知"之分更关键——检索级总不确定性总体最强，一阶 confidence 是计算廉价的强基线，而指纹级不确定性与检索成功率几乎无关（relAURC≈0.9，接近随机拒绝）。
AI.motivation: 非靶向代谢组学中仅约10%的特征可被注释（"暗物质"问题），而当前基于机器学习的MS/MS结构检索方法仍存在显著错误率；在临床代谢组学与环境筛查等高风险场景中，错误标注会导致误诊或误导监管决策，因此需要一个机制来判断"何时可以信任某个预测"。已有的COSMIC等监督式置信打分方法未对不同不确定性量化策略做过系统性比较，领域内也缺乏"哪一种不确定性类型最适合拒绝错误预测"的实证共识。此外，直接在留出集上按经验风险调阈值无法考虑有限样本波动，可能导致实际风险超出目标值。
AI.method: 问题设定为两阶段指纹检索：MLP/Transformer编码器将谱图映射为4096维指纹概率向量θ，按余弦相似度对实例特定候选集（由分子式过滤、上限256）打分排序，以Hit@K（K∈{1,5,20}）衡量，损失取ℓ_K=1−Hit@K。选择函数由评分函数κ与阈值τ确定，覆盖率φ=E[g(x)]，选择性风险R=E[ℓ·g]/φ，风险-覆盖曲线以相对AURC（relAURC，0为oracle、1为随机）评价。评分类别分三族：(1)一阶检索级分数——最大softmax概率confidence、前两名相似度差score gap；(2)二阶分数——在预测指纹θ上放置二阶分布q(θ|x)，对候选softmax分布与逐位Bernoulli分布分别用Depeweg等信息论分解为总/偶然/认知不确定性（κ_ret^tot/al/ep、κ_bit^tot/al/ep），以及top-K秩方差κ_rank；后验用Deep Ensemble(S=5)、MC Dropout(S=50)、末层对角Laplace(S=50)近似，并比较三种聚合策略（指纹/分数/概率级）；(3)输入级距离分数——1024维倒数第二层表示上的kNN距离(k=100)与Mahalanobis距离。最后用SGR算法（Geifman & El-Yaniv 2017）在校准集上二分搜索阈值，结合Clopper–Pearson上界与union bound，形式化保证P(R>r*)<δ（δ=0.001），在测试集对半划分上校准/评估并报告目标风险下的覆盖率。
AI.result: （1）任务对齐原则：检索级分数显著优于指纹级分数。检索级总不确定性relAURC在MLP上为0.347/0.323/0.359（ℓ1/ℓ5/ℓ20），而指纹级三类分数约0.89–0.97，接近随机拒绝；而当目标损失改为指纹相似度（连续Tanimoto/余弦）时，位级总不确定性最优（0.367），呈双向对齐。但离散化评估显示这一优势主要源于位级熵与概率校准的耦合，而非真正的子结构预测价值；Hamming损失下几乎所有分数劣于随机（仅位级认知不确定性例外，0.777）。（2）总不确定性优于其分量：偶然不确定性接近总不确定性，认知不确定性在所有后验近似与截止值下一致更弱，与Hofman等"最优拒绝准则应为总预测不确定性"的结论一致。（3）最佳分数依赖K：K=1/5时总不确定性最强；K=20时MLP上秩方差最强（0.322），Transformer上总不确定性最强（0.320），说明confidence与秩稳定性的排序随架构与截止值变化。（4）一阶confidence是最强的廉价基线（0.366，接近总不确定性），score gap次之且随K增大退化；输入级kNN/Mahalanobis分数几乎无判别力（≈0.89–0.99）。（5）候选集大小是有效难度信号（与−log|C|的Spearman相关从K=1的0.32升至K=20的0.78），但候选集固定在上限时失效；秩方差在固定候选数子集上仍优于随机，故不只是候选数的代理。（6）风险控制：Hit@20在r*=0.5时MLP可保留约87%谱图，Transformer达99.97%；Hit@1因基础错误率高只能覆盖小部分（如18.25%）；所有操作点的留出经验风险均低于目标风险。（7）监督式分数组合对K=1无增益（Δ≈−0.01），对K=20有约0.045的增益。（8）结论对候选池构造稳健：取消256上限（约59%公式池超限、部分逾20000）、改用10 ppm前体质量过滤时，Hit@K下降但总不确定性仍最强。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是把MS/MS分子结构检索形式化为带任务特定损失的选择性分类问题，并首次在输入级、指纹级、检索级三个粒度上系统比较不确定性与距离类拒绝准则，同时给出基于无分布泛化界的有限样本风险保证。核心洞见是"不确定性层级与目标损失匹配"：检索准确率应由检索级（候选排序级）不确定性度量，总不确定性为最强准则，偶然分量远优于认知分量，而指纹级不确定性与表示空间距离几乎不预测检索成败；一阶confidence可作为免后验采样的强基线。实务上，使用者可设定可容忍错误率r*，在可交换性假设下获得以高概率满足约束的自动注释子集，候选列表场景（Hit@5/20）已具备可用的自动化运行区间，而精确匹配场景需更强模型或接受更低覆盖率。局限包括：仅两个架构、一个基准，未最大化检索性能本身；MassSpecGym候选集按构造必然包含真分子，开放世界（真分子缺席）设定仍是空白；未来可探索考虑指纹稀疏性的不确定性估计、直接在谱图输入空间估计认知不确定性、基于保形化Benjamini–Hochberg的FDR控制与保形预测集等替代范式。

title: Ranking Reasoning LLMs under Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling evaluates reasoning LLMs by sampling multiple outputs per prompt, but ranking models in this regime remains underexplored. We formalize dense benchmark ranking under test-time scaling and introduce Scorio, a library that implements statistical ranking methods such as paired-comparison models, item response theory (IRT) models, voting rules, and graph- and spectral-based methods. Across $20$ reasoning models on four Olympiad-style math benchmarks (AIME'24, AIME'25, HMMT'25, and BrUMO'25; up to $N=80$ trials), most full-trial rankings agree closely with the Bayesian gold standard $\mathrm{Bayes}_{\mathcal{U}}@80$ (mean Kendall's $τ_b = 0.93$--$0.95$), and $19$--$34$ methods recover exactly the same ordering. In the single-trial regime, the best methods reach $τ_b \approx 0.86$. Using greedy decoding as an empirical prior ($\mathrm{Bayes}_{\mathbf{R}_0}@N$) reduces variance at $N=1$ by $16$--$52\%$, but can bias rankings when greedy and stochastic sampling disagree. These results identify reliable ranking methods for both high- and low-budget test-time scaling. We release Scorio as an open-source library at https://github.com/mohsenhariri/scorio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scorio库，用于在测试时扩展环境下对推理LLM进行基准排名评估，实现了配对比较模型、IRT模型、投票规则、图谱方法等多种统计排名方法。在20个推理模型、4个奥赛风格数学基准上的实验表明，全试验排名与贝叶斯gold standard高度一致（Kendall's τ_b = 0.93-0.95），单试验场景下最佳方法达τ_b ≈ 0.86。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）通过为每个提示采样多个输出来评估推理LLM，但在此 regime 下对模型进行排名的方法仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Scorio库，实现多种统计排名方法：配对比较模型、項目反應理論(IRT)模型、投票规则、基于图和谱的方法。在20个推理模型、4个奥赛风格数学基准（AIME'24, AIME'25, HMMT'25, BrUMO'25，最多N=80次试验）上评估。
AI.result: 全试验排名与贝叶斯gold standard Bayes_U@80高度一致（平均Kendall's τ_b = 0.93-0.95），19-34种方法完全恢复相同排序。单试验场景下最佳方法达τ_b ≈ 0.86。使用贪婪解码作为经验先验（Bayes_R0@N）在N=1时降低方差16-52%，但当贪婪采样与随机采样不一致时可能产生偏差。
AI.conclusion: 确定了适用于高预算和低预算测试时扩展的可靠排名方法。Scorio已开源发布。

title: Bio-Inspired Self-Supervised Learning for Wrist-worn IMU Signals
summary: Wearable accelerometers have enabled large-scale health and wellness monitoring, yet learning robust human-activity representations has been constrained by the scarcity of labeled data. While self-supervised learning offers a potential remedy, existing approaches treat sensor streams as unstructured time series, overlooking the underlying biological structure of human movement, a factor we argue is critical for effective Human Activity Recognition (HAR). We introduce a novel tokenization strategy grounded in the submovement theory of motor control, which posits that continuous wrist motion is composed of superposed elementary basis functions called submovements. We define our token as the movement segment, a unit of motion composed of a finite sequence of submovements that is readily extractable from wrist accelerometer signals. By treating these segments as tokens, we pretrain a Transformer encoder via masked movement-segment reconstruction to model the temporal dependencies of movement segments, shifting the learning focus beyond local waveform morphology. Pretrained on the NHANES corpus (approximately 28k hours; approximately 11k participants; approximately 10M windows), our representations outperform strong wearable SSL baselines across six subject-disjoint HAR benchmarks. Furthermore, they demonstrate stronger data efficiency in data-scarce settings. Code and pretrained weights will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于亚运动理论的运动片段token化策略，用于可穿戴加速度计的自监督预训练，在NHANES数据集上预训练后，在6个subject-disjoint HAR基准测试中优于现有SSL方法，并在数据稀缺场景下展现更强数据效率。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴加速度计实现大规模健康监测，但标注数据的稀缺性限制了鲁棒人体活动表示的学习。现有自监督学习方法将传感器数据视为非结构化时间序列，忽略了人类运动的底层生物结构，而作者认为这一因素对有效的人体活动识别至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 引入基于运动控制亚运动理论的token化策略，将连续手腕运动视为叠加的亚运动基函数；2. 定义"运动片段"（movement segment）为由有限序列亚运动组成的运动单元，可从手腕加速度信号中提取；3. 将运动片段作为token，通过掩码运动片段重建任务预训练Transformer编码器，以建模运动片段的时间依赖性。
AI.result: 在NHANES语料库（约28k小时、约11k参与者、约10M窗口）上预训练后，表示学习在六个subject-disjoint HAR基准测试中优于强基线可穿戴SSL方法，并在数据稀缺设置中展现出更强的数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于亚运动理论的token化策略和掩码重建预训练范式，成功将学习重点从局部波形形态转移到运动片段的时间依赖建模上，为可穿戴传感器数据自监督学习提供了新的有效框架。

title: FRIEND: Federated Learning for Joint Optimization of multi-RIS Configuration and Eavesdropper Intelligent Detection in B5G Networks
comment: 8 pages with 5 figures and 2 tables. Accepted in 29th Conference on Innovation in Clouds, Internet and Networks (ICIN 2026)
summary: As wireless systems evolve toward Beyond 5G (B5G), the adoption of cell-free (CF) millimeter-wave (mmWave) architectures combined with Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) is emerging as a key enabler for ultra-reliable, high-capacity, scalable, and secure Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) communications. However, safeguarding these complex and distributed environments against eavesdropping remains a critical challenge, particularly when conventional security mechanisms struggle to overcome scalability, and latency constraints. In this paper, a novel framework for detecting malicious users in RIS-enhanced cell-free mmWave networks using Federated Learning (FL) is presented. The envisioned setup features multiple access points (APs) operating without traditional cell boundaries, assisted by RIS nodes to dynamically shape the wireless propagation environment. Edge devices collaboratively train a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) on locally observed Channel State Information (CSI), eliminating the need for raw data exchange. Moreover, an early-exit mechanism is incorporated in that model to jointly satisfy computational complexity requirements. Performance evaluation indicates that the integration of FL and multi-RIS coordination improves approximately 30% the achieved secrecy rate (SR) compared to baseline non-RIS-assisted methods while maintaining near-optimal detection accuracy levels. This work establishes a distributed, privacy-preserving approach to physical layer eavesdropping detection tailored for next-generation IIoT deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为 FRIEND 的框架：在 RIS 增强的 Cell-Free mmWave（B5G/工业 IIoT）网络中，由多个接入点（AP）作为联邦学习客户端，基于本地观测的 CSI（图像化并融合发射功率、位置、服务 AP/RIS 等元数据）协同训练带早退机制的 DCNN，用于物理层窃听者检测；同时借 RIS 相移配置联合提升保密率。MATLAB R2025b 生成 28 GHz 仿真数据，Python/TensorFlow Federated 训练评估。结果：准确率 0.71–0.93（召回率最高 0.95），早退使推理时延最多降低 35%（CL=70%）/45%（CL=55%）且准确率 >0.83；最优 RIS 相位下平均保密率较既有非 RIS 辅助工作提升约 30%（最高可达 18 bps/Hz 量级）。
AI.motivation: B5G/6G 面向 IIoT 场景演进，Cell-Free（无固定小区边界的分布式 AP）+ mmWave + RIS 成为高可靠、低时延、分布式安全通信的关键使能技术。物理层安全（PLS）中基于 CSI 的窃听检测是主动防御手段，但现有工作多将 CF-mMIMO、RIS、毫米波与深度学习割裂研究，忽视拓扑—传播—分布式智能的耦合；同时集中式 ML 在 IIoT 中因隐私、带宽、数据分散难以落地，中心化安全策略在无中心协调的 CF 架构下亦不可扩展。论文还以 MBSE（基于模型的系统工程）流程定义系统需求（如 R1–R10：5V 数据、偏差—方差控制、隐私合规、可复现性等），聚焦 Securability 与 Scalability。
AI.method: 系统模型：3GPP TR 38.901/38.843 参数化的 CF RIS 辅助 mmWave 网络，18 AP、3 RIS、500 UE（70% 合法 / 30% 窃听者）、28 GHz、AP 32 天线、RIS 10×20 相位、TDD 上行 SRS（OFDM）估计 CSI。有效信道 h_eff,a,l = h_dir,a,l + G^H_{r,b} Θ_r h_l,r（窃听者同理）；保密率 SR=[C_l−C_e]^+，指标为全网平均保密率 ASR。数据集：MATLAB R2025b 仿真器生成含多径衰落、阻塞、大/小尺度衰落、SE 与 RIS 反射的复信道矩阵并转为 CSI 图像，标签 0/1，附位置、发射功率、服务节点元数据；UE 按最佳接收 SNR 动态关联 AP/RIS。模型与 FL：Keras Sequential 精简 DCNN，输入 3 通道 CSI 图 + 6 通道数值元数据，binary crossentropy 优化；第二卷积块后接辅助分类器实现早退（置信度阈值 55%/70%），客户端与全局轮次采用一致退出策略；3 个位于拓扑中心且靠近 RIS 的 AP 作为 FL 客户端，FedAvg 周期性聚合权重（不传输原始 CSI），中心服务器置于拓扑中心 AP；网格搜索 + 交叉验证调参；TensorFlow Federated 实现，100 次 Monte-Carlo（不同 RIS 相移），训练/测试 8:2 划分，评估 Accuracy/Precision/Recall/F1。
AI.result: 分类性能：准确率 0.71–0.93（IQR 中心约 0.84），召回率最高 0.95 且变异较大（源于靠近 RIS、功率差小的高相似 CSI 边界样本），精确率高，F1 稳健，漏检率低。效率：早退使推理时间降低最多 35%（CL=70%）与 45%（CL=55%），准确率仍 >0.83，多数样本可提前判定。保密性能：所有 RIS 相位下 ASR 随合法/窃听比升高而上升；Phase ID 89 在高比例下超 20 bps/Hz，Phase ID 54 明显偏低；非 ML（真实标签）曲线与 Phase ID 4 高度吻合，验证分类器捕捉到的物理层模式具真实性，但部分高 SR 相位实为偏向合法用户的偏置配置（窃听类召回率下降）；最佳 RIS 相位（ID 4）较作者前期工作（无 RIS 辅助）ASR 提升约 30%。
AI.conclusion: FL 下训练的智能分类器可可靠识别恶意传输，准确率/精确率接近 95%，在无原始 CSI 共享下实现分布式、隐私保护检测；RIS 相位调优可显著提升 PLS 保密率（正确调谐下最高约 18 bps/Hz），早退机制在资源受限 AP 上提供可观的时延/算力折中，验证了 CF-mMIMO + RIS + FL + AI 联合设计的可行性。局限与后续工作：全部结论基于仿真数据（需真实测量验证 R8）、RIS 配置多样性/可扩展性未充分评估（R7）、早退与计算卸载联合优化待研究，以及 FL 轮次通信开销与非 FL 基线的统一对照有待完善。

title: Federated Learning-driven Beam Management in LEO 6G Non-Terrestrial Networks
comment: 2 pages with 2 figures and 1 table. Accepted in 2026 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES) Symposium
summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) require efficient beam management under dynamic propagation conditions. This work investigates Federated Learning (FL)-based beam selection in LEO satellite constellations, where orbital planes operate as distributed learners through the utilization of High-Altitude Platform Stations (HAPS). Two models, a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and a Graph Neural Network (GNN), are evaluated using realistic channel and beamforming data. Results demonstrate that GNN surpasses MLP in beam prediction accuracy and stability, particularly at low elevation angles, enabling lightweight and intelligent beam management for future NTN deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向6G低轨（LEO）非地面网络（NTN）的分层联邦学习（FL）波束管理框架：以轨道面为联邦客户端、层间通过高轨平台站（HAPS）做面内聚合、地面网络控制中心（NCC）做跨面FedAvg平均，在不共享原始数据的前提下预测最大SNR波束。基于真实信道与波束成形仿真数据，比较了MLP与GNN两种架构：GNN在Top-1准确率上达96.14%（MLP 88.41%）、Top-3达99.52%（MLP 98.03%），且在低仰角时精度与波束切换稳定性显著更优，模型体积与训练开销仍处于可部署范围。
AI.motivation: 6G新业务（如超可靠低时延通信）要求大尺度MIMO与波束成形来补偿严重路径损耗；但LEO星座高速运动、传播条件动态变化，传统的CSI估计式波束选择存在计算复杂度高、信令开销大、适应性不足的问题。集中式学习在LEO场景中更会带来过高的信令开销与时延，且数据回传受限于间歇性连接。联邦学习可实现不交换原始数据的分布式训练，天然契合NTN多层级架构，可同时获得隐私保护、可扩展性与对非独立同分布（non-IID）轨道几何分布的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 系统建模：S波段（下行2 GHz）LEO星座，高度1015–1325 km，多轨道面、每面均匀分布S颗卫星，静态UE集合部署于指定ROI并受最小仰角约束；卫星与UE均配4×4/小型UPA天线，采用固定方位/俯仰波束码本，仿真时长2小时、采样1000个快照，快照内星-UE几何视为准静态。标签通过全搜索仿真取最大SNR波束 argmax_b SNR_{u,s,b}，SNR计入发射阵列增益、路径损耗、仰角相关的小尺度Rician衰落、时间相关阴影衰落与接收噪声；输入特征包含场景/地理信息、星与波束的方位角俯仰角等几何量。FL框架：分层两级——每个轨道面作为一个逻辑FL客户端，面内卫星通过层内HAPS（边缘聚合与控制实体）协调并训练面级本地模型，200个本地训练轮次后参数上传地面NCC做跨面FedAvg，再广播全局模型回各客户端，从而保证数据本地性、降低通信开销并刻画不同轨道几何造成的non-IID分布。模型：MLP为全连接+非线性激活，对每个候选波束独立打分，轻量高效；GNN将波束建模为图节点、邻接波束为边，通过图卷积交换信息，学习相对波束质量与局部一致性。
AI.result: 表I：GNN在所有指标上全面优于MLP——Top-1准确率96.14% vs 88.41%，Top-3准确率99.52% vs 98.03%，跨客户端平均Top-1为95.97% vs 89.15%，表明最优波束几乎总能进入候选前三；代价为训练时间19.23 s vs 6.27 s、模型大小71.43 KB vs 38.40 KB，复杂度开销有限，NTN部署可行。图2：两种模型的准确率随卫星仰角升高而提升（传播条件更优），GNN始终领先；低仰角下所有方法切换率升高（信道动态、衰落与阴影衰落增强），其中GNN的切换趋势紧密跟随仿真得到的oracle（最大SNR波束）曲线，而MLP在低仰角时切换率略高，说明GNN的波束稳定性与底层信道特性更一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提FL框架在LEO NTN中实现了有效的波束预测与选择管理，GNN通过捕获波束间关联关系比MLP取得约8.7%的更高预测准确率与1.8%更稳定的波束切换，且复杂度开销有限，为未来6G NTN的轻量化智能波束管理提供了可行路径。未来工作将扩展至完全分层（multi-level）FL架构、引入干扰感知的波束管理以及用户—卫星联合优化。

title: The Discrete Charm of the MLP: Binary Routing of Continuous Signals in Transformer Feed-Forward Layers
summary: We show that MLP layers in transformer language models perform binary routing of continuous signals: the decision of whether a token needs nonlinear processing is well-captured by binary neuron activations, even though the signals being routed are continuous. In GPT-2 Small (124M parameters), we find that specific neurons implement a consensus architecture -- seven "default-ON" neurons and one exception handler (N2123 in Layer 11) that are 93-98% mutually exclusive -- creating a binary routing switch. A cross-layer analysis reveals a developmental arc: early layers (L1-3) use single gateway neurons to route exceptions without consensus quorums; middle layers (L4-6) show diffuse processing with neither gateway nor consensus; and late layers (L7-11) crystallize full consensus/exception architectures with increasing quorum size (1 to 3 to 7 consensus neurons). Causal validation confirms the routing is functional: removing the MLP at consensus breakdown costs 43.3% perplexity, while at full consensus removing it costs only 10.1% -- exceeding a 4x difference. Comparing binary vs. continuous features for the routing decision confirms that binarization loses essentially no information (79.2% vs. 78.8% accuracy), while continuous activations carry additional magnitude information (R^2 = 0.36 vs. 0.22). This binary routing structure explains why smooth polynomial approximation fails: cross-validated polynomial fits (degrees 2-7) never exceed R^2 = 0.06 for highly nonlinear layers. We propose that the well-established piecewise-affine characterization of deep networks can be complemented by a routing characterization: along the natural data manifold, the piecewise boundaries implement binary decisions about which tokens need nonlinear processing, routing continuous signals through qualitatively different computational paths.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示GPT-2 Small中MLP层执行二元路由机制：特定神经元形成"共识-异常"架构决定token是否需要非线性处理。这一结构解释了多项式近似的失败，并为理解transformer的非线性计算提供了新框架。
AI.motivation: 理解transformer语言模型中MLP层的非线性计算机制，特别是为何多项式近似方法表现不佳
AI.method: 使用GPT-2 Small (124M参数)进行实验分析，包括：神经元激活模式分析、跨层发育轨迹研究、因果验证实验（MLP移除测试）、二元与连续特征对比、以及多项式拟合（R²评估）
AI.result: 发现MLP层执行二元路由：特定神经元（7个"默认ON"神经元和1个异常处理器N2123）形成93-98%互斥的二元路由开关。跨层分析揭示发育轨迹：早期层(L1-3)使用单网关神经元，中期层(L4-6)显示弥散处理，后期层(L7-11)形成完整共识/异常架构。因果验证显示：共识崩溃时移除MLP损失43.3%困惑度 vs 完整共识时移除损失10.1%，差异超过4倍。二元特征与连续特征准确率相当（79.2% vs 78.8%），而多项式拟合R²最高仅0.06。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个补充性的"路由表征"框架：沿自然数据流形，分段边界实现关于哪些token需要非线性处理的二元决策，将连续信号路由到不同计算路径。这一框架解释了多项式近似失败的原因，并为理解transformer的非线性计算机制提供了新视角。

title: MCMC Informed Neural Emulators for Uncertainty Quantification in Dynamical Systems
summary: Neural networks are a commonly used approach to replace physical models with computationally cheap surrogates. Parametric uncertainty quantification can be included in training, assuming that an accurate prior distribution of the model parameters is available. Here we study the common opposite situation, where direct screening or random sampling of model parameters leads to exhaustive training times and evaluations at unphysical parameter values. Our solution is to decouple uncertainty quantification from network architecture. Instead of sampling network weights, we introduce the model-parameter distribution as an input to network training via Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). In this way, the surrogate achieves the same uncertainty quantification as the underlying physical model, but with substantially reduced computation time. The approach is fully agnostic with respect to the neural network choice. In our examples, we present a quantile emulator for prediction and a novel autoencoder-based ODE network emulator that can flexibly estimate different trajectory paths corresponding to different ODE model parameters. Moreover, we present a mathematical analysis that provides a transparent way to relate potential performance loss to measurable distribution mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MINE（MCMC Informed Neural Emulator）范式：先用 MCMC 在物理模型上离线推断参数后验，再用确定性的神经代理模型在后验信息化的数据上训练，从而在不依赖贝叶斯权重采样的前提下，以远低于暴力网格搜索的成本获得与原模型一致的不确定性量化（UQ）。配套给出分位数（区间）代理与前向 ODE 代理两种实现（含新的 AEODE 架构），以及基于 Wasserstein 距离的分布失配稳定性分析与数值验证。
AI.motivation:
物理仿真模型的神经代理（neural emulator）通常假设已有准确的参数先验分布，才能把参数不确定性纳入训练；但现实中更常见的情况是：直接对参数空间做网格筛选或随机采样会导致训练时间爆炸（20 参数、每参数 10 个取值的暴力网格需 10^20 次仿真，约 3×10^12 年），且大量评估落在非物理的参数取值上。此外，主流的贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）需要在高维权重空间做后验近似，难以扩展、先验难以选择、后验常失准。

因此本文动机是：把"贝叶斯推断"从"网络结构"中解耦出来——不确定性不再由网络权重承载，而由离线 MCMC 得到的物理参数后验承载；并需要一个定量、可解释的理论工具来说明"训练分布与部署分布之间的失配"会带来多大性能损失。
AI.method:
整体为两步法：
(1) 离线 MCMC：采用 DRAM（Delayed Rejection Adaptive Metropolis）自适应 MCMC 对物理参数做贝叶斯标定，得到后验样本 {θ^(i)}（FaIR 链长 30 万，burn-in 5 万；Himmel 链长 5000）；
(2) 在"后验信息化"训练分布上训练确定性代理：训练分布 ν = ρ(x) ⊗ π(θ|y_hist,x_hist)，即输入来自输入分布 ρ、参数来自 MCMC 后验。

两个互补实现：
• 分位数（区间）代理 N_ω':X→R^m，两隐层 ReLU 前馈网络（各 20 单元），pinball loss + 非交叉正则项 max{0, q_0.05 − q_0.95}；输入为基年排放 E_0 分布的超参数 η=(η1 正态/对数正态标志, η2 位置, η3 尺度) 与情景 s，输出后验预测分位数（5%/95%）。
• 前向代理 F_ω:X×Θ→R^n，采用新提出的 AEODE（AutoEncoder-based ODE network）：编码器 φ(x0,θ) 产生隐状态，隐空间向量场 f 积分得轨迹，ψ 解码回观测空间；加入可学习频率的正弦/余弦时间嵌入 λ(t)、自注意力模块（Q/K/V 来自时间条件化隐状态，权重视作参数化求积核/影响核 K_θ(t,s)），以及 5 项物理监督损失：重建、一阶/二阶时间导数、初值恒等、总质量守恒。

理论部分：设 F 与代理均为 Lipschitz、在 U=X×Θ（乘积范数）上，定义平方误差风险与 J(ν)=inf_E R_ν(E) + c(ν,ν_dep)·W_2(ν,ν_dep)。Lemma 1（coupling + Cauchy–Schwarz 得到风险平移界 R_ν' ≤ R_ν + c·W_2）、Proposition 1（在部署律处 J 取最小、偏差 ≤ 2c·W_2）、Corollary 1（多情景混合律 ν_mix 为全局最优训练律）、Lemma 2（W_2(ρ⊗π, ρ⊗π̂) = W_2(π,π̂)）、Theorem 1（有限链界：0 ≤ J(ν̂_N) − J(ν) ≤ 2c·W_2(π̂_N, π)，且在遍历性/二阶矩收敛假设下几乎必然收敛）。

实验：Himmel 化学动力学（6 组分、3 个反应速率常数）与 FaIR v1.6 简单气候模型（20 个物理参数、SSP-RCP 情景 + 不确定基年排放）。指标含 MSE/RMSE/MAE/MBE、pinball loss、经验分位数 MSE、90% 覆盖率、平均区间宽度、wall-clock 时间；基线为 Torchdiffeq、ChemiODE、NeuralODE，另有逐模块消融。
AI.result:
FaIR 分位数代理：上/下界与经验分位数 MSE 分别为 0.0049 / 0.0023；pinball loss 0.0238 / 0.0199；平均 90% 覆盖率 90.04%（接近名义值）；经验与网络平均区间宽度 1.2907 vs 1.3024（差 0.0117）；推理耗时 0.0006 s，而经验采样（5000 样本）约 20 s。

化学动力学 AEODE 对比：MSE 2.450e-5 优于 Torchdiffeq 3.231e-5 与 ChemiODE 2.582e-5；MBE 由 −7.539e-4 降至 −1.316e-4；耗时 9.5e-5 s，相对 Torchdiffeq 约 15% 开销但相对数值求解器约 10× 加速。消融：NeuralODE 基线 3.101e-5 → 加时间嵌入 2.593e-5 → 加注意力 2.466e-5 → 加物理损失 2.450e-5。

FaIR 前向代理：消融使 MSE 从 3.200e-5 降至 2.949e-5（约 21% 改善）；预测轨迹均值/方差与真值吻合良好，未来预测可信区间明显宽于历史标定期（符合预期不确定性更大）。理论侧：训练律匹配部署律（后验/混合后验）为界最优，有限链误差由 W_2(π̂_N, π) 控制并随链收敛而消失。局限：化合物 C 在末期浓度分布上出现模型无法复现的尖峰；假设离线 MCMC 可行，超昂贵仿真器需多保真或代理辅助采样。
AI.conclusion: MINE 范式通过"离线 MCMC 参数后验 + 确定性神经代理"实现与网络结构无关的贝叶斯不确定性量化，把昂贵的参数空间搜索压缩到统计相关的区域，显著降低计算成本；Wasserstein 稳定性分析为"在（近似）部署分布上训练是最优的"提供了定量依据，并量化了有限 MCMC 链带来的性能退化。分位数代理适合需要低延迟区间的场景（如金融气候风险），AEODE 前向代理则支持快速后验预测采样并在精度-速度权衡上优于 Torchdiffeq/ChemiODE。展望包括面向极端昂贵仿真器的多保真与代理辅助 MCMC 扩展，以及在气候科学、大气化学与能源系统中的更广泛落地。

title: Factorized Neural Implicit DMD for Parametric Dynamics
summary:
A data-driven, model-free approach to modeling the temporal evolution of physical systems mitigates the need for explicit knowledge of the governing equations. Even when physical priors such as partial differential equations are available, such systems often reside in high-dimensional state spaces and exhibit nonlinear dynamics, making traditional numerical solvers computationally expensive and ill-suited for real-time analysis and control. Consider the problem of learning a parametric flow of a dynamical system: with an initial field and a set of physical parameters, we aim to predict the system's evolution over time in a way that supports long-horizon rollouts, generalization to unseen parameters, and spectral analysis.
  We propose a physics-coded neural field parameterization of the Koopman operator's spectral decomposition. Unlike a physics-constrained neural field, which fits a single solution surface, and neural operators, which directly approximate the solution operator at fixed time horizons, our model learns a factorized flow operator that decouples spatial modes and temporal evolution. This structure exposes underlying eigenvalues, modes, and stability of the underlying physical process to enable stable long-term rollouts, interpolation across parameter spaces, and spectral analysis. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on a range of dynamics problems, showcasing its ability to accurately predict complex spatiotemporal phenomena while providing insights into the system's dynamic behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理编码的神经场参数化方法，用于Koopman算子的谱分解。该方法通过学习分解的流算子，将空间模式与时间演化解耦，从而实现稳定的长期预测、参数插值和谱分析。
AI.motivation: 1) 物理系统的真实方程往往未知或难以获得；2) 即使有先验知识（如PDEs），高维状态空间和非线性动力学使得传统数值求解器计算昂贵，难以满足实时分析和控制需求；3) 现有方法（物理约束神经场和神经算子）存在局限性：前者只能拟合单一解曲面，后者在固定时间 horizon 下直接近似解算子。
AI.method: 提出一种物理编码的神经场参数化方法，用于Koopman算子的谱分解。具体包括：1) 学习分解的流算子（factorized flow operator），将空间模式与时间演化解耦；2) 该结构可揭示底层特征值、模态和稳定性；3) 支持长期rollout、参数空间插值和谱分析。
AI.result: 在多个动力学问题上验证了方法的有效性：能够准确预测复杂时空现象，同时提供系统动态行为的洞察。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将物理编码与神经场相结合，利用Koopman算子理论实现了：1) 稳定的长期预测；2) 对未见参数的泛化能力；3) 谱分析能力。为复杂物理系统的数据驱动建模提供了新思路。
